bka' zlon rtogs brjod/mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis brtsams/—si khron 4 rigs dpe 1na khang /

/ na mas ma ya/ sgrib bral zag med ye shes me long cher/ /thams can mkhyen pa'i snang brnyan yongs rdzogs pa/ /skyabs kun 'dus zhal mtshungs med drin can rje/ /mi byed snying nas gus pas lan brgyar 'dud/ / thog ma med nas srid pa'i lam ring por/ /bar mi chad du 'khyams pa'i 'khor ba pa/ /spyi dang bye brag duXkhas rtag gzir ba'i/ /rnam 'gyur bzod dka'i rim pa brjod las 'das/ /brgya lam tsam na dal 'byor rten bzang po/ /rnyed pa'i skal ba mchog gis snyems gyur kyang / /'di snang sgyu ma'i rol rtsed la chags pas/ /yang dag don chen sgrub las rgyab kyis phyogs/ /de phyir rang gi ngang tshul gsong po'i gtam/ /ri mo'i lam du spel ba mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /khrel zhing gzhan gyis 'phya smod gnas gyur kyang / /phyi rabs lo rgyus nges phyir mdo tsam gleng / /

zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir gang gleng bar bya ba /bdag cag gi mes po'i bar du ni stag lung ga zi'i gdung rigs zhes byang stag lung gi seng ge'i khri 'dzin pa dang / dbon rigs kyis phod mdo lhun grub rdzong sogs kyi chab srid bde bar skyong ba las/ phra men gyi rig pa 'dzin pa bdud kyi kha drod can dbyen sbyor la mkhas pa'i skye bo la la dag gi byed pa la brten nas gtso bo rnams mnyes gshin pa las bzlog ste/ phan tshun gcig la gcig ma mthun par rtsod pa can du gyur pa'i mthar gnam bskos dga' ldan pho brang pa'i khrims lung btsan pos 'doms te dpal stag lung gi dgon gnas gtsug lag khang / rdzong gzhis sogs 'dzin dbang gang na ci mchis pa rnams gzhung gnas su bdag gir bzhes/ sku ngo ser skya rnams la mthun rkyen gsol skal nyung zad dang bcas te bdag cag gi yab rje mched sogs 'tsho zhing bzhes pa yin la/ de yang rje btsun ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub nges don chos kyi nyi ma rnam grol mchog gi sde'i gsung las/rang don snying la zhen kyang spyo chos su/ /gleng bas pha rol gzhan yang slu byed mi/ /de 'dra dug sbrul dar gyi lcibs 'dra ste/ /ring mo nyid du 'bros par byas na legs/ /zhes gsung pa 'di dag gi snang tshul la da/ngas par mngon zhing gang 3

ltar rnam par 'dren pa chos kyi khri la mngon par dbang bsgyur ba don brgyud sangs rgyas kyi phreng ba rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ni so so'i stogs brngod spegs bam du 'khod pa ltar dang / srid na spyod pa'ang ma sangs tshe dbang grags pa sogs kyi lo rgyus mang zhing / yab gcig ngag gi dbang phyug tshangs pa mchog gis kyang ga zi 3 rigs las skyes pa shā gi shā phra rmi ṇa'i rigs rus byung tshul zhes mdzad pa mchis par/ de yang rlabs kyi po ti se ru las lar skyes pa'i mis rang gi skye rgyud ma shes na nags kyi spe'u 'dra/ mi rang gi cho 'brang ma shes na g.yu 'brug zol ma 'dra/ yab mes kyi yi ge'i tshang ma shes na mon phrug yul bor dang 'dra/ zhes dang /skyes pa'i mi la grags pa'i gtam dgos/byas pa'i chos la grub pa'i mtha' dgos/che ba'i mi la mtho ba'i rtags dgos/zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don la kun gzigs rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos/ bod sil bur ma song ba'i snga rabs kyi dus rje 'bangs mtha' dag rigs rus 'chol par mi spyod pas khungs dang yig tshang la nan tan du byed pa'i srol 'dug cing / deng sang 'di rigs kyi rgyu mtshan mang du ba/spel rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/mjug ma med ces bzhad gad byed/

ces pa'i ngang tshul du 'gro yang / — zhes gsungs pa ltar lo rgyus mang po'i mgrin pa 'degs 'os su ma gyur kyang / rang gi rigs rus skye rgyud/ pha mes kyi yig tshang bcas nges par shes dgos pa gsungs pa bzhin/ phyi rabs rnams kyis pha mes kyi bya ba dang byed pa ji ltar byas pa sogs yid la nges par bya ba'i phyir du kho bos kyang rang tshul cung zad gleng bar 'dod do/de ltar bod mi'u gdung drug tu grags pa ni/ — bse dang rmya dang gdong dang gsum/ sdong dang dbra dang 'bru dang drugaces pa/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i ye shes kyi rol pa spe'u dang / rje btsun sgrol ma'i sprul pa brag srin mo'i rigs rus kyi dwangs ma las chad pa'i phru gu drug byung ba de yin cing / de las rus chen bco brgyad ༵da par mkhas pa kha steg bzhed pa dang / rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos/mi rnga—sa lha gzigs kyi gdung gi thog ma'i khungs dung sgong las chad pa'i ye smon gyel po nas gdung rabs bdun tsam rim gyis brgyud nas/ a mi mu je khri de'i jo mo gnyan bza' sha mig la sras gsum dang / tshu bza' la sras gcig srin bza' la sras gnyis te drug byung / 'di dag las chad pa/ rus chen bco brgyad/ 'bras la dkar nag khru gsum/ bod kyi

mi'u gdung drug byung tshul shin tu mang zhes gsungs pa gang ltar na'ang / gdung drug gi khongs las/ lcags khams dbra rigs nang tshan ga zi zhes pa'i rigs kyi thig le yab gcig de dag gi rigs dang / tshal pa khri dpo na nas nye bar brgyud pa'i drung na skyed pa rnam sras khang gsad ba'i rigs las— byung ba ma dang drung du grags pa gnyis kyi myu gur spyon bsags bzang po'i rdo mthu las me mo glang gi lo dal 'byor gyi lus rten bzang po zhig ni rnyed par snang ngo / churnga ngu'i dus na sgong ba pa gtor ma btang ba'i tshul gyis )nga shag dkrol tshul dang sbrags/ ing zhes mang du 'don pa dang / de nas lor son tshe can stegs kyi khar ma bzhag bar za 'thung mi byed cing / stan mthon po la bsnyegs nas dga' ldan khri pa yin zer ba sogs bag chags bzang po zhig yod zer ba thos te/ da lta'i ngo thog 'di ga yin 'dug pas sgro 'dogs su nges/ bzhin stabs snying du sdug par brten tshang mas kha spyor ba btsog pa'i tshad du ba phyugs kyi sto sgod la dpe byas nas chas khog gi ming btags pas res shig de kha 'bod/ lo drug bdun tsam na se ra thig chen ming du zhang po rab 'byams smra ba zhig yod pa'i sar phyin nas khrog yig legs par bslabs/ la mo chos skyong chen por zhus pa'i ming la tshe ring dbang rgyal zhes stsal/ lo btsu nas yab gcig bka' drin can gyis yi ge 'gri pa dang / rdol rtsis/ dpe cha 'dzin skyong sogs tshang na zhi slob dpon 5—

khur du bzhes te bslab bya yang dag par mdzad/ gzhung sa'i bla rtsis pa khro rgyal dpal mgon dang / smin grol gling nas blo gros /kyi mthu ldan dge slong blo gsal rnam gnyis nas snyan ngag me long le'u gnyis pa tshar re khrid par rtsom rgyug kyang phul grub rjes/ dge slong blo gsal lags nas/lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa 'jigs bral gyis mdzad pa'i dpe cha zhig dang bcas/'jigs med grags pa'i legs bshad yongs 'du'i tshal/las 'ongs bstod tshig u7la gzhon nu'i 'phreng / dbyangs can dga' ba tshe ring dbang rgyal gyi/rnam dpyod mgu'/ pa'i rgyan du bdag gis spel/zhes ming 'dogs kyang mdzad/ 'di dag gi skabs su kho bo byang stag lung gi gdan sar 'khod pa dgos zhes gra ming sogs 'dus tshogs phal cher nas don gnyer che ba byas 'dug kyang phyi nang gi rkyen dbang gis ma 'grigs/ yang nag chur yab gcig dang mnyam du yod thog sku zhabs pad dkar 'dzin pa'i zhabs gras su dgos tshul phebs kyang mi khrol 'byung ba'i zhu don mdzad de khrol cha stsal/ lcags yos rang lo bco lnga pa'i thog smin grol ming du slob gnyer la thon nas/ nges pa don gyi mkhas pa chen po lo chen snye sri'i zhabs pad bsnyen te 'phags yul mkhas dbang da1'i 6

bzhi/da gzhung snyan ngag le'u gsam pa'i bal 'a khrid zhus shing rtsom rgyugs kyang phul ba dang / stong 'jug ma gtogs pa'i skar rtsis ri mo yongs rdzogs/ la spyar dpa bcas pa'i yig ris kyi bka' drin stsal zhing / de 'phros rnams kyang rim bzhin zhu mus la/ mdo khams bstan pa'i sgon me chab mdo rgyal ba 'phags pa lha sku bsnyun bag gis btses pa'i thabs bcos la lo chen rin po che gdan zhus kyi chibs bsgyur stabs re ba 'phro can du lus kyang / chu mo sbrul gyi lo slar yang skyabs mgon lo chen mchog gi zhabs rtsar bcar te/ sgra dbyang sa can ma yongs rdzogs/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas/ skar rtsis kyi 'phro skyong bcas bdag nyid kyis gong du ji ltar bslab sbyangs bgyis pa 'di dag thams cad slob dpon bskos te bslabs pa sogs kyang min pa'i lo chen mtshungs pa med pa sku dngos rang nas ljags khrid gnang ba sha dag gi skal bzang nyams su myong zhing / sgra'i ri mo yongs su rdzogs par grub nas tshangs sras dgyes pa'i blo ldan zhes phyag bris ma'i ming 'dogs stsal/ rtag par dgyes pa chen pos rjes su bzung nas zhabs drung 'di chos zhig mdzad na yag po yong ba 'dug ces sku 'khor sogs la bka' yang yang stsal 'dug kyang de lta bu'i skal ba ni ma thob/ lo snga phyir yon tan bslab ring la lngags bshad nyan skabs sogs don yod nges ma gtogs bag yangs la brten pa'i sdod gnas kyi sgo'i them pa 'da' ma myong bar brtson pa bskyed/ deng sang lta bu'i gung sangs dang — — 7

sangs sogs ci yang byed ma myong zhing / rjes ma'i skabs zla ba drug gi ri nga la thon khar skra khru thengs gcig byas pas/ lan tshar gri chung gis bshags nas khru dgos byung ba sogs g.yeng ba lam gyi dbang du ma song ba'i yon tan la brtson 'grus che bar grags/ de skabs gter chen myos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin 'gyu ri med rdo rje yang sku 'tsho zhing gzhes skabs bcas yang sprang mjal phyag gi go skabs thob cing / phyag phul ba na sku bzhengs gnang ba'i bzos sgo dang dbu thug stsal ba/ bka' las kyang / rigs kyi bu la brgyud kyi lha 'go zhes khyed tsho bod kyi mi drag bsngags par 'os pa yin pas da lta— nas yon tan la brtson pa ma bskyed na ci yang mi btub tshul sogs bka' slob don gyi snying po can mang dag stsal zhing / de skabs gtir gsar rig 'dzin thugs kyi thig le dang / tshe dbang / gur drag rta mgrin lcags ral can sogs kyi bka' dbang rjes gnang kyang mang dag thob/ gdung sras padma 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i drung nas dpal rdo rje7jig byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang chen kyang thob pa yi dam 'di nyid ba dag gi lha ga pa'i lha mchog tu 'di tsam nas rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar 'grig ga ma snyam/ rjes ma'i skabs 'dir gter chen chos kyi rgyal po zhing 'di'i gdul bya jogs shing / skye bo rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir zhi dbyings su mnal bar bzhed pa'i phyi'i rtags nam mkha' nas lha'i rol mo'i rgo dang / dri zhim gyi du da pa 'thul ba/ 'ja' sprin ngo mtshar 'i ༷

bgod pa dang bcas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i spreng du gshegs pa'i gdung mjal sogs 'dod pa rdzogs par thob cing smon lam gyi mtshams spyor kyang yang dag pa ra bgyis/ de skabs yab gcig lha ldan du phebs 'dug thog nas bsu mi gnang byung bar lha sar phyin/ rgyal po lha bzang gi lung bsgyur ba'i skabs yin gshis mjal phyag zhus te drung na spyod pa'i gras su zhugs/snyan ngag le'u gsum pa'i rtsom rgyugs/ mchod brjod sum mar du spyor ba bcas phul bar gnang cha yang stsal/ shing rta lo yab gcig tshangs pa chen pos grub dbang rin po che ngag dbang bston 'dzin dpal 'byor ci po sku 'khor dang bcas mdo mkhar du spyan drangs te zhag shas kyi bar du brtan chags shing bsnyen bkur zhabs tog sogs kyi mnyes pa bsgrubs/ thugs spyo bzhin pa'i ngang nas chos bro nyams mgur sogs kyi dgyes nyams mdzad/bdag cag gis kyang mgur dbyangs sogs kyi mchod sprin spro/ 'dod chos zab mo'i 'brel pa'ang zhus te kun tu don yod pa'i bka' drin thob/ shing mo lug lo mdo mkhar rtsa ba'i sras dang kho bo thun mong la bya khri dpon gyi sras mo rnam rgyal dbang mo 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi gnyen du sbril mang mi ring bar tha dad du gyur/ me pho spe'u'i lo kho bo gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse ji dpya khrul 'bab yong bsdu ba'i byed por mngags pa bzhin bskyod—/ — mgon po tshe mtha' yas sa'i ngo bo paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs cen por mjal phyag gi skal bzang thob/ rdzong dpon sogs ri ba'i chab zhubs 9

sgo sangs dang 'grig pas der bskyod de nyag phran gyi rtse 'jo sogs la rol ba de dag gi khengs pa'i ri bo cung zad bsnyil/ dpya khrul bsdu len sogs gang gi thad du'ang rang blo bzang por gang shar gyi drang tshad gtan la phab pa las/deng sang gi skye bo tha shal rnyed pa kho na don du gnyer zhing gtam ngan la ji mi snyam par 'bangs rnams til ltar 'chir ba'i ngan spyod mkhan rnams kyi rnam thar ring du dor nas/ 'bangs rnams dga' zhing 'dun pa dang 'bab pa yong gzhung gis rtsis lam du bstar ba la'ang a gnyis pa'i gnas zin par gyur to/ de rjes cad du me mo bya lo slar yang gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i sgong dpon gyi las 'dzin du bsko bzhag gnang ba ltar thon par 'di skabs o rod jun gar pas rgyal po lha bzang la dpung bsteg pa 'dam du 'khrug long gi stabs bcas stod smad thams zi bun gyi g.yengs bzhin par mchis pa las gzhis rtser yang rdzong 'dzin du rtsis dpon lum pa nas dang /'brong rtse nas yab bcas yod kyang mi ring ba nyid du lha bzang khang klu sbu ṭa kyi spyongs su mtshon cha'i lam du bkrong pa bcas mtshan jus shor te jun gar pas bod khams la dbang bsgyur ba'i sbyar yig bkram pa ltar kho bos kyang lha ldan du bskyod nas jun gar pa'i dpung gi gtso bo rnams la btud/ de rjes stag rtse zhabs drung lha rgyal rab brtan dgung lo shin tu smin kyang hong tha'i —ji'i bka' yin zhes bod ljongs kyi srid 'dzin sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol/po na kyi mi drag bla ma kha shas mar bcad/ rnying lugs kyi dgon gnas —10

gtor ba sogs yo lang che/ bka' drin mnyam med lo chen dharma sri yang skyid chu'i 'gram du bkrong rtsis la/ pho ba spar bye gshegs 'dug kyang thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi ched du grub dbang rin po che ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor me tog ldum rar bzhug 'dug pa der phyin te bsngo rten phul nas dgongs pa rdzogs pa sogs kyi smon lam yang dag par zhus/ de rjes kho bos gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtser sdog pa de skabs dpon ja'i sa nga sogs rim par 'byor te bkra shis lhun po nas gzhu 'dom lnga brgya'i khongs— gzhis rtse'i zhol yongs rdzogs bshig dgos sogs brdab gsigs mi/na tu che bas ngal dub tshad las 'das pa byung ba dang / bla ma khrus phu nas dang /nged gnyis nas gzhung gi sgu rim mnan gtad kyi bkod pa byas zhes nyin gcig yong bzhes khang du sgor skyil byung yang mthar sgol phug bla ma dang nor 'khrul byung zhes sgor skyel byed mi sog po gnyis kyi lag nas rta sge ma re sprod len gyi bden gsol dang bcas rang nyi da la nyes skyon ma byung tsam du shar/ dpon jil sang dang mnyam du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gziṭa chen por tshe sbyin sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang zhig kyang legs par thob/ sa khyi lo ljongs 'dir yun ring 'dug dgos shar na mthar nyams nyes ji yo nga ma shes pas dgongs khrol zhus te/ lcags rtse gri gu'i rdzong dam na gyi las khur 'dzin du stsal/ 'di skabs stag rtse sde srid nas zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi mdun du mdo sde 11

mchod pa'i skabs 'grems pa'i slob dpon bdud 'dul sogs kyi gos sku legs par bzhengs grub pa'i rab gnas la dga' ldan khri rin po che blo bzang dar rgyas/ rje drung rin po che/ rgyal sras rin po che bcas phebs 'dug pa/ sde srid rin po che'i mjal khar bcar/ legs 'bul gyi bdog pa bstar/ rab ston gyi tshe skye bo sgyu rtsal gyis snyems pa du ma'i dbus su tshang rag gi rtse 'jo la zhugs pas de skabs na tshod phra ba bcas lus kyi sdem 'gyur khyad par thon pa la/ rta thog nas lhung dogs pa'i rgyal sras rin po che sogs sku lus yon por gnang dgos pa dang / gzhan dag gis kyang kha la sbar mo 'gebs pa'i bsngags brjod dar dir sgogs pa byung /skabs 'dir rgyal sras rin po cher dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i mngon rtogs rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa reg zig bklags chog ma'i ljags lung kyang legs par thob/ de nas lha ldan du bskyod de yab gcig tshangs pa chen bo sku nyams mi bde bar gyur nas de'i tshab tu stag rtse sde srid kyi mgron gnyer dang / drung yig nyis spyogs lta bu'i khur len dgos shar/ lcags pho byi ba'i lo bsam yas dbu rtser jo bo byang chub chen por dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan sogs rin po che'i phra rgyan can stag rtse sde blud nas bzhengs par gnang ba rab gnas yon bdag la chibs bsgyur gnang skabs 'dir gong sa thams/ cad mkhyen pa'i sku 'khor gras nas bkra kas dang la ra ba'i chos mdzad lho kha brgyud gsang stabs kyis 'byor ba/12

gong sa skyabs mgon chen por sde srid rin po che nas zhu yig gnang dgos dngos su zhus na gnang gtad kyi rgyur song dogs 'ol dga' rje drung rin po che dang phran bu/ phyag mdzod dngos grub dgos skyes can gsum bgros nas/snga phyi'i babs rkyen mtha' dag gi bsod bkrol dang bcas zhu yig bzos shing phyag dam kyang gsang stabs kyis phab ste don gnyer chen pos phul ba yin kyang / rgyal dbang mchog gi phyag tu 'bul thub pa ma byung zhing /gong ma chen po'i lung gis mngags pa'i rgya sog gis dpung bgrang gis mi lang ba dang bcas/ gong sa lha mi'i gtsug rgyan chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling nas spyan drangs te rim bzhin gsheg pa'i snyan grags kyi rnga bo che srid pa gsum na bsgrags pa la brten jun gar pa'i dpung tshogs/ bod dpung bcas byang phyogs su rim par bteg kyang gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa chen po chibs kha bsgyur pa dang / gong ma'i dpung gi gzi byin ma bzod par jun gar pa'i dpung rnams rang gnas su ldog cing srid zhi'i rnam 'dren chen po yan lag bzhi pa'i dpung gis bskor te gru 'dzin pho brang chen por zhabs sor gyi sprad ma 'khod pa'i dga' ston bla na med pa nyams su myong skabs mgron gnyer gyi zhabs 'degs sgrub bzhin pa yin/ de nas mi ring bar stag rtse sde srid rang bzhin bzang zhing / thugs gya gyu chung ba/ ya rabs kyi ngang tshul bcos med du mnga' ba bstan 'gro mtha' dag la thugs bskyed dge ba zhig yin 'dug kyang / ga — 3

— rnam kun nges par mi g.yo zhing /skye ba'i mthar thug gnas gyur pa/skyes bu'i don dang 'gal gyur pa'i /spyon gyi las la phyag 'tshal lo/zhes gsung pa ltar sku tshe snga ma'i las dbang myong bya bzlog tu med pa'i sde srid rin po che blon 'khor dang bcas pa kha shas gong ma chen po'i bka' khrims kyi 'jigs pas 'jig rten phyi ma'i gnas skabs su drangs ste de skabs yab gcig tshangs pa chen po dang kho bo'ang gong ma'i mi drag gshin rje'i gshed ma lta bus 'gugs par lhags pa kho bo gnas tshang du cung zad bzhag nas yab gcig phebs dgos shar ba de'i bar du bdag cag ngo g.yog zung gis snyi thag chad pa'i 'dab chags bzhin tu gzhis mdo mkhar gyi bar du zhag gsum gyis rdol bar byas te/ de nas nyen dogs shar nas btsan zhig tu bskyod rgyu'i sta gon byas par yab gcig dam par dam ji tsam las gzhan ma nyes skyon med par bde grol gyi gtam cha 'byor ba dang /nged kyang na tshod phra zhing las don chen po'i le khag ci yang med tshul bka'i gung blon pho lha tha'i jis bsed dkrol gnang bas gong ma'i mi drag rnams dgongs pa dwangs ba'i gnas tshul bcas 'byor bas rang gnas su phyir sdog —chu pho stag gi lo lha ldan du bskyod de 'jig rten rnam par 'dren pa rgyal 14

dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba mong mi dma' ba dang bcas rnam rgyal gra tshang bas che sbyin rnam par rgyal ma'i sgo nas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bgyis/ rgyal ba'i yab rje rin po che bsod nams dar rgyas dpon khag rnams dang / bka'i gung blon chen po rnams la 'a nga legs mtshon gyi bdog pa bstab/ 'di skabs gzhung gi drung na spyod pa rnams drag zhan gyi go rim dang / shes yong sogs zhib dpyad mdzad 'dug par bdag la ni mgo 'don gyi re stos 'cha' yul yod pa zhig min kyang / shes bya yi ga rtses stobs rtsal bcas tshang ma ang gnas dang po sha stag 'khod par snang yang sde srid stag rtse ba'i nye gtogs stabs las tshan che khag mi 'os pa'i gleng byung 'dug pa re zhig drung 'khor byings gral su 'khod/ skabs 'dir rmor dgon du bskyod de rmor chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i dbang chen dang / na ro mkha' spyod ma'i sin dū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs dang / bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim rtswa dbu ma che chung sogs bka' chos mang dag zhus te rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len bskyangs shing / yang dag gi ste/ dbang zhus te ras rkyang gi brtul zhugs kyang bzung / chu mo yos kyi lo gzhis chen gong ri dkar po'i dpya khrul 'bab yong bsdu ba'i byed por stsal par dam pa'i lam dang mi 'gal ba'i dpya 'bab lugs bzhin bsdus shing / za snyed kyis gtser 15

ba med pas 'bangs mas kyang yid rwangs par byed pa dang / gzhung 'bab rtsis lam du bstar ba la'ang a gnyis pa'i gnang skyes zin pa byung / gnam ro gsar tshes kyi dga' ston la thod ri bshad sgrub gling pa'i bla ma las sne sogs mang dag 'tshogs rgyun 'dug pa/ nged nas phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan dang rig gnas lnga bshad las brtsam pa'i gral 'phros 'jibs par gsol zhing / mjug mtshan nyid 'gro ming par kha 'phangs/lha ldan du 'byor nas mi dbang pho lha tha'i ji hor kha bzhi sogs la gong ma'i bka' bzhin don dpyod la phebs dgos shar ba de'i sku tshab lta bu rtsis dpon du sdod dgos phebs don bzhin bka' lhur blangs shing phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i dag ther zhib dpyad thal lus med pas zhabs 'degs bsgrub pa las ngo 'dzin dang rgyu brngan gyi rjes 'breng gzhung don la ji mi snyam pa'i le shor du gyur pa ni ci yang med/ shing pho 'brug gi lor lhar bcas skye rgu'i rnam 'dren rgyal dbang 'jig rten gsum mgon gdan sa chen po ri bo dge ldan/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bcas kyi gnas gzigs la chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i chibs 'chang pa'i gras zhus te zhabs 'degs sgrub pa'i skal bzang thob/ bsam yas su yod thog gzhis nas bya ma rta 'byor te yab gcig ngag gi dbang phyug tshangs pa chen po gzim khri mtha' can du gyur pa'i gnas tshul thos pas bzod par dka' ba'i gdung bas mnar zhing ci bya gtol bral du gyur pa/ de 16

'phral kun mkhyen rgyal dbang mchog gi spyan sngar thon phyag zhu bar bcar bar/bsam yas kyi zhabs rjes lha khang du zhabs 'chag gnang skabs dang 'grig byung ba/ phyag gis btud cing du ngag drag pos bdag gi pha 'jig rten pha rol du gshegs pa de nyid kun mkhyen rgyal dbang na rim la mi phyed pa'i dad pa gting tshugs shing khyad par rgyal dbang mchog la bcos min gyi dad stobs dang ldan pa lags par/ da ni skyabs mgon dpung gnyen thams cad skyabs mchog gi thugs rje kho nar re ba las med gshis 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las grol zhing / bde 'gro'i rten bzang brgyud de thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob pa'i skyabs 'jug thugs rje che dgos tshul gsol ba phur tshugs su btab par bka' bzhes bzang po'i dbugs dbyung stsal/ de nas ring stabs kyis bskyod de mdo mkhar du 'byor ba na yul 'khor skye bo seng seng po snum zhag bral ba/rdzong yang thug dang / dar spyog la sogs pa phab ste rnying gog gi rnam pa can/'bangs 'khor rnams kyang gos dri ma can mnab pa skra bshig pa/ ngud mo'i sgra sgogs pa/ nyams mi dga' ba sha stag mthong nas/ kho bo yang ma dga' nas mchi ma'i rgyun lhung zhing yid chal chor gyur nas gom pa'i 'degs 'jog kyang tshul bzhin ma thub pa bran dag gis brten te rdzong nang du lhags pa na 'chi med kyi dga' tshal dang mnyam pa'i gzims chung nyi 'od 'khyil ba de yang stong par lus/ yid kyi brten sa mig gis lta ba'i yul / ///na

gcig bu dang ni bral bas/ nyi zla med pa'i nam mkha'i khyon dang / nor bu med pa'i chu gter lta bur mthong nas/ kye ma/ 'khor ba'i snang tshul ni las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i bde sdug gang yang snying por gyur ba rdul tsam med pa 'di 'dra ba sha stag go snyam du nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa'ang shugs drag tu skyes song / de'i tshe dge ba sgrub pa rnams kyi ngang tshul rang gi rgyu nor gang mchis pa nas bzung zhing rnyed par dka' ba rnams mdzod phugs su bcug nyag nyog nor du btub min rnams pha ma'i dge rtsar gtong ba dag gi lugs srol ma bzung bar/ mdo mkhar rang gi nor rnying chag lo hā ba'i thugs dam rten rgyal dbang mi pham pa'i snang brnyan dzha/༷las grub pa dang / nged rang gi lag bris ma bye brag rtogs byed chen mo su ba tā du spyor ba pod/gdung rten lcags rtse ma/ pad 'dab dkyal 'tsho sbug gis byas pa'i spus legs dang / pad ril kong rna dang bcas pa/ rgya lu chas cha tshang /sog chas cha tshang / dgra chas cha tshang / tshom chen gyi yol ba mdzod gos rgyan gzhi rnying ma shin tu legs pas mtshon rgyal ba 'jig rten gsum mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por yod dgu rtsal sprugs kyi bsngo rten gang legs dang / gzhan yang skyabs yul dam pa la bsngo zhus/ rten bzhengs/ 'dus gra la mang 'gyed/ gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod sprin/ 'bangs mi sde rnams la sbyin gtong sogs grags 'dod dang byas 18

lo tsam ma yin pa'i bzang zhing gya nom pa rnam dkar dge gtong rgya chen spa legs par bsgrubs/ gnam lo 'di nang nas bzung ste mnga' ris gra tshang du lo ltar cho 'phrul zla ba nang du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i yig drug dung phyur bum sgrub kyi rgyun bzang yang da lta'i bar du chag med du sgrub pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dpag par dka'/ shing mo sbrul gyi lo rgyal dbang phyag na padma sbas yul dkar mo ljo ngas sam chos 'khor rgyal bkra shis lhan gyis grub pa' gdan sa chen por chibs kha bsgyur bar sgar dpon gyi zhabs 'degs zhu dgos la/ chos 'khor rgyal nas spel zla gzhis grong nas nor 'dzin dbang po'ang bsnyun gyis btab pa bcas spyog min gyi ga mang gzhi che yang zhabs 'degs sgrub 'os gang ci 'thus shor med pa bsgrubs/ de nas mdo mkhar rang gzhis la gnas skabs rje btsun gsang ba 'dzin gyi sgyu 'phrul rje drung rin po che blo bzang 'phrin las dbang po'i sde spyan drangs zhag shas bzhugs brtan chags par bkur ste zhabs tog phun sum tshogs par bsgrub shing / yongs 'dzin dam chos bzang por gnas 'di ni lho bde ba can yin 'dug gsung ba sogs bsngaṭa brjod stsal/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i gsung 'bum gras nas dbang lung sogs zab chos kyi rim pa'ang mang du tho pa pa 'di skabs so thar gyi sdom pa'i nyams gzhes sogs kyang lhod pa med par gnang / me pho rta'i lo kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa chen pos/ bde 1snye

ldan zhing gi myo gon po paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dge spyong gi dngos po yang dag par bzhes te/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi yon gnas dam par gyur pa'i tshe jo bo shākya mu ni'i spyan sngar mchod sprin rgyas gshoms dang gnas yul sogs tshang ma'i gra bsgrig gi zhabs 'degs zhus pa'i skal pa bzang po'ang rnyed/ 'di skabs bka'i gung blon chen po pho lha tha'i ji dang / bsher dpon bon grong / spro bde khang gsar pa'i dpon po bag gro bcas nas mtshams sbyor gyi sde pa rag pa'i 'dzin dbang thog dol 'jo rab brtan pa'i sras mo mched dang bcas tshang ma 'dod bsgril 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi rim par lhur blang /'di tsam na bod ljongs su gong ma bdag po chen po'i sku tshab tā bzhin gnyis tsam bzhugs pa las/ dpung tshogs kyang phyir ldog cing / bod 'bangs rnams kyang rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gi thugs rje'i ci bder bag yangs su gnas chog pa'i skabs yin kyang spyod 'jug las/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod blo yod kyang / sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyugabade ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bstan 'gro'i gegs chags bdo ba'i dbang 20

sgos/ me mo lug lo bka'i gung blon rnams dgongs pa'i 'dzin stangs tha dad pa'i dbang gis thugs nang ma gshin par pas se nga phod nas/ gung lum pa nas/ tha'i ji sbyar ra nas bcas kha shas bgros thog nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pas se khang chen nas lha ldan bla brang gi gzim chung rgyal ba sku na rim gyi bzhugs gnas khams gsum du rkus thabs kyis mi rtag pa'i lam la bkod/ de dang dus mtshungs gtsang du bang gung pho lha tha'i jir gsang dmag mngags kyang stod phyogs su theg pas glags ma rnyed/ las don 'di tsam brtsoms nas nyi ma gcig kyang bde ba dang dal ba gnas rgyu med par stod smad kun tu dmag gi rnam par g.yeng ba kho nar dus 'da' ba byung / 'di skabs kho bo'ang thog ma tā ching ba thur gyi sog dmag gi rjes 'ded du byang phyogs gnam mtsho'i bar du bteg rjes sor sog po rnams nas mgo 'bul zhus gshis phyir sdog yang gung blon pho lha tha'i ji stod nas phyir ldog mdzad pas dpung 'bras khud du lhags pa de dang nye bar dbus dpung gi sgar phab pa'i 'jings su zhugs/ mi ring bar 'thab dus shar ba 'di nyid ha cang rgyal pham shan bye ba ma byung yang / gtsang dpung g.yas ru 'bras khud ri 'debs su lhags pa gang yod phyir bsnyil zhing /kha shas srog gi 'du byed btang ba dang / kha shas bcings bzhin du go rar bcug— pa'ang sna tshogs shar/ 'di dag gi tshe kho bo yang g.yas ru'i ru dpon gyi go sa 'dzin pa'i stabs ru sne gang yod du gtso bor phyin pa las 21

zol sbyor gyis skung ste bsdad nas sdar ma'i brtul zhugs bzung ba med/ de nas sang nyin gzhan ma'i mtshan mo nas gtsang dpung gsang stabs kyis bcub/ ste ri mtho sa btsan rnams bzung ba'i g.yul bshams rgya cher shar thog re gnyis nas tshugs ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis gtsang dpung rnams phra ma zin par yang skyar zhig stod phyogs su phyir 'then mdzad dgo shar/ dbus dpung byings rnams rjes 'ded kyi tshul du stod phyogs su bteg kho bo gzhis ka rtse'i sgong du sdod dgos phebs pa thub chen gdan sa'i rnam thar bzung /mi 'gyangs tsam dgongs khrol zhus pa ltar smin nas lha ldan du slebs mtshams su/ slar yang dbus dpung phyir ldog rjes stod nas gtsang dpung skyar ca/ lhags pa'i gtam cha la brten/ kho bo cag dang / sku zhang a ge bkra shis/ gung lam pa nas/ sbyar ra tha'i ji sogs chabs cig par gtsang du thon/ der 'byor skabs kyang nyang stod shar kha rgyal rtse yan gyi rdzong gzhis tshang ma gtsang dpung gi bdag gir bzung grub 'dug bdag cag rnams ni rgyal rdzong gi 'dabs rol rgyal mkhar zhes pa'i grong chung zhig snang bar rten bcas te gnas so/ de'i sang nyin rang rgyal rtse'i rdzong gi nye 'dabs mang ra zhes pa'i sa char g.yul gshams kyi las la bzhuṭa par 'thab lag shin tu ya nga bar 'phrod pas 'jings su dbus phyoṭa kyi dpa' rgod du grags pa tshe bdag dang dpung gshibs te kho bo'ang yod rung nyes skyon du ma gyur cid / tshe bdag cung zad 22

chang gis myos pa'i skyon gyis byas sa ma zer ba'i gang stor mtshon 'og tu bkum pa bcas mthar g.yul pha ༄ / pa'i snga rtaṭa thog mar shar bar 'khums so/ de nas re zhig sngar ltar gnas pa la mi'i za chas 'bru rtsam/ rta'i chas rjen chag gzan pa sogs kyang shin tu rnyed dka' bar gyur pa la dmag mi'i skye bo dag gi mgo 'ching nged cag ru las/ brgya bcu sogs kyis bgyis te phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu ke bar ltar lhang/sa nas gzan sran/ 'bru rtsam 'tshol ba la dmag dpung gi 'jigs pa sel thabs dang bcas yun ring zhig ngal ba lhur len dgos shar/ 'di dag gi skabs mda' gzhis sogs sa rigs rgya chen po la longs spyod pa po rnams ni ci bder 'dug pa las/ ngal ba la brten mi dgos pa'i srol lam ya mtshan pa snang / skabs shig gtsang 'grag dgon zhes pa'i gnas su phyin nar dmag mi'i skye bo'i 'bru rtsam sogs 'khyer ba smos ci dgos/ de'i gtsug lag khang na sku rten byin can 'ga' shas 'dug pa'i gzungs gzhug kyang 'don du 'cha' ba la nged rang nas sgo bkag te legs par srung ba'i skyon med du yod pa 'di tsam yang don yod pa 'i dge 'bras la mgu ba skyes/yang rgyal mkhar gyi dbus dpung thog gtsang dpung gis mtshan 'gebs btang ba'i 'khrug long rgya cher shar ba sgar dpon dga' bzhi nas sogs kha shas rkyen dbang du gyur skabs/ mnga' ris zla ba rgyal po'i dmag mi zhig gsod par brtsam pa nged rang gis zhus gsol srog skyabs kyi bde bar gnas nar 33

slar rang gnas su ldog chog par byas/ de rjes dbus dpung gi sgar grong gong zhes pa'i sa char gnas thog paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po dang / sa skya bdag chen gyi sku tshab dang / dbus gtsang gi chings don legs par 'grig tshul gyi dbus dpung rnams sna dkar rtse'i bar du phyir sdog de nas mi ring ba slar yang rkyen slong brjod rigs mi mthun tsam gyi thog gang ltar bka'i gung blon pho lha tha'i ji dpung bcas byang 'grims kyis thon pa'i gtam grags la brten/ gung blon lum pa nas sogs bdag cag rnams kyang lha ldan du ring stabs kyis phyir ldog de nas kyang mi 'gyangs bar gtsang dpung rnams kyi gnam mtsho nag chu sogs rim par blangs nas khad nyer bcar zhing gar par dmag sgar phab/ de'i tshe dbus dpung gi gtso bo rnams dang dmag dpung yod do cog dga' mo 'phrang du 'dzin cha dang bcas rgol bar bteg kyang / las dbang myong bya bzlog tu med pa'i rang rtags kyis nyin gcig kyang brtan ma thub pa dbus dpung rnams 'thor/ gtso bo rnams po ta la'i rgyal sgo'i nang du bya thi ba tshang la 'jug pa bzhin 'dzul/ gung blon pho lha tha'i ji dpung bcas kyis lha ldan rgyal khab chen po chabs 'bangs dang bcas pa bdag gir dbang bsgyur/ de tsam na dbus kong bka'i gung blon rnams rang rang gi nyes pa ni thog tu bab/ dgra la rgol ba'i nus pa ni med/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por gsol ba 'debs pa las ci bya gtol bral du gyur pa'i tshe/ kun gzigs rgyal dbang mchog ཿ4

gi gser dngul gos dar gyi gnang skyes bla na med pa myur bur spungs pa gung blon pho lha tha'i jir stsal te bka' blon sogs nyes can 'di rnams srog la mi 'bab pa dang / ci bder gnas chog pa dgos zhes bka' nan lci bar phebs pa la/ gung blon pho lha the ji nas gong ma'i bka' ji ltar phebs pa ma gtogs pas/ de'i bka' gsal ma phebs bar srog skyon yang ba dang rgyab gnyer dang sbrags te bde grol gyi lha ldan gnas khang khag tu ci bder gnas bcas/ kho bo'ang byed spyod mi mtshams pa'i nyes can gras su 'ong ba'i don ma mchis kyang / dpung 'degs snga phyir ste 'dzin sha stag tu bskyod dgos dang / ma 'ongs lhus things sa 'og dar 'thag gi rnam bkra'i ris ci yang byed pa ma shar bas/ mi dbang pho lha tha'i ji thugs 'khrugs par ma gyur grang snyam du yid la kun rtog gi ri mo ci yang shar rung / sngon nas 'dris shing brtse ba'i skyong bzhin pa kho na 'a mu ltar rag dang rag shag tu'ang dmag mis gnod pa byung do ṭa srung cha ba 'jog pa dang / lha sar phebs ma thag kho bo rtsad gcod mdzad 'dug pa bcas mjal khar bcar skabs dgyes 'dzum mul bzhin par sngar 'dris kyi bag chags bzang po'i gsung gleng dang /dus 'gyur yo lang zad mi shes pa'i gnas tshul gyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar gyur/ 'di tsam na kho bo la mi dbang mchog gis dgyes par skyong ba la zham ring ba dag ches cher ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / gtsang phyogs kyi mi drag rnams nas kyang log pa'i zhu sne ji snyed spyor 'dug kyang / mi dbang nyid 15

ri bo ltar brtan brjid ba chang ba la gzhan rkyen rlung gis g.yo 'gul ma thub 'dug cing / rang nyid kyang dbyings dkon mchog gi gzigs pa ma khrel na/mi kha 'chal rnams lab pa gang dga' gyis/ zhes gsung pa ltar ci'ang nyams snang med par sdad pas sus kyang glags blta ba ma byung ngo /de nas mi ring bar gong ma chen po'i bka' mang ṭa pa'i mi drag a li khan a pa ca tā bzhin/ mi reng nu dzang gi me tā bzhin can dpung tshogs stobs po che dang bcas 'byor/ nyes can rnams la nyin grangs mang po'i bar du dri rtsad 'jigs shing rngams pas bden rdzun gyi shan phye/ srog la 'bab 'os dang mthar bskyugs 'os sogs dbye ba phyes nas/ nyi ma gzhan par bka' blon sogs nyes pa lci ba rnams bar ma ri'i 'dabs rol du khrims shing gtsugs par bsgrags nas/ me bo che'i sgra lan gsum bskul ba dang chabs cig par srog bkum/ de tsam na kho bo bee 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba/ snying mi dga' bar gyur nas mig bltar ma bzod cing smon lam rnam gsum kha ton byed pa las thabs ma rnyed bod 'dir dam pa'i chos gnas pa'i zhing khams rgyal ba yab sras kyi thugs rje'i gzig pas skyong ba rten gsum khyad par can bzhugs pa'i gnas khyad du 'phags pa yin kyang / chos dang bdud kyi dpe bzhin snga phyir du bod kyi mi drag du ma zhig khrims 'og rang du ma rung bar gyur pa'i ngang tshul bsam nas yid skyo ba la tshad med pa zhig byung yang de las bzlog pa'i nus pa bee med/ de nas mi ring bar am 26

ban gnyis nas bka' phab pas gong ma chen po dang 'jal 'dzom bka' drin che tshul gyi gong sa mchog sku 'khor dang bcas li thang phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur dgos shar/ phyogs 'di'i gdul bya rnams mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyi ca co ches cher sgogs shing byud chu'i ko khad rag 'gram gyi bar du zhabs rjes su 'breng nas thal mo sbyor zhing / phyag 'tshal ba dang / ngur mo'i sgra dang bcas smre sngags kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'ang dpag tu med pa byung / bdag cag gis kyang bde chen gyi bar du chibs bskyel la bcar zhing dad gdung chen po'i gsol 'debs zhus pa/dgyes bzhin brtse ba'i bka' dang zhal phyis kyi byin rten kyang stsal/ de rjes gnam gyi lha gong ma chen pos kho bo la'ang dza sag rim pa dang po'i tha'i ji'i cho lo dang bcas bka' blon gyi las khur 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' phebs/mi dbang chen pos zhwa gos bca' tshang sogs leṭa skyes gya nom pa dang /gzhan dag gis kyang legs pa'i me tog lha rdzas rim pa ltar mod/ legs par brtag na sdug bsngal gyi khung bur tshud pa'i legs so nyid du nges so/'di skabs skyabs mgon byams pa'i zhal snga nas kyis rdo rje 'chang don yod mkhas grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gnas tshul mi dbang mchog la zhu ba gnang ba ltar thugs yid 'phrogs te zhogs gur smon nas gdan 'dren zhu gnang gis lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi gnas gzigs thugs smon sogs gnang zhing dga' ldan khang gsar du yab sras sku 'khor sogs dang mnyam du 27

dpal 'jigs mdzad rdo rje bdud las rnam par rgyal ba dang / thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs kyi dbang chen sogs thob cing / de nas rgyud khang lcang lo can du bzhugs gdan 'jags skabs phran gyis gsol ba btab ste dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzoṭa pa brtse bas gzigs dgos zhus pa ltar zhal gyis bzhes par brten dbang zhu ba po bsam sdings sprul sku/ thon zhabs drung / phran bcas la sta gon nyin gcig dang / dngos gzhi dbang bzhi rdzogs pa nyin gcig la gzabs bshad rgyas par stsal ba'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro bdas snying myos/ 'di phan chad la bla ma bzang gsum gsung bshad sogs 'byams klas pa du ma zhig gi bka' chos zhu myong mang / 'di nyin lta bu'i go ba skye ba dang /dad pa 'phel ba rtsa ba nas ma byung zhing / bla ma 'di rang sangs rgyas dngos yin 'dug snyam pa'i 'du shes skyes/ khyad par gsung bshad skabs/ thabs rgya che ba'i rim pa dang / shes rab stong pa nyid thabs shes ya bral gyis byang chub mi 'grub pa dang / de lta bu'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyis yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro ba'i rgyal sras ngang pa'i rgyal po de rgya che ba thabs kyi cha rnams ma tshang ba med pa'i kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i gshog pa dang / de kho na nyid bdag med pa gnyis legs par rtogs pa'i don dam pa'i bden pa la brten pa'i gshog pa gnyis bgrad nas 'gro bar byed pa las bya gshog chag ltar lam rngu cha shas phyogs re bzung nas 'gro ba'i thabs med pa dbu ma 28

'jug pa las/kun sgob de nyid gshog yangs dkar po rgyas gyur pa/ngang pa'i rgyal po de ni skye bo'i ngang pa yis/mdun du bdar nas dge ba'i rlung gi shugs stobs kyis/rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro/zhes gsung pa'i don zab rgyas su stsal pa dang / de ltar thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs nas nges pa gsang sngags la 'jug dgos pa sogs kyi zab bshad gnang ba rnams thos pas chos tshu' bzhin du sgrub pa'i blo yod pa yin na bla ma 'di lta bu zhig nges par brten nas nyams len skyong dgos par 'dugagatam snyan grags tsam gyi rjes la 'breng ba'i bla ma dang chos zab zab/ yin yin mang yang lam ltar snang phyogs re ba tsam gyis ci yang mi btub par snang snyam pa'i nges shes gting nas skyes/ dbang bsgyur legs par stsal grub nas khyed rnams kyis yag po go i byung phebs par/ bsam sdings sprul pa'i sku nas nged tshos ni dpe med gar yong / bka' blon zhabs drung sku yon che gshis yag po gsan yod 'gro zhu ba gnang song bar/ bla ma'i bka' la/ mi nag gi yon tan che byas kyang / phar skad cha dris na phu sob sob zhig la sa mi yong phebs/ de rjes khyed da lta nyams len gang byed phebs par 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs ma chag tsam re dang / na ro mkha' rngo9

spyod ma 'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma bcas nyams len byed khul yin zhus par/ de rnams byed lugs ji ltar yin phebs par rgyun du byed pa bzhin blor gang nges pa rnams shar gyis snyan du phul bas/ 'o na de rnams kyi lag rjes ji ltar 'jog phebs par lan 'bul rgyu 'di yin zhig ma byung bas mi nag gi yon tan la spi sob sob las mi yong phebs pa thugs mad snyam pa shar/ skyabs mgon rdo ri rje 'chang yar lam rag gzhis khar spyan drangs mi ngo rnams la tshe dbang zhus shing / phran gyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bskyed rim sgom khrid zhig zhus te nyams len rgyun skyong gi khul du bgyis/ de dag gi dus su gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje'i ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul rje drung sprul sku rin po che lha sar phebs nas 'khrul zhig gi rnam thar ji snyed pa zhig lhur bzhes par mdzad pa la/ la la dag mchog tu dad pa'i sa la bkod pa dang / la la dag ma dad pa'i phul du gyur pas bskur pa 'debs pa sogs sna tshogs byung song yang /kho bo ni mtha' de gnyis ka'i phyogs su ma lhung ba rang babs su tshuṭa thub par gan sa pa lags/ de nas yang mi ring ba nyid du rje grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub rin po che sa ga zla ba nang lha sar phebs te/ jo bo shākya mu ni la dge sbyong gi cha lugs phul ba dang / stong mchod/ rab gnas 0/skyar ma dang / zhabs brtan de mtshungs ra mo che dang / po ta lar yang mchod 'bul rab gnas sogs la phebs skabs/ rgyud khang lcang 30

lo can du bzhugs thog phran gyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ bla ma rwangs —po dge bshes sogs kha shas/ ma sbyora'i bla ma/ phran bcas kha shas la lam gyi gtso bo rnams gsum gyi smin khrid gzabs rgyas dang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bskyed dim dang / rdzoṭa rim rnal 'byor bzhi'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa nan tan du stsal ba'i bka' drin bla na med pa thob cing / rang gi go don la ji ltar byung ba dang sbyar nas bla ma yi dam dbyer med la bstod pa zhig gis phebs pa'ang rang blos gang sgobs 'phral du phul bas dgyes pa chen pos rjes su bzung nas rang nyid rtsom pa po las lhag pa'i brda 'grol gyi gsung bshad kyang stsal zhing / mthar khyod thabs shes gnyis kyi bdag po byed pa'i rten 'brel gyis zhes lha rdzas srid du ring ba zhig dang /gser dmar ram ji/ཿlas grub pa'i rdo dril cha tshang zhig kyang stsal ba'i bsod nams kyi phul chen por gyur kyang / da lta'i gnas tshul la brtag na thabs shes kyi bdag po'i dri mas kyang ma gos par snang / de skabs bdag gis gsol ba ji ltar btab pa bzhin dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rdzogs rim rgyas pa lam rim pa lnga dang sbyar ba'i zab gnad can dang / dmigs rnams skyong tshul mdo 'gog 'dril ba'i legs bshad kyi skyes bla na med pa zhig kyang bka' rtsom stsal/ lam gtso'i bka' khrid stsal skabs sna / ma'i bla ma yang chos zhur yod pa kho pa bla ma la dad zhen che bar grags kyang yang dag pa'i lta ba'i gsung bshad stsal skabs/gzims chung du 'khyugs 31

bab pa gral 'tshes gzhan la skyon med par ma ( 1 bla ma la phog ste spyon pa dang / sma ra yang tshig pa byung song ba khong tsho'i lta ba skyon can zhig min nam gleng / 'di skabs skyabs mgon byams pa rin po che chab mdo rgyal ba 'phags pa lhas spyan 'dren gyi gshegs nyer mchis pa mi dbang chen po dang lhan cig par lha ldan gyi gnas gzigs su phebs pa bla brang gi mda' yab 'og tu thog mar mjal ba yin pas kha btags dang phyag phul zhing /mjal ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur nus pa'i yid rab tu dang bas spu zing por byed pa'i dad stobs 'phel yang bka' chos sogs kyi 'brel ba zhu ba'i skabs ma rnyed/ slar mdo khams nas phyir phebs pa dang bstun ma gcig grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs bka' chos rim par zhus shing / phran gyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad lha bcu gsum ma'i blos bslang sku rgyu rdon dkar po sogs las grub pa cha tshad dang ldan pa gsar bzhengs kyi rab tu gnas pa'ang stsal/ gsung bshad skabs/ rab gnas skor gyis gzhi blang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bgrod pa'i lam tshad la ma nor ba nyams su len tshul gyi zur brgyan pa dpe bral ba'i legs bshad kyi skyes gnang bas mi phyed pa'i gus pa thob/ gur smon du skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang rje grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po lcags phag zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du skyabs mgon bla ma byams pa rin po ches gsol 'debs gnang ba bzhin/ rta tshag rje drung rin po che/ rgyud smad bla ma grags pa lhun grub/ bla ma rwags 32

po dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ byang chub ming gi ri khrod pa kha shas/ bdag cag sogs don gnyer can mang por dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags luṭa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa nyin gsum gyi bar du rgyas par stsal zhing / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim bsdus pa'i ljags lung kyang stsal ba thob pas skal bzang dga' ston ni nyams su myong mod kyi/ de ltar thos pa'i don nyams len gyis phongs pas rin po che'i gter rnyed kyang de longs spyod dang bral ba ci 'dra ba de 'dra'o/skabs der lho 'brug gzhung dang / de'i nang tshan ka spe gnyis mi cha/thun pa'i rkyen dbang gis sto nang mi bde ba'i zing long du gyur pa la gong ma bdag po chen po'i las don du bzhugs pa rgya dpon go lo ye dang / phran gnyis de dag gis mthun sbyor legs spel du bskyod dgos tshul bzhin nyang stod shar kha rgyal rtse'i bar du bskyod cing / de nas spel gong dar han du grags pa dang / sman thang pa gnyis 'brug so so'i gnas su mngags/phan tshun du 'jibs par smra bas mtshams sbyor ba gtan du yid ston rung ba dka' yang re zhig bde 'jags kyi bya dga' chen po la bkod/ bkra shis lhun por deng nas bde ldan zhing mgon paṇa che thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i mjal phyag gi skal bzang thob ste mi ring bar lha ldan du phyir ldog yang mi dbang chen pos bskul ma zhu ba gnang ba bzhin rje grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub pa'i zhal lnga nas dga' ldan du spyon 33

drangs bye/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod sdong gser gdung rin po che'i spyan sngar/ mi dbang chen po blon 'khor/ lo sems dpa' chen po/bdag cag la sogs pa mang dag la smon sems cho gas 'dzin tshul gyi phyag len rnam par dag pa dang / gsung bshad rgyas par stsal bas tshang ma bcos min gyi dad pa'i sa la bkod cing / byang chub kyi sems rin po che theg pa thams cad kyi lam gyi gzhung shing dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bgrod pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa dang / byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di skyes pa tsam gyis 'khor ba'i btson rar gnas pa'i nyam shin tu thag pa zhig yin kyang / bde bar gshegs pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras zhes brjod pa dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur pa yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ zhes sogs kyi lung don mtha' klas pa dang bcas te byang chub kyi sems rin po che la bsngags brjod kyi rgyas bshad stsal ba rnams thos pas kho bo ni mig mchi ma dang ma bral bar 'di lta bu'i dam pa'i chos kyi legs bshad thos rgyu yod pa skal ba re bzang snyem du dad pa'i spu long g.yos par gyur to/34

de'i nyin phyi ma la yangs pa can du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi tshogs 'khor gnang song bar me tog gi char zim bur babs shing / de grub nos gnas gzigs gnang skabs chos rgyal gyi sku brnyan gyi spyan gyi thad nas zil pa che bar babs pa bdag cag gis kyang 'thung rgyu byung zhing /bka' bsko gnang bas rngul ba yin nam/ bdud rtsi 'dzag pa gang yin nam dbye ba ma chod/ 'di skabs la mo cho sa skyong chen po'i sku brten pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyang yod par/ gnas gzigs su phebs lam du phran la dri ba mdzad nas dge lugs pa la tshogs 'khor gyi srol yod pa e red gsung bar/grub mtha' thams cad la rang lugs kyi tshogs 'khor yong bar gzhir bcas gleng / lar babs nas mi nag pa'i rigs phal cher gyi blo'i 'dzin stangs la dge lugs pa zhes mtshan nyid pa kher kyang mdo phyogs kyi nyams swen las sngags phyogs kyi nyams myong gang yang med pa dang / rnying ma bka' brgyud pa sogs sngags pa kho na yin snyam pa'i log rtog rgyun 'byams pa zhig 'ong gi 'dug pa de ga'i rang rtags su mngon / yang mi dbang chen pos chu pho byi ba lo lha ldan rtse mor gsang bde 'jig gsum gyi blos bslang khyad par can ga ra bzhengs dang / 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi sku thang gsar bskrun/ gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la rab gnas su spyan 'dren gnang ba bzhin/ rje grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub pa'i zhal snga nab zhogs gur smon pa'i chog rog dang bcas pa nas 35

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor du rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad rjes/ rgyud khang lcang lo can gyi chos rar mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po sku 'khor dang bcas pa dang gdan sa chen po bzhi'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas bsdus/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang khams gsum mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i grol ba don gnyer gyi mkhas 'dus brgyad brgya tsam la dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thams cad gang nas gshegs shing gshegs par 'gyur ba'i lam 'khrul ba med pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde rin po che'i don ma tshang ba med par 'dus shing / shing rta chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / thogs med gnyis kyis ji ltar bkral ba/ byang sems las dang po pas ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul dpal lha cig tā pa ka ras bod yul 'dir gsal bar mdzad pa/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams khrid rgyas pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi'i gzugs— su rol pa chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos 2 greng rgyal ba'i dben gnas kyi yang dgon brag seng ge'i zhol du mdzad pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa chen mo'i gzabs bshad zla ba lnga'i bar du threl nas nyin stor nyin gung yol nas nyi rgas bar dang / skyabs dgon chen po bla ma byams pa rin po che nas kyang gsung chos ma rdzogs bar du snga dro tshang mar bde lam/ zhal lung / blo spyong don bdun ma sogs kyi khrid dang / dngen sa bka' 'bum sogs kyi ljags lung kyang stsal bar/ /bo 36 spre

bo'ang chos sgrub pa'i skal ba dman zhing rnam g.yeng zad mi shes pa'i 'dam du bying ba'i stabs snga dro bka' chos tshug pa zhu ma thub kyang / phyi dro byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gzabs bshad bka' khrid kyi rim pa rnams g.yengs med brtson pa chen pos nyan te mdor na gnyid kyis non pa tsam yang med par spro seng nger gyur pa bee bsod nams kyi phul ches mchog tu gyur cing /sa zla'i bco lngar skyabs mgon chen po bla ma byams pa'i zhal snga nas kyi —sems bskyed mchod pa rgyud pa'i 'du khang du stsal ba dang / chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhir rje grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog gi lha sa bla brang gi gzim chung khams gsum du sems bskyed mchod pa stsal ba'i skal bzang la'ang longs spyod/ skabs 'dir byang stag lung bka' brgyu ༷ sdom gsum gleng gi sgrub mchod 'char can tshugs pa dang stabs bstun gyi bdag cag nye du 'khor bcas bskyod de gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la mchod sprin/ mchod sa/ dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyid kyi bsnyen bkur ba sogs bsod nams kyi phung po 'du bgyis shing smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor shugs drag tu bgyis/ gar 'chams kyi stang stabs kyang 'dren— byed kyi bcud du thob/ nyi ma gzhan pa la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dab༄ 'khrun las bstan 'dzin rnam par rgyal ba la sku gsung thugs/ rten/ na gza' skor chas dngos 'bul gyi bdog pa bzang po dang bcas ste zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar tu brtan par bzhugs pa dang / rlabs chen 37

'a phrin las kyi 'jug pa mtha' rgyas su sprel ba sogs kyi lo rgyus lung 'dren —gang shes dang bcas gsol ba btad par re ba dzad bzhin 'jo ba'i bka' lan kyang stsal 1 de rjes do g.yog tshang mar ma gcig grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang / skyer sgang lugs dpal rta mchog rol pa zung 'brel gyi rjes gnang stsal zhing / nged rang sgor la dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor dbang / gnod sbyin ma pa ra tsitta dang / lha mo dud sol ma'i rjes gnang / tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes ba/nang / bstan srung rdo rje kun skyob dpal mo che'i rigs gtad sogs bka' chos kyang mang tsam zhu ba'i go skabs rnyed/ de nas 'bri khung gti sgo'i chu tshan gyi 'phrod bsten tu bskyod par 'bri khung sprul pa'i sku rdzong gsar tu bzhugs skabs dang 'grigs pas der 'ong dgos phebs pa bzhin phyin nas mjal 'dzom zhus/chos 'brel 'dra ni zhu skabs ma rnyed/ chu tshan gyi 'phrod brten grub nas phyir ldog lam zhogs gur smon du bcar te zhag gsum gnas bcas nas rje grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyi sku zhabs su nyin ltar bcar ste chos dang 'brel ba'i bka' mol zab cing rgya che ba stsal zhing / lhag par 'jig rten gyi phun tshogs legs leṭa 'dra mo'i gsung gleng gi mu ga byung la/ 'khor ba zhes skyug bro po yin/ 'dis ci yang mi 'ong zhes yang yang bka' phebs kyin yod pa 'di gcig pu'ang bsam bzhin da snying nas dad pa'i gsos su 'gyur pa yin cing / nan gyis gsol ba 38

btab pa ltar/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dang chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum tri rjes gnang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos kha shas kyang dgyes zhig tu stsal/ spyan snga nas thon khar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sku phyag la sle'u chung ba'i bzo rgyun thugs dam rten du bzhugs pa gcig dang / zhwa gos sogs bdog pa rgya chen stsal nas chos dang mthun pa'i zhal slob mchi ma 'khrug pa stsal zhing / phar yang mchi mas gnang bzhin du bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon chen por zhabs pad brtan dgos pa dang / skye ba nas tshe rabs kyi 'khrung ba thams cad du rjes su 'dzin dgos pa'i gsol 'debs yang dag par zhus/ shing pho stag lo mi dbang chen pos gsol 'debs mdzad pa bzhin/ mi ci chen po nyid dang / rgyal sras rin po che/ rgyal ba 'phags pa lha/ rta tshag rje drung rin po che/ se 'bras kyi bla ma drag rim phal cher/ phran bu bcas khyon 'dus pa drug cu skor la rje grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog gis lha sa zam gdong du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams khrid rgyas pa stsal zhing / dga' ldan khang gsar kyi tshoms chen du mi dbang mchog nas sbyin bdag mdzad de sgyu lus mchod pa phul du byung ba mdzad pa sogs kyi zab chos ma lus pa'ang skal ba bzang pos thob par gyur kyang / nyams su len pa'i skal bas phongs pa ni bsod nams ma yin pa'i 'bras bu rlabs che bar sem/sa 39

so/ me 'brug lo skyabs mgon rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i bka' bzhin mi dbang mchog nas jo bo shākya mu ni'i spyan sngar rgyal ba ma pham pa'i snang brnyan ches che ba gser zangs las bsgrubs pa bzhengs pa gnang bar yang rje grub pa'i dbang phyug nas rab gnas stsal zhing / sku rten 'di'i gzugs gzhug rdo rje 'chang don yod mkhas grub nyid kyi tshems dung dkar rang byon khong pa'i 'khyil khar ring bgrol yod pa khyad 'phags gser gyi ga 'ur g.yu phras phyug pa dang / slob dpon rin po che'i brag phug ma ra ti /ra tshe sgrub gnang skabs kyi las bum ngo thog dang / phra rgyan la phran rang gi rna rgyan gru g.yu'i pad 'dab dang / rna rtsa pad ril kong rna nyis 'dogs spus legs dang bcas phul ba'i bsod nams spel/ 'di skabasajo bo shākya mu di'i spyan sngar mchod sprin bshams thog rje grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog gis skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'ang stsal/shing mo yos lor lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i skyabs mgon mtshungs zla bral ba thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po mgar thar nas chibs kyi kha lo bskyod de/ pho brang chen po ri bo gru 'dzin gyi gzhal med khang chen po'i gser khrir zhabs zung 'khod du nye ba'i snyan mags kyis bskul te/ mi dbang chen po'i zhabs rjes 'brengs te chibs bsur bcar/ nged dang mgron gnyen spru gu ba gnyis rwa speng nas sngon la thon te gong sa skyabs mgon chen po/ lcang skya rin po che/ phu tā bzhin 40

sogs la mtshams zhur mngags pa gnang byung ba bzhin bskyod/ bzhugs sgar 'du nag sum mdor phebs thog rgyal dbang 'jig rten gsum mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po gzims gur gyi mdor yol sgor nang du bzhugs stan srab mor bzhugs 'dug pa'i sku mdun du bcar/ sku mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor gzi byin lhag par gsal ba mthong thos dran reg gis grol ba legs par mjal zhing 'khri shing dud pa lta bu'i phyag 'tshal gyis btud de byin rlabs zhus/ sku'i nye ba'i gam kho nar 'dug tu stsal nas/gsung dbyangs snyan cing 'jebs pa'i bka'i gnang ba stsa la ba rnams ni yid la bzung / thugs brtse chen pos bskyod pa'i gzigs pa lhag par dge ba ni nyams su myong zhing skyabs mgon chen po dang gong ma'i bla dpon rnams la ji ltar gsol 'os kyi don rnams la the tshom gyi spros pa chod par byas te —phyir ldog de'i nyin phyi ma 'a/ 'dam stod bkra shis thang tu mi dbang chen po dbus ga tsang gi bla dbon mi drag stobs po che dang bcas te bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po mngon par 'du mdzad pa'i mdun bstar te gzims gur ga sa ri'i dum bu chad pa lta bur tshang ma gdan mngon par 'dzom pa na mi byed gus pa'i phyag gis btud pa la phyag dbang stsal zhing der 'dus mtha' dag dga' ba dang gus pa dang / rangs pa'i bsam pa gzugs can bzhin du byes par gyur/ de nas rwa smreng gi gdan sa chen por gnas gzigs sogs la chibs kha bsgyur zhing / 'di dag gi skabs mchod yon dgongs 41

pa sgod gcig tu dkar ba'i rdo legs lam gyi sgo dod pa bcas rdzong gzhis mtha' dag la gtam snyan dril bsgrags kyi bka' shog kyang stsal/ kho bo rwa greng nas sngon la bskyod de lha ldan du phebs ston sogs kyi gra bsgrig tu 'gro dgos stsal ba ltar 'ong zhing / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi 'khya/sa ra chen mor yol ba bla bre/ phan phye phur/ dra ba dre phyed/ rgyal mtshan/bzhugs khri/ stan gsham sogs kyi bkod pa bla na med pa dang / gsol ston gyi bzhes spro rang yang gro zhib ru'i bre bco lnga la bzos pa'i lag dogs kyi tha sbag bkang ba theg dka ri ba sogs bzang zhing rgya che ba'i gsol ston gra sgrig gnang song ba ltar ka/ 'di skabs char gyi rgyun ha cang ches pa'i skyon phra mo tsam las gzhan ma gang gi skor la'ang gra ma 'grig pa dang rten 'brel gyi 'jug sgo log par song rigs ci yang med par legs pa rab kyi rtser phyin pa'i dga' ston gyi 'jug pa sum rtsen du'ang ma grags sam snyam pa'i snyems rnga/ skyes/ de nas mi ring bar rang nyid nas mchod yon lhan rgyas la brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i blo gros shar te pho brang chen po po ta la'i gzim chung bka' gdams 'khyil par rnam rgyal gra tshang pa tshogs yongs nas tshe sbyin rnam par rgyal ma'i sgo nas gsung chog gnang bar dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen por 'phags pa thugs rje chen po klu 'jim las grub pa'i sku dang / rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa pod gnyis la sogs pa spyon sngar bstar zhing / ma /la 42

'bul ba dang chabs gcig par zhabs pad brtan dgos pa sogs tshig don rang blos gang spob rgyas par gsol bas rgyud khul te 'ga' zhig mchi ma 'byin pa sogs kyang byung 'dug cing / mi dbang chen po la yang sku —gsung thugs rten sogs dngos 'bul spom mthor bsteg zhabs brtan gyi cho ga grol rjes gzim chung nyi 'od du mchod yon lhan rgyas nas mjal slog gsol ras rgya cher stsal zhing / dgyes shing brtse ba'i gsung gi dbugs dbyung kyang thob/ de nas mi dbang chen po blon 'khor dang bcas pa tshang ma sgong rgyab dga' spyo tshal du gdan drangs ste zhabs tog dang / rtsed ra sogs rgyas par bshams nas dgyes rgur rol/ 'di dag gi tshe rdzong rgyab kyi 'dam ra dbus gtsang mi ser phyed langs kyis brnga ba'i srol yod par spyi spom su brngas gshis las rgyun lnga mchod bsgral nas kyang 'gor ba dang nyin chad thal chad sogs la dngu la bsdu ba 'dam brnga rtsa chad dang mnyam pa sgrub dgos sogs dka' sbyongs shin tu che bar brten rjes sor mi dbang chen pos thabs gang 'gab dri ba gnang bar rang rang gi bsam tshod sna tshogs zhig phul 'dug kyang 'dam ra la thig btab pa'i cha bgos dang / de la rdzong gzhis mi ser rgyan rgyab pa'i rang skal sgrub bcug na rang mi rang las kyi las 'gor chung zhing / nyin chad thel chad sogs bsdu mi dgos pa'i dge slebs che tshul zhus pa ltar/ deng sang gi bar du srol lam de kho na gnas pa 'di ni tshig 'don legs pa'i dge rtsa rlabs po 43

chi yin snyam pa'i rlom pa'ang mchis so/lo 'di'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po dang / mi dbang chen po mchod yon lhan gcig tu bkra shis lhun por chibs kyi kha lo bskyod pa'i zhabs phyor kho bo'ang bteg bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gnas su phebs nas snang ba mtha' yas mi'i srid pa'i gar gyi rol pa paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por mjal 'dzom/legs 'bul brtan bzhugs bcas 'bul res su bka' drin che ba'i skabs dang / lhag don paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos sngon 'gro'i ljags bshad dang bcas byang chub myur lam gyi dbu 'dzug par gnang ba sogs skal bzang don ldan gyi rim pa mtha' dag nyams su myong / sa skya bdag chen rin po che rgyal ba yab sras mjal khar phebs pa'ang mjal zhing dgyes bzhin pa'i bka' stsal kyang zhib lhug tu stsal/ 'di skabs hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun kyi khyab bdag rje grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub zhal snga nas zhing )'di'i gdul bya sgogs shing / rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bsgul ba'i phyir chos dbyings zhi ba chen po'i khrong du mnal ba ni/ skya shi bar de'i snang ba gang shar yang /sngon chad goms pa'i lam 'khyer rnam gsum gyi/ gsal 'debs dge sbyor bskul mar rtogs gyur nas/ tshe yid la dga' ba rgyas par shog44

ces gsungs pa ltar/ gsung mgur dang / bzhad mo dang spyo nyams kho na'i ngang nas chos dbyings zhi ba chen por gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs zhu mi 'byor ba/ kho bo'ang yid la gdung ba brnag dka' bas gzir zhing / ci bya'i thabs dang bral bar gyur te rang nyid kyi gyon pa'i gtso bo sbu la kha'i da ma/ zhig mchis pa de rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po dang / rgyan gzhi mngags thags kyi rtsag pa nang kho ru las byas pa zhig mchis par paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen por ljags bsngo skyabs 'jug zhu rten phul nas gsol ba btab/ lha ldan du phrin yig mngags nas gur smon rang du dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa'i dngos po yang mi dman pa phul te bsod nams kyi phung po 'du bgyis so/skyabs mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug 'di nyid la phran bus chos dang zang zing gi sgo nas kyang dgyes shing brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ste/chos dang mthun pa'i bka' bslab dang / zol med pa'i bka' mchid kyis dbugs dbyung pa sogs phas bu la 'doms pa lta bu'i bka' drin bla na med pas bskyangs pa'o/de nas mchod yon lhan rgyas lha ldan du chibs bsgyur grub rjes/bla ma dwags po dge bshes blo bzang sbyin pa rag shag tu spyan drangs nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa dang /rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i bshad srol mchog tu gyur pa legs 45

bshad chen po 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad lung rdzogs par zhu snyam mang rnam g.yeng gi gzhan dbang stabs le'u bdun pa yan chad zhus shing 'phros —rnams skal ba ma thob/ me mo sbrul gyi lor gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchod yon lhan rgyas dga' ldan/ bsam yas bcas kyi gnas gzigs dang / de nas chos 'khor rgyal bkra shis lhun byus grub pa'i gnas mchog dam par chibs kha bskyod de phyir phebs skabs yer pa'i gnas gzigs dang / rag mdor gsol 'bog gnang ba'i tshe/ gsol tshig skor sogs tshang ma'i 'gan len dang / dkar spro spom 'bul/ dngos 'bul dang bcas bdag cag nye du mchis brang dang bcas pa'i mjal phyag skal bzang gi dpal la spyod pa dang / mjal slog gnang skyes bzang po dang bcas bka'i gnang ba dam pas dbugs dbyung ba'i bka' drin thob/ bkra shis lhun por paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po blo bzang ye shes gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi ngor zhi ba'i dbyings su mnal ba'i dgongs rdzogs dngul gdung rin po che bzhengs pa gnang ba rang nyid kyi rna rgyan gru g.yu'i pad 'dabs/ pad ril kong rna bcas phra rgyan gyi zhabs 'debs su phul ba'i bsod nams 'du byas/ skabs 'di shed du gong sa mchod yon gyi bka' gnang ba spyi bor stsal ba bzhin mchod dpon zha lu mkhan rin po che ngag dbang yon tan 'byung gnas kyi zhal slob pa sku tsha pa sangs bkra shis dang / rgyal rong tsha go rgyul po'i blon po'i bu ngag dbang gnyis nas brda sprod/pa 46

dbyangs can ma'i ri mo yongs rdzogs song ba'i rgyug len byed dgos phebs pa bzhin blangs par/ ming le'i rnam dbye'i gras nas/ bod pa'i don gyi rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig si byer bsgyur ba sob/cha/ nor 'khrul 'dug tshul gyi rgyu mtshan phul bar/ mchod dpon mkhan po rin po che rang nas kyang de ltar dgag pa mi 'thad tshul gyi sgrub byed 'ga' zhig gsung bar snang yang gzu bor gnas pa dag gis brtag pas gsal ba nyid du mchis pa 'di skor la rtsom yig chung ngu zhig kyang zur du gsal/ dus 'dir kho bo brgya bshig stong 'gug gi tshong rgyur sogs rnyed pa sgrub pa la ches cher mthu dman pa'i 'byor pa'i phul dang mi ldan pa'i phyir rin po che gser zhun sogs kyi rgyu cha ni sgrub par ma thub/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che skya chos rmad du byung ba dang / rje bdag nyid chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa bcas mdo mkhar bkra shis rab brtan du leng/sa par bsgrubs pa la rab tu gnas pa zhu ba sogs kyi ched du bdag cag nye du mchis brang dang bcas bskyod de/ bla ma dwags po dge bshes blo bzang byen pa dpal ldan smad rgyud gra tshang pa'i chog rog dang bcas pa gdan drangs nas gsung rten rnams na sung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo bskyed pa la e shes chen po'i byin ke bab pa'i lhag gnas me tog sil ma'i char dbab par mdzad cing / ra ston yon 'bul sogs kyang rgyas par bstar/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes ga)na nas don gnyer can ser skya mang tsam la thuṭa rje chen po dpal 47

mo lugs kyi dbang chen rgyas par stsal zhing / sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la bla ma nyid kyis gtso mdzad bdag cag rnams kyis bsnyung gnas rkyang khug kyang legs bar bsgrubs/ rmongs pa bdag lta bu'i blo'i 'char sgo la/ rang nyid 'chi ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i tshe dam tshig nyams chag skong ba ni shin tu gal po che 'dug de la bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du dbang bzhi rdzoṭa par zhu ba'am/ yang na rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug tshul bzhin du len pa gal che bar snang / de yang las rung gi bsnyen pa tsam tha na'ang rdzogs dgos par shes nas/ rje grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por snga sor dogs dpyod zhu lugs/ bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / zhes bsnyen pa sogs yang dag par ma byas par dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / sbyin sreg rab gnas sogs bya mi rung bar gsungs 'dug mod kyang / deng sang sngags kyi gra tshang rnams su la'ang bsnyen pa ma song bar dkyil 'khor gyi las la 'jug pa sogs mang dag 'dug pa/ des na bsnyen pa ma song bar bdag 'jug blang na/ bsnyen pa med pa'i nyes pa byung yang / dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i phan yon 'jug pa zhig e yong zhus par/ bka' las/ sangs rgyas kyis ma gsung pa'i las ka zhig khyod kyis byas pa la phan yon ga la 'ong / zhes bzhad gad dang bcas phebs byung ba yid la bzhag nas/ mdo mkhar gyi nub phyogs ri bo'i spo na rdo rje steng zhes pa'i ri khrod shin tu dben pa zhig yod pa der bla ma dwags po dge 48

bshes mchog gis gang ci'i bslab cha mdzad cing / 'khor gnyis dang bcas zla lhag gi bar du mtshams bcad kyis bsdad nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po gtso 'khor gyi las rung gi bsnyen pa/ ye shes 'beb sngags dang bcas pa legs par grub cing / mjug tu zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kyang cha tshang bar bgyis pa/ de rjes nas bdag 'jug rab gnas/ sbyin sreg sogs kyang gang spyogs nyams su len khul bgyis/ de nas lha ldan du 'byor ba'i mchod yon gyi mjal phyag sogs legs par grub cing / mchog tu dgyes pa chen po'i bka' stsal gyi bdud rtsi'ang thos 'dzin gyi bcud du bzang ngo/'di dag gi sngon lcags khyi tsam nas mtshan sgrog mkhan zur grags pa'i mtshan can la thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i rjes gnang dang / rje grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub rin po cher dbang chen/ bsnyung bar gnas pa gso sbyong gi sdom pa zhus te lo re bzhin sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga dang / cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bco lngar bsnyung gnas rkyang khug gi nyams len mang tsam bgyid pa'i skal ba thob cing / skabs shig rmi lam du/ kho bo lus gcer bur phyung / lag tu gri chung cig bzung lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun chos skor du 'gro zhing / lam du dri chu 'dor bzhin par mchis pa la/ byams pa mched bzhi'i thad du slebs skabs/de skabs jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun na gnyug mar gnas pa rgya mda' dge slong zer ba mchis pa des nged kyi rjes su bsnyegs nas sku zhabs lags lha 49

khang nang du gcer bur phebs pa dang / dri chu 'dor ba 'di 'dra dpe la srid dogs med/ de 'dra gnang dogs med zer ba dang / nge da /ba phyir slog nas/ shes sgrib spangs pa'i gcer bu ste/ ston mo ngas kyi rtsa chu 'dor ba yin/ khyod bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rna rtse la/ bdag med shes rab kyi mtshon gcig 'debs/ zhes dge slong gi rna rtsa la nge da rang gi lag gi gri chung de 'debs tshul byas pa zhig gsal bar rmis pa gnyid sad dus tshig don tshang ma sa le nges pa zhig byung ba thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis las sgrib phran bu byang ba'i rtags 'dra i yin re ba mchis so/skabs 'di dag tu gra tshang khag sogs la gzhung nas gshor lebs gnang dgos la 'bru spus gzhung gnang ji bzhin mi yong zhing / so so'i lag tu'ang mi 'bab pa dang / tshogs smon gyi khur chen dge 'dun la 'bul ba'ang bying la chag rgyag spar tshod kyi phran bu re las mi yong bar mi ser la g.yog sgrub pa po rnams nyin mtshan khor yug gi dka' tsheg nyam thag bzod dka' ba yong 'dug gshis mi dbang chen por babs rkyen gnas tshul zhib mor gsol te/ gtong sgo'i 'bru'i spus kyi tshab tu bud stong sa zhing thog nas stsal ba dang / khur dod du dngul stsal ba zhu ba po rnams re ba mi joṭa pa med cing / gzhung gnas dang mi ser la phan spebs che bar 'gyur ba'i smra ba don ldan gyi dge rtsa sgrub/ chu mo phag gi lo/ o'i rod jun gar pa'i dpon dga' ldan tshe ring nas bod ljongs su dge rtsa bskrun par mang ṭa 50

nga ske sna khya ma phyag mdzod pa/ bla ma gnyer pa/ ja'i sang gras chos nam mkha'/ sba ye pa khu lang rdo rje/ khi sna gras rab rgyas/ phur bu/ me ge chi bstan pa/ gzhan yang bla dpon khag mang po'i mi sna 'khor g.yog dang bcas ches mang ba/ de dag bskyel bar gong ma chen po'i bkas mang ṭa pa'i mi drag bee a pa khan am ban/ tsang jun chen po u khar tā/ sa shā bzhi/ ka la tā gnyis/ sbyar go chi/ sri chi'i chi/ tsong ye/ nu ye sogs ma / dang / zi ling gi dpung tshogs stobs che ba dang bcas gnas tshul sngon chug med pa glo bur du nag chu'i nye 'dabs la 'byor grub tshul byung bar gong sa mchod yon gyi bka' phebs pa bzhin kho bo dang / mda' dpon blo bzang dar rgyas bsu bar bskyod par g.yug chu'i 'gram nas bsu ba'i yo byad/ rta khal sogs gang la'ang le thog med par bsus nas lha ldan gyi gnas su sgar phab cing / de nas dga' ldan dang / bkra shis lhun por bskyod skabs phar phyir dang / phyir ldog skabs nag chu bar bcas rgya sbyong gi 'grul pa gtos che gar bskyod kyi gnas su bskyod dgos shar ba gong ma'i dpon khab rnams btsan brjid che zhing shugs drag pa dang / jun gar ba rnams kyang gyong po sog le lta bu'i sems 'chang ba'i rlang spyod dang bcas/ gcan gzan gtum po dang / ri dwaṭa mnyam du 'tshoṭa pa lta bu'i riṭa mi mthun pa/ don phra mo re la'ang rtsod pa can du byed pa sogs gang ci nas bya dka' ba'i gzhir gyur pa sha stag gis rang nyid la'ang mtho 'tshams bar cha 51

ma 'tshal snyam du sems kyang / rgya sog gi gtso 'khor stobs po che de dag thams cad dga' zhing mgu ba'i rnam 'gyur las mi rigs mi 'thus pa'i gleng riṭa ni ci yang med pa 'dzum mul bzhin par dengs/ shing pho byi ba'i lo/ mi dbang chen po 'khor bcas sga 'dra cha tshan du gsheṭa par/ mdo mkhar nas gsol ston 'bul skyes sogs kyis mnyes pa bsgrub shing / de nas bdag cag nye du gnyen mdun 'khor bcas rang gzhis su bskyod de/ sngo bzhengs rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi bka'i dgongs 'grel bstan 'gyur rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa skya chos rmad du byung ba gsar bzhengs la/ rtses dang mkhan rin po che sangs rgyas rdo rje dang / chog rog pa dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'khor rang gi gra rigs dang bcas pa spyan drangs te dpal 'jigs mdzad rdo rje lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor du rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba smin rgyas su stsal zhing / dus der char shin tu dkon pa'i skabs yin kyang char rgyun stom par byub pa sogs rten 'brel gyi mtshan ma'ang legs/ rab gnas kyi yon 'bul dang / rab gnas dga' ston gyi rim pa sogs kyang rgyas par bstan/ nged rang nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen mtshams bdun phrag gnyis pa zhig kyang nan tan du bgyis/ ngo ma rnams dang zla bo kha shas bcas nas mkhan rin po che'i drung du theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong gi sdom pa zhus te/ bsnyung bar gnas pa rkyangakhug legs pa bsrungs shing / de'i nyin mo gro shul khul yas mas nye sko—52 —

cha nga ma'i bla ma ser mo ba/ mi ser/ mdor na mu to ba yan chad skya ser gyi khrom ka shin tu che bar 'bru 'gyed gya nom pa dang bza' btung gis tshim par byas/ de nas lha ldan du lhag gnas gong sa mchod yon la mjal 'bul gyi mchod sprin dang bcas bye mjal phyag gi skal bzang thob cing bka' stsal ba nga po'i dbugs dbyung ba'ang stsal/ shing glang lo gong sa mchod yon rna ma gnyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba la thugs bskyed kyi 'jug pa mtha' gcig tu mthun pa dang / go babs dang mthun pa'i legs lam mtha' chos pa zhig byung na zad ljongs bstan 'gro'i bsod nams kyi go skal zla ma mchis pa yin mod kyang gcig tu snyigs mar spyo da pa'i dus kyi rnam 'gyur gsal bar skye 'gro'i bsod nams dman dbang dang / gnyis su na skye bo bdud kyis snying brlams pa 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde 'joms pa la bsam bzhin du smon lam gyi mthu grub pa la la dag gi byed pas dbyen bcos te mi dbang chen por yang log pa'i snyan bskyod du mas bskul ba'i rnam 'gyur la brten/ji skad du/ blo chen yin yang 'byung pos rgyud/ brlams na log pa'i lam du 'gro/ gsungs pa ltar/ drung yig tshangs skyes nas mnan pa byas tshul sogs kyi gleng gzhi'i skor nas 'phros pa'i/ gsol dpon chen mo grags pa mtha' yas la'ang gleng ba/byu/ bzos pa de skor la spo/ bo khri chen no min ham gyi drung du mi dbang mchog nas bslab ston zhu bar mngags pa gnang bar/ drung yig tshangs skyes kyi lag bris mar mnan ba'i zag rdzas len dgos gsol 53

dpon na bslabs tshul byung yang nged nas 'di la bden 'dzin byed kyin med/ 'on kyang gle pa 'di byung gshis tshangs skyes dang ngos 'dzom byed dam/ yang rang babs su 'jog pa bang 'dod byed rgyu yin/ khyod rang gong sa mchog gi zhabs 3debs sgrub mi ba/tso bo yin gshis nged nas log mtheng — byed don med ces rgyu mtshan lobs gsung ba lta ra khri chen de nyid kyi drung du mol bar/ gso la dpon chen mos zhu rigs/ dpon po nas rang ngos la snga phyir thugs rjes gzigs bzhin pa'i mu yin/ de 'dra byed pa'i don ci yod/mdor na yid la bsam pa lta zhog rmi lam du'ang rmis pa med/ 'on kyang ngos sbyor skor bka' gnang zhu chog kyang / btson dong nang gi mi dang lab gleng byed rgyu mi 'dug dpon po dgongs pa rwangs phyin de kas chog ces zhus song ba bcas 'khrun chod pa de bzhin la/ de'i sang nyin gong sa mchog nas kho bo 'bod du gtong ba gnang byung ba bzhin sku ma dun du bcar bar bka' la pa //kha sang mi dbang gis khyod btang nas graṭa pa mtha' yas la dri ba byas pa de nged nas go byung / de skor grags pa mtha' yas la don sed du gzugs med gzuṭa bcos kyi rgyu mtshan byas pa las/ don du snya/da snyed rgyu 'di tsho thams cad nga ma 'dod pas byas pa los yin/ des na nged ni khang rwa 'i sbub/ tu dpe cha 'dra bltas nas nyam chung gi sdod pa las gzhan ma'i bya byeb rnam 'gyur gang yang mad/ 'dis kyang ma 'thus na 'bras spungs sam ri khrod gang rigs la phyin pas chog de ga'i rgyu mtshan mi/ dbang la lobs phebs byung / de la 54

phra1 bus phyag gsum btsal/ gdung shugs chen pos da lam 'di sko ra sogs —gzhung rang gi sku chags bdo ba 'byung po'i 'phrul stobs kyis yong babs gya nyes zhig yin 'dug deng sang than ltas ngaca pa'i rigs kyang mang tsam 'dug pas 'byung po'i 'phru' stobs cir 'gyur mi shes pas thugs stobs rgya cher bskyed de 'jam chaṭa su 'gyur ba/ bstan 'gro spyi yi bde thabs la dgongs pa ci nas mkha thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhes gsol 'debs nan cher zhus / mi dbang mchog la'ang gong rnga mchog nas bka' ji ltar phebs don rnams chad lha4/ bla/da par snya na dbang du gang 'je bas zhus par phyir phebs la/sngon cha/'i rgyu ma tshan rnams ni chos dbyings kyi chod nga ltar yin 'dug da sgos thad ni/ gangs ri ra bas bskor ba'i zhing khams 'dir/phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/spyan ras gzigs dbang bskal bzang chu mtsho yi/zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cigacer/ pa'i don dgongs dbyings su 'jags pa dang / bod 'bangs bstan 'gro'i phan bder dgo ngas pa bka' drin che ba las legs su snyan rdo/legs la cha rdo~Xbye~X//༷pa'i //thar zaX cing bzang ba lhu ra ༷༵༷༷ rdo55

pa'i bkra shis lugs legs kyi dge mtshan gzhal du med par gyur to/me yos gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston sogs grub tsam nas mi dbang chen po'i sku 'jing la gnyan 'bur gyi bsnan drag pos zin ste thabs bcos sku rim sogs ji snyed mdzad kyang gang gis kyang ma bzlog par zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la gzim khri mtha' can du gyur/ dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad shul na lus shing / mdor na/ zas gos gnas mal sogs kyis bde bar bskyangs pa'i sku lus kyang gcer bur bzhag ste/ rnam par shes pa gcig pu gnyis su sed pa 'jig rten pha rol du gshegs pa ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shi dza ga ta mi tra ya na)'i gsung las/lha gcig ji ltar khyod 'byor yang /gshegs nas 'jig rten gzhan bzhud tshe/mya ngam thang la dgras bcoms ltar/gcig pu sras sked btsun mo min/na bza' ma mchis bshes ma mchis/rgyal srid ma mchis khab ma mchis/dpag med mthu dpung mnga' lags kyang /gzigs myu ma mchis gsan ma mchis/56

gcig tsam nyid gcig phyi thag gi/rjes su 'brang ba mi mnga'o/mdor na nyid kyi mtshan tsam yang /de tshe med na gzhan ci smos/zhes gsung pa ji lta bzhin mngon du gyur pa ma thong nas yid la zad mi shes pa'i gdung bas mnar zhing / 'khor ba'i bya ba la snyi pa po med par stogs pa dang / de'i nyin mo dbang 'dus khang gsar gyi khang 'gram du mu to ba tshe 'phos ma thag pa zhig kyang mthong ba/ gsung rab rnams su shi ba'i nang par 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po shi 'phos pa dang / mu to ba tshe 'phos pa gnyis khyad par ci yang med ces gsungs pa 'di lta bu'o snyam du nges shes skyes/ mi dbang mchog gi dgongs rdzogs rgya cher sgrubs pa'i zhabs 'debs bsgrub shing / phyis su bod ljongs kyi dpon po mi drag sogs che rgu rnams khrims 'og tu btsan thabs su gshegs rkyen ngan pa kho ‘ las/bsnyun gzhis thebs nas sman rim sogs kyis 'tsho skyong dang / mthar dge sgrub sogs kyang ji bzhin yod pa su la'ang byung ma song zhing / mi dbang 'di nyid gzim mal du ba nge bar sku tshe'i 'du byed btang zhing / rnam dkar dgongs rdzogs kyang rgya cher sgrub tu yod pa rnam smin da kar po 'dzag pa'i las 'bras kyi bde ba ngo mtshar ba zhig go/ lhar bca sa skye rgu'i rnam 'dren rgyal dbang thams cad rma khyen gzigs chen po'ang dga' ldan khang ba/sar du 57

zhabs sor gyi pa1 bkod de ljags bsngo/ thugs smon/ skyabs :na jug gi gsu ngas don sogs kyang rgyas par stsal zhing / 'brel tshad ngon lngan gyi bka' drin bla na me pa stsal ste/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che thugs rgyud 'byongs pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba mngon du mdzad/ de nas mi ring bar gnam gyi lha gong ma bdag po chen pos tā las bā dur la wang pho lha nas kyi las shul byed dgos dang / wang gi ma lo tham ga soṭa stsal te bod 'bangs kyi las don byed ngo ra lung gis bsngags par mang dga' ston gyi cho ga nyin ga mang po thel nas gnod sbyin rtag stsos kyi khengs pa'ang thung ngur bsnyil/ yang o'i rod jun gar gyi dpon tshe dbang rdo rje rnam rgyal nas/ dga' ldan tshe ring gi dge rtsa sgrub pa sogs 'a ched du ma ngags pa'i mi sna gsol dpon bla ma/ bla ma dbu ma dzad/ dkon gnyer bla ma/ gsol dpon bla ma gzhon pa/ ja'i srang gras/ sba yes gu lang /me ge chi sna mdo/ sa yā gras/ rab rgyas phur bu bu ring / kho yag chi bcas dang / gzhan yang bla dpon khag gi mi sna g.yog rigs dang bcas ches mang ba gong ma chen po'i bkas mngags pa'i mi drag yu a pa han am ban/ tsong zan/ khi yā/ sbyar go chi/ spi chi'i che/ ma / zi ling gi dmag mi dang bcas gtos che ba 'byor rgyu'i gnas tshul byung bar brten/no yo7 gung pa/ ta dang / kho bo bsu bar bskyod dgos kyi bka' phebs pa bzhin bskyo da par nag chur zla lhag gi bar du sgug dgos shar zhing / de 58

nas 'byor ma thag rgya sog gi dpon khag rnams la zur gsos spyod rgyu/rta rnga bong gi sprod len gro chas dos khal gyi gra bsgrigs sogs gang la'ang le thogs kyi gleng bzhag med par bsus te lha ldan gyi gnas su rdol/ sa pho 'brug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du rgya spyong gi dpon khag byings bcas bkra shis lhun por bskyod pa dang mnyam thon bgyis par lam bar du jun gar pa'i mi la 'brum nad thebs pa bcas nyen dogs shin tu che yang gzhan 'ched med pa bcas nyes skyon du ma gyur cing paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i mjal phyag dod rdzogs su thob pa bcas don rnams legs par grub nas phyir ldog slar yang rgya spyong rnams lha sa nas phyir sdog skabs nag chu'i bar du skyel mar dong ba bcas la/ stobs po che dbang phyug btsan po/ phan tshun gcig la gcig mi mthun pa'i mig gis blta zhing rtsub mo'i tshig sbyor gyis snying la mar ma'i cho ga sgrub pa rnams kyi bar du bya dka'/byed gtad kyi rnam pa ci yang 'ong rigs su mchis kyang / de rigs mad par bde 'jags 'khon rtsod bral bar dga' bzhin spro bzhin rang rang gi gnas su bskyod pa'i zhabs 'degs tshul bzhin bsgru bas/ nged cag phyir sdog skabs wang tā la'i bā dur dga' 'dra chab tshan dang de nas gtsang du phebs rgyu'i zham ring du bcar dgos phebs don ltar zhabs rtsar bcar/'di tsam nas bzung ste/ ji skad du sdig spyod rgyal po bskos pa da / nga pa'i yang thog grum pa dang / ri rtse shin tu zhig pa yi/ 'dabs na 59

gnas rnams rtag tu 'jigs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ wang gi mdzad spyod mtha' dag rang dbang gis ma yin par 'byung pos rgyud brlams pa'i rang rtaṭa kyis rnal du mi gnas par khro zhing gtum pa/ gzu lum can/ rang bzhin gyis zhe sdong ba chu srin lta bu/ bya ba gang yang brtag pa dang bcas pas mi zin pa/ 'brel med byung rgyal du spyod pa/ skye bo srog 'phrog pa la ni shig bkum pa tsam du'ang ji mi snyam pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur la brten mthong tshad gsod dang / thos tshad skrag pa'i dpe bzhin tshang ma 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bar byed pa la/ bdag cag kyang rang nyid kyis nyes par spyad pa'i nong 'a spyod dang 'grogs pa med kyang / rang bzhin gyis bag khums shing ya nga bzhin pa zhabs rjes su 'brang mod kyang / drang po yin lugs su spyod pa'i snang tshul sogs legs par gsol ba la ni bzhin gyi /dngas mi gsal par 'khon du 'dzin spyod drag pos bsdigs/ ngan pa bzang por smra ba'i rdzun gtam dang / g.yo rgyus bslad pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba 'jam zhing snyan pa bag phebs par smra ba la ni 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyungs te/ bzhad gad dang bcas dga' bar byed/ rtse bar byed pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal ba de'i tshe/ bdag cag ni dgun gyi khu byug bzhin du smra ba med par gnas pas kyang mi 'thus par sgo du ma nas rnam pa du ma sa nye bar 'tshe ba bar ma chad du mchis ste/ skabs zhig dga' ldan khang 4/sar gyi gzem chung 'gag tu ro yon pa/ ta dang / kho bo gnyis bos nas/ mgron blo bzang bkra shis dang / dpal 60
