shag brgyud wang gi bslab ston la/ bla ma byams pa dang / bu mo/gung / zhabs drung bcas nas mnga' ris gung la dmag khyog shog byas 'dug ces tā bzhin rnams nas nged la gsung byung / khyod tsho'i byed babs de ji ltar yin gyi gsal thong phebs par/ zhu lan du/ rang ngos nas drag gzhan su 'dra'i thad du'ang dkrug shing dang / byed ngan bsam sbyor logs pa'i rigs rmi lam du'ang byas pa med/ 'on kyang so so'i las dbang myong bya ma nyes kha g.yog lta bu yin na ni phran rang na tshod 'di tsam la sleb pa da lta bar ni spyon dbang med tsam byung / da ni ban sku tshe ring na lo gsum/rkyen glo bur byung na zhag gsum gyi dpe ltar yin 'dug pas/ ji lta—ra gnang yang 'gyod pa med pas dgongs pa gang dpyad las zhu rgyu med ces zhus/ lo 'di'i mjug dang / sa mo sbrul dang / lcags pho rta'i lo la byang phyogs kyi yul spyongs su ri dwags nyes med bag yangs su rgyu ba rnams la go 'ded du dbus gtsang gi dmag dpung bskul ba lta bu'i stobs po che dang bcas ste gshegs/ 'brong / rkyang / dgo ba/ gtsod la sogs pa dang /mdor na sa'i steng du rgyu ba byi'u tshogs chen po'ang nam mkhar 'phur mi shes par rdog 'og du 'gro ba bcas grangs kyis mi chod pa srog dang phral bas sa gzhi khrug gis chag chag tu btab pa/ ri dwags kyi sha dang / pags pa la sogs pa 'chal mar gdal ba gshin rje tshal lta bu tshe thung 'gyur gyi las tshabs po che 'di dag mthong tshe thog snar nyam nga ba snying rje ba'i bsam pha — —6

bzod glags dang bral ba sto bu skyes kyang / rim pas blo dred pa na snyi2 rja'i sems lta ci smos/ dpon gyi tsha shugs ma bzod pas ri dwags sogs bzung na dga' ba dang / gsod na dga' ba'i blo 'di kho na skyo bar snang ba/ 'khor ba na rtag tu ngan goms chen po'i shugs 'di bzlog par dka' ba zhig go/lcags rta lo gtsang du chibs bsgyur gyi rin chen rtser bzhugs skabs/yang kho bo gzims chung 'gag tu bos nas/ dza sag tha'i ji/ dbus mda' dpon la mo chos rje gsum dbang por bzhag srang sbug dang /dpal shag gis bka' bsgyur ba/ sku mched gnyis 'khrugs rkyen yong ba 'di bla ma byams pa/ gung pa/ ta/ bu mo zhabs drung bcas khyod tshos mnga' ris gung la yi ge btang tshul tshe ring gi lag bris ma 'di bzhin byung / 'di skor ngos len byed dam/ kho pa dang ngos gtugs gang byed gsal thong / gsung bar/ phran gyis pha mes rigs brgyud nas bla dpon yab sras/ sgu mched sogs su 'dra'i rigs la'ang dkrugs shing phra ma bcug pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med/ phran rang yang deng sang drung 'khor gyi gras su rgan 'go/ bsam pa mi chung tsam kun gyis tshad mar mi 'dzin 74 med/'di lta bu'i dkrug shing gi yi ge btang zer na tshe ring ngo thog ra shā dang ra sprad chog pa dgos zhes yus mthar gyis zhus par bka' lan du/ chi ring la glang chen smyon pa byin tshar ba'i ngos gtugs mi yong ba 'dug de rigs ma 62

rgyas nges khungs rdol med na de gas 'thus tshul byung ba/ don du tshe ring gi lag bris zer ba bcos ma las don gnas ci la bden yang bya ba lam du mi gtong ba'i skabs tshol kho na nges/ go 'ded rjes ma 'di'i skabs le thog ci yang med rung ri dwags bsrung ma thub par bsnyad nas wang gi kho bo ma dmigs phug ste phyag mda' 'phangs pa thog ma de rta'i mjings pa la phog nas khrug mang du zag de rjes lan gcig 'phangs pa g.yogs phun tshogs don grub can na tshod phra zhing rtsal lag dang ldan pa zhig nged kyi mdun du yod pa de'i stod la phog ste de ma khad rta las lhung ste tshe 'phos des thugs tshims pa lta bu'i rang nyid la nyes skyon du ma gyur tsam byung ste/ de'i nyin mo mtshon srung soṭa yong res rje grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub zhabs kyi sku 'gag zhig mchis pa spyon pa'i 'og tu gon nas yod pa de'i cha/thus mtshan g.yol thub pa yin nam snyam zhing / phyi dro bzhugs ra du phebs nas wang gis phran g.yog phun tshogs don 'grub 'das pa'i dge thebs yin ces dngul rdo tshad gsum skyel mi gnang byung ba dgra gnyen brtag mi thub pa'i rnam ra ya mtshan snyam par shar/ de nas sgo ṭa ming dkar stag rtse bcas brgyud de lha ldan du yud tsam phebs rjes/ re shig stag rtser stam chags/ de skabs phran bu dang / mgron gnyer tshe dbang gnyis ching wang gi sras mo bsam 'grub sgol ma'i phebs bsu la nag chu bar bskyod dgos kyi bka' bsgyur zhing / stag rtser phebs rgyu'i snga zhog dga' ldan khang gas ra gyi rdo gdul 63

du thon phyag zhu bar bcar ba yin kyaja / phebs bsu'i bya byed sogs tshig gcig kyang ba /'a stsal ma byung zhing spyan tsam ya4 ma gzigs rung / de'i phyi nyin rang thon nas nag chur zla lhag gi bar du bsdad kyang phran gnyis sdod sar rgyu 'grul bkag nas dkan— mo nam 'byor gyi gtam cha ni ma go/ mdor na nag chu 'go pa rta ro kha so gas dang yang 'phrad len tsam byas mi chog pa'i bsdam rar brten bza' btung gi yo byad kyang sgrub par dka' bzhin du re shig 'di bya'i rnam gzhag 'khyog la nye bar brten bye gnas pa las/ mgron gnyer pad tshal tshe bdag gi gsung rig wang 'dis las 'bras thams cad khyad du gsod/ rang snang gang shar gyi bya ba byas tshad lam du 'gro/ gzhan mas bsam bzang drang tshugs bzung yang bsam pa thog tu mi khel ba 'di 'dra'i babs la brtag na las rgyu 'bras zer ba 'di bden kyin med pa 'dra gsung / de'i lan du kho bos/ las 'bras mi bden pa ci la srid/sgogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' tshad ma mi bslu ba yin mod/ yin kyang myur bul gyi dbang gis skye ba brgyud nas myong dgos pa'i las dang / che stod la bsags pa'i las kyi 'bras 6 tshi smad la myong ba mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi las dang bcas sna tshogs yod gshis las byas shing bsags pa'i 'bras bu 'chol ba med pa myong dgos pa la the tshom ci yod ces glengs/ 'on kyang 'di skabs kyi babs yul gang la brtag na'ang mthar srog 'phrog pa zhig las ma 'das par bsam zhing / de'i tshe dam tshig nyam chag skong ba la 64

rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang lngan par dbang zhu yul ni ma rnyed/ des na rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug tshul bzhin du len par gnad che bar shes nas/lha— ldan nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bdag 'jug blang ba'i yo byad/ dkyil thang / bum pa/ mchod rdzas/ dbang rdzas la soṭa pa ched du blangs te/ bdag 'jug spyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba bgyis shing /nag chu sdod ring kha ton kyang 'phel bar yod thog dpon mo bsam 'grub sgol ma 'phral du 'byor ba yod tshul gyi dza sag tha'i ji dbang 'dus/ dbus mda' dpon dar rgyas bkra shis/ gzims dpon phur pa dpon g.yog gtos che bas drab/ shul dang bcas ste nged gnyis kyi gur sa'i nye 'dabs su byung ba/der gur phub cing stan bsham sa par gung gral du dza sag can gsum dang /zur gral du nged dang mgron gnyer pad tshal ba bcas 'khod de sde len gyi rnam pa gang 'byor bstab/ sdod babs kyi skor da lam gyi 'di kho na lta ra byed dgos wang gi bslab ston nang bcar yod 'dug pa de ga ji bzhin gyi bkod bshams stabs 'grigs su gyur/ de nas dza sag can gsum nag chur phar rir sgar bab song zhing / bdag cag zung la ni 'di bya 'di gyis gang yang ma byung rung sang nyin tsam byings sdebs su zla bsgril byed pa las 'os med 'dra snyam dem nur gyis mgrin pa 'khyo ṭa la 'phyang bzhin par gnas pa las/de'i nub mo'i thun tha ma tho rengs kyi tshod tsam du lha sa nas ri / brgyud kyi yi ge snga phyi gnyis lam bar nas zla 'gril gyi phran sar 'byor byung ba'i don 65

la/ dga' ldan khang gsar gyi mdzod pas bskur ba'i yi ge mi rje chen por rgya nas bsam ngan mi srid pu byas byung bas khyod rang dpung bcas 'phral du yongs lugs gyis/ zhes pa dang / wang gi phyag tham 'byar bar rgya nas bsam ngan rlabs po che byas byung gshis khyod rang rnams der sdod ma dgos pas sog bod kyi dpung bcas 'phral du phyir ldog dgos dzwal 'dug pa/ de 'phral mgron gnyer pad tshal nas bos te 'phros mol byas par/ wang gi tham ga gnang ba 'di brdzus ma yin 'dug da sto bzo lta shor tshar ba red ces khong 'dzum shor ba'i gleng 'phros kha nas grub rjes nag chur phar rir mda' dpon dza sag sogs kyi sar bskyod/ der gong gi gnas tshul rnams mol ba skya thag dang sngo dri'i dpe bzhin tshang ma re dogs kyi rgyu mtshan mang du gleng yang / yang tig 'phral du phyir ldog la thag bcad nas tshes bco lnga snga char nag chu nas thon rjes gong sa mchog nas bka' tham phebs par/ wang shā la'i bā dur rgya nas med pa bzos/ wang gi g.yog rigs nas ta bzhin sogs la gnod tshe brtsam tshul sogs zhib par phebs pa the tshom gyi sgos pa chod/ de nas zhag bzhi'i thog 'byor ba po ta lar shar rgyag mjal khar phyin pas/ no yon pa rte ta la tā bzhin zhing gshegs gnyis nas gong mo'i phyag mda' stsal te bod kyi 'go chings gnang dgos byung 'dug don bzhin gzims chung nyi 'od 'khyil bar kun mkhyen rgyal dbang mchog gi sku mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba dang / no 66

yon pa1 ta lhan du bzhugs thog mjal phyag zhus/ gang ci'i bka' stsal zhib mol phebs pa la/ lan 'bul zhus shing / bod 'bangs spyos glaṭa ma rnyed pa'i 'byung po mthu bo che de/ da lam gong ma'i thugs rjes tā bzhin gnyis nas snying stobs chen pos bsgral ba gtsag bu rnag thog tu khel yang /skye bo gzu lum can du mas tā bzhin gnyis ma rung bar byas pa ni gnyis phung bdag brlag gi spyod pa thal che tshul sogs zhus par/ de ka byung song sogs bka' stsal bag phebs pa'i bdud rtsi'i zil mngar snying ga'i bcud du smin/ 'di skabs no yon pa / ta po ta lar bzhugs mus yin 'dug kyang /zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer gcig nyin dga' ldan khang gsar du phebs gong sa mchog nas stsal ba'i tham ga dang bcas lugs gnyis bka' lung btsan po'i khur bzhes te nyes can rnams 'dzin bzung gi bka' khyab sogs shugs drag mdzad pas tshang ma 'dzin bzung thub pas khri mun tu bcug go/de nas mi ring bar gong ma bdag po chen po'i bka'i lung gis mang ṭa pa'i mi drag ban a li khan am ban 'byor te nyes can blo bzang bkra shis kyis mtshon pa drag zhan mang po'i tshogs la 'dri rtsad zhib mor dpyad de nyes pa thog tu babs pa rnam‘ khrims lugs sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas lcang lo can gyi sgo rar bka' khrims kyis tshar bcad/ de nas tsong thu tshe gung ye/rnam rgyal a ban jo'u am ban can kyang rim par 'byor/ 'di skabs kho bo bro 'tshal bas las don gyi zhabs phyir bcar ma thub par shag tu 'phrod (7

bsten du bsdad skabs yin par/ mjug nad gzhi las grol mtshams su am ban rnams nas 'bod mi byung ba bzhin bsam 'grub pho brang du bcar/der gong gsal dpon po rnams tshang ma 'dzoms 'dug thog ban am ban nas sog skad mdzad de gsung rigs/ khyod snga sor nas gong ma chen po'i thuṭa rjes bskyangs te bka' blon gyi go sar bzhag pa yin/ wang pho lha ba'i dus dang / 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi rwas gang la'ang bya ba ngan pa ma byas shing bsam pa drang por bzung 'dug da dung yang bod kyi bka' blon las khur byed dgos yod gong ma'i bka' las mi 'gal ba'i hur thag thong / mi rabs kyi bar du thugs rjes 'tsho ba yong / zhes gsung byung bar/ nged nas de 'a/na zhu rigs/ phran bu sa 'og gi 'bu srin phra mo lta bus gong ma bdab po chen po'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba skra rtse tsam yang med par sngar yang bka' blon gyi go sar 'jog pa gnang ba'i bka' drin bas/ma gyis mi khyab/da sgos kyang nga rang gi shes yong gang nas kyang zhabs 'de ṭa 'grub pa'i mkhos shog thon snyam pa mi 'dug 'on kyang gong ma chen po'i bka' blon spyi gnar dang / dza sag tha'i ji cho lo gnang ba 'di kho 4'i thugs rje'i gze byim ma bzod pa ma gtogs/ wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal nas da tshod tshar bcang tshar brnga / da ni gong ma chen po'i bka' gang phebs kyi rjes su 'breng nas gso la ba btab te rang gi shes nus kyi gang spyogs zhabs 'deb/sa sgru ba chog pa zhu zhes zhus par tshang mas dgyes nyams che ba mdzad/ de rjes gong sa lnga 68 — —

mi'i rnam 'dren mchog nas kyang mgron gnyer sho long dar han phran gyi thad byi gtong ba gnang nas bka ༄ bsgyur ba/ bod kyi las don byed pa bka' blon gcig gnyis kyis byas nga sa gra 'grigs pa zhig mi yong 'dug da sgos gzhan yang bkod dgos /sa/—ban tshos kyang lab byung / khyod rang pha mes nas gzhung sar gus zhabs che ba dang / zhabs drung rang nas kyang snga phyir byed spyod mi 'tshams pa'i glengs rigs med cing / shes yong / lhag bsam ba/nga nas kyang babs 'brel bcas bka' blon gyi las khur sngar bzhin byed dgos phebs par/ zhu len du/ phran la bong ba gser gzigs kyi bka' bzang po phebs pa che rabs thams cad du bka' drin 'khor mtha' bral yang /rang blo rang la skog tu ma gyur gshis bka' blon tsam gyi zhabs 'degs 'grub pa'i blo nus mkhos shog ni ci yang ma mchis/ 'on kyang phran bye pha mes nas bzung ste gzhung gi thugs rje kho nas 'tsho ba dang / skyabs mgon chen po 'di phyi gnas skabs thams cad kyi ma gon skyabs dpung gnyen zhu yul yin gshis bka' gang phebs mngon bstod las gyen ldog zhu ma nus pas zhabs 'degs lhag bsam rnam dag sgrub chog pa dang / de ltar gegs med 'grub pa'i thugs dam skyabs 'jug gi rim pa'ang 'di phyi gnas skabs thams cad du 'dor ba sked pa mkhyen zhes gsol ba btab/ de rjes se 'bras dge gsum gyi bla ma las ste rnams dang / gung / bka' blon/mda' dpon/ dza sag drung 'khor las tshan pa che phra tshang ma bsam 'grub 69

khang gsar gyi tshom chen du bsdus gong ma'i lung gis mngags pa'i mi drag tsong thu tshe gung ye nas sogs dpon khag thams cad 'dzom thog bod ljongs kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bgyi ba'i tshul don tshan bcu gsum du bsdus pa'i rtsa tshig dang / de'i don re re bzhin du tsong thu tshe gung ye nas rgyas bshad dang bcas legs par 'doms pa'i mthar de ltar bsgo ba ni khyod rang bod 'bangs kyi don kho na yin/ de ma yin pa'i bya ba bshad lugs gzhan zer rgyu e yod gsung bar gong ma bdag po chen po rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos dang dbyer med pa'i dbo/ngas par tā la'i bla ma'i chos srid yar rgyas dang / bod 'bangs nyam thag pa 'di rnams nyes kyi rwags pa dang / sdug bsngal gyis gzer gyi rwags nas gnas/ skabs thams cad du bde ba la sbyor ba nye ring phyogs lhung med par skyong ba'i dgongs pa kho na mnga' gshis/ da lam kyang khyed dpon khag rnams nged bod 'bangs rang gi ched du phebs/ bod kyi byed sgo skor yang bar skabs kyi srol ngan pa rnams dor/ srol bzang babs 'brel dang mthun pa rnams yar rgyas su gnang rgyu'i rtsa tshig dang bka' phebs par/ bka' drin che zhes phyag 'bul ba las gzhan ma'i rgyu mtshan zhu rgyu med ces zhus/de nas lcaṭa lug hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin phran bu bka' blon bzhi gzims chung nyi 'od 'khyil par khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po lhun 70

po la nyin mor byed pas mdzes pa lta bu/ brjid chags shing gzi byin gyi snang ba rgyas pa'i drung du nye bar 'khod pa la so so la bzang zhing gya nom pa'i gnang sbyin stsal ste bka' phebs par/ khyod rnams kyis bstan srid lar rgya gang cir lhag bsam rma med pa'i sgo nas yin lugs drang por srong ba dang /mnga' 'bangs rnams 'os min khrul khrims kyis gtser ba med par bde bar ma bas su phebs pa'i thabs tshul la 'bad dgos shing / khyod tshor bka' blon gyi las khur bkod pa ni don du srid skyong gi gnas dang khyad sed pas chos srid thams cad kyi zhabs 'de ṭa hur bskyed gtong dgos soṭa bka' blon don gyi snying po can mthar phyin pa stsal ba/ zhu lan du/ phran rnams nas zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba'i blo gros nus stobs gang yang ma mchis rung / rje bla ma mchog la gsol ba btab te bya gzhag gang ci dgongs pa dang mthun pa ga yong ba blo nus kyis ji ltar spobs pa lhag bsam rnam dag zol med du zhus shing / de ltar ma yin na gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can rnams kyis bka' chad drag pos tshar gcod par gdon mi za zhing /skyabs mgon chen po nyid nas kyang bdag cag gi zhabs 'de ṭa sgrub pa byas pa don ldan du 'gyur ba'i skyabs 'jug dus nam yang gam la ba med pa thuṭa rjes gziṭa dgos zhes phyag dang bcas gsol ba btab/ bka' shag gi drung yig tu gzhis rtse bkras mthong ba/ lha sa tsha chul ba/ mal dro khron rgyab pa/mgron gnyer mnyes thang bde skyid gling pa soṭa bsko bzhag gnang / de nas shā—

bzung te nged rang gtso bo rnams kyis mi shes ma rig pa'i sgo nas bsam pa lhad med kyang sbyor bar skyon chags pa'i rigs yod na ni smos ci 'tshal/gzhan ma tshang ma blo gros gcig tu mthun pa'i sgo nas zhabs 'de ṭa sgrub thos gang ci bgrol thog nas thag bcad gong ma chen po'i bkas mngags pa'i mi drag lha sar bya ba tshang ma'i dbye 'byed du gzhug pa dang gong ma skyabs mgon chen por rim bzhin snyan 'debs zhu dgos rnams sku bcad rgya'i skabs kyang ljags thun seng bar du zhus chog gi yod pa legs par zhus te/lhag bsam drang po'i sgo nas rang gi blo gros kyi mthu ji yod dang / rtsal ji yod pa'i dpung bskyed de gong sa lha mi'i 'dren pa chen pos bstan 'gro phan bde spel ba kho na la dgongs pa gcig tu gzhol ba'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa sgrub rgyu 6da pa ni skye ba don yod pa/ rnyed pa la legs par rnyed pa'o snyam du dga' zhing gus pa'i bsam pas zhabs 'degs kyi rim pa zol med par bsgrubs/ de nas mi ring bar phran bu sger nas srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gziṭa chen po gzims chung bka' gdams 'khyil par spyan drangs te/ rnam par rgyal ba'i gra tshang gi 'dus pa'i tshogs nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe chog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs kyi cho ga spyor dngos rjes gsum smin rgyas su stsal ba'i rdo rje slob dpon pa 'di thog mar bsko bzhag gnang ba'i nyin dang 'grigs pa byung zhing dngos 'byor gyi 'bul dngos kyang / ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i snang brnyan rgya gar shar phyoṭa li 7ཿ

dkar rtsod med khri rgyab dang bcas pa lta bas chog mi shes pa/ dpal kye rdo rje lha dgu'i snang brnyan spungs sku rgya gar shar li bzo bkod phun sum tshogs pa/ rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing chos rgyal dge dbang yab sras kyi legs bshad rong ston chen po smra ba'i seng ge'i phyag dpe la ma phyi bgyis te ri mo gnyis pa'i lam du byas pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa tsong kha pa'i phyag dpe spang ston chen po blo gros brtan pa dang / so ston 'jiṭa med graṭa pas mchan bu btab pa 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling na bzhuṭa pa la phyi mo bgyis te paṇa chen bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag dpe las bshus pa/ zhwa dmar drug pa'i phyag dpe phyis rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyis rgya mchan gyis gsal bar byas pa'i glegs bam/ bdag cag gi ston pa rgyal ba zas gtsang sras po'i skyes rabs 'dul ba lung / mdo mang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin phyogs gcig tu bsdus par mdzad pa lnga brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi grangs can pu sti ka gnyis/ bka' gdams gdung rten lcags rtse ma/rnal 'byor rol ba'i dga' ston nas ji ltar gsung ba bzhin rgyu mchog gi gras ston dmar po las grub pa'i cang te'u phra rgyan can rked bsdams kyi thang lhod las skad phra sbom du 'gyur ba/ rdor dril 'phags pa'i sgam nang ma/spyin sreg dngos grub rgya mtshor rgya gzhung gi khungs dang bcas gsungs pa ltar gyi cha tshad dang ldan pa'i dgang blugs gser dngul gyi tshag ldan/ zhi 73

rgyas dbang drag gi mtshan ma dngul 'phul las grub pa/ sgod sgam dang bcas pa cha tshang / gzhung gi bris dpe chen mo'i gras nas 'khyar ba kho bo'i sug par son pa rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten tshang ma cha tshad kyi lam nas drangs te ri mor gtan la phab pa'i deb gzhi mig gi bdud rtsir mnga' ba/gzhan yang na bza' skor cha tshang / sku'i nyer dpyad cha tshang / gser dngul sogs bdog pa'i dngos po dang bcas spyan sngar bstar zhing / tshe chog gi ma/la 'bul mtshams su kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon chen por zhabs pad brtan dgos tshul/ bar skabs su gzhung gi bstan srid 'di yang sdig to can gyi byed pa'i tshul bzhin ma yin pa dkruṭa te nyams chag che yang nye lam gong ma chen pos bka' lung btsan pos mgon po nyid bod 'bangs chos srid kyi bdag por dbang bskur ba bzhin bdag sogs bstan 'gro'i thugs rje'i skyabs rol nas zhar yang mi 'dor ba dgos tshul sogs rang blos gang spob zhib rgyas su gsol ba btab pa bka' bzhes bzang po gser gyi cod pan gtsug gi rgyan du bcing / skabs de dang nye bar don gnyer can gyi mkhan sprul/ bla chen sogs mang dag dang lhan cig tu kho bos kyang gsol ba btab pa bzhin po ta la'i tshom chen rnying par skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gziṭa ston pa rdo rje 'chang 'khor lo chen po'i skur bzhengs nas/ gdug pa can rnams mtha' dag btul te rtsa rgyud drag po gsum 'dul gsungs pa'i rgyud de las ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas phyung zhing /74

dpal sha ba'i dbang phyug la bka' babs pa rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i yi dam gyi lha mchog bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa sta gon dang bcas pa smin rgyas su stsal ba'i thar 'dod rnams la re ba yid bzhin du 'jo ba'i bka' drin gzhal du med par gyur to/chu pho spe'u'i lo paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po dbus phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba/ phebs bsur gnam bzhugs zhag gi sa'i bar phran rnams ngos kyis bskyod pa ra sku'i dkyil 'khor mthong na mi mthun pa med pa mig gi bdud rtsir thob/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden tshig rna ba'i bcud len du gyur cing mjal phya ga skal bzang gi dga' ston myang nas phyir ldog de'i sang nyin kyang ser 'bras kyi bla sprul/ drung 'khor che 'bring chung gsum/ 'a zhu ru/ kha bal/ lha sa ba'i gnas chen po sogs kyis chibs su dang / rnga brdung / dar phyar/ ser sbring / bro gzhas sogs kyi bkod pa tshar du dngar ba bcas pho brang chen po po ta lar rgyal ba yab sras gdan mngon par 'dzom ste tshom chen rnying par phebs ston gyi rim pa rgya cher bstar ba'i dge mtshan nyams su myong / de nas mi ring ba'i char— paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen pos gsol 'debs shugs drag tu gnang ba bzhin dbang / rjes gnang / khrid lung sogs rgya cher stsal ba nge skabs bka' rgya dam pas chos zhu ba nyung shas las ma tshud 'dug rung /kho bos kyang don gnyer gyi gsol ba nan tan du btab pa ltar/ dpal dus 75

kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su jogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon la brten pa rgyas pa nyin gsum gyi ri5 la byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang / mchog dbang gong ma gsum/ gong chen gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang mtha' brten dang bcas pa mtha' dag rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i 'grel chen dri med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs pa rgya bod kyi mkhas pa jems kyi sa bkral ba'i srol mang du mchis pa las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rang nyid kyis chos rgyal zla ba bzang po star bsngags brjod kyi dbyangs su sdir ba/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa nyid gang gi sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub chen po smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang pos rgyud kyi 'grel chen dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga cha lag dang bcas pas legs par gtan la phab pa bzhin zab rgyas su stsal bas dbang don brda 'phrod pa tsam du ma zad phyi nang gzhan gsum kyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnad 'gag mtha' dag la ma rtog log rtog gi the tshom dri ma mtha' dag bsal te dpyod ldan mkhas pa rnams la'ang rgyud don mtha' chod pa'i go don bla na med pa stsal zhing / tshe dpag med lha dgu thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi bka' dbang bcas kyang thob pa 'di dag gi nyams len skal bas phongs kyang / dbang don khyad par can gyis ljaṭa bshad thos 'dzin gyi bcud du longs spyod rgyu yod pa'ang bsod nams kyi phung po gzhal bya'i yul las 'das par gyur/ de nas rang nyid kyis srid zhi'i gtsug 76

rgyan rgyal dbang yab sras so sor zab rgyas bka' chos kyi bdud rtsi legs par gsan bzhes grub pa'i legs 'bul dang bcas chabs gcig par sgu gsung thugs rten dang / dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba mi dman pa'i mchod sprin dang bcas zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa dang / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun ma chad du skor ba sogs kyi gsol 'debs kyang zhus/ mi ring bar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs bstan pa'i bdag po bkra shis lhun por chibs kyi kha lo bskyod par ngos cag nams kyang stod lung sgang gtsug lag na khar bzhugs zhag gi sa'i bar chibs bskyel du bskyod cing / slar yang ring min du mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mis/ gi bdud rtsir smin pa dang /skye ba nas tshe rabs kyi phreng bar rjes 'dzin thugs rje'i 'jug pa zab mos skyong dgos gsol 'debs kyang rtse gcig tu zhus/ chu mo bya'i lo/ lhar bcas skye rgu'i rnam 'dren rgyal dbang 'jig rten gsum mgon lha ldan smon lam chen mor chibs bsgyur skabs/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su 'jiṭa med chos kyi seng ge'i khri la spyon drangs te 'dus tshogs su mang 'gyed dang / skyabs mgon chen por 'bul dngos mod mi dma' ba bcas phran bu bka' blon thun mong nas zhabs pad bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan par 'tsho zhing bzhes dgos pa sogs kyi gsol 'debs zhus par bka' bzhes bzang pos re ba'i 'bras bu yongs su smin/ skabs 'dir kho bos rang gzhis mdo mkhar bkra shis rab brtan du/ rgyal ba ma pham 77

mgon po/ dpal lha gcig — 4 ka ra/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po/ rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang thams cad mkhyen cing gziṭa pa chen po bcas kyi sku brnyan khri rgyab dang bcas pa gser zangs las grub pas mtshon/ sku gsung thuṭa rten gsar bzhengs rnams la rab tu gnas pa zhu ba dang / rang riṭa kyi myu gu dbang phyug bkra shis leṭa kyi khab tu/ gtsang ljongs kyi mda' dpon ram pa nas ཿ thur kha sha kha'i sras mo bsu ba'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo bcas kyi ched du dgongs khrol zhus te bskyod/ thog ma kho nar dpal ldan stod rgyud gra tshang nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyag re rab 'byams pa ngag dbang graṭa pa rdo rje slob dngo na dang chog rog dge 'dun bsnyen song bcu phrag dang bcas/ dpal 'jib/sa mdzad rdo rje lha bcu gsum kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dam tshig sems dpa'i ngo bo ye shes sems dpa' byin chen dbab pa'i cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum ma tshang bar med par smin rgyas su stsal zhing / rab gnas kyi yon 'bul rab ston sogs kyang rgyas par bstar/ de'i tshe kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog nas kyang tshad med pa'i ba rtse chen gzigs pas bskyangs te thog mar phra rgyan gye the bas su rna rgyan pad 'dab che chung gnyis dang / rjes su legs so'i ba/nang skyes gya non/ pa dang / rten rnams/ la mchod rdzas shel dpyad/ dkar dbya da gu gu shel sogs ngo mtshar ba'ang mang du stsal ba'i bka' drin bla na med pa tho ba/ rigs kyi myu gu'i mdun thabs 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi 78 —

rim pa'ang ya rabs dra ma'i lugs srol gyi rjes su 'brang nas dga' ston/rtse 'jo sogs lugs mthun bag yod dang 'brel bas/ 'khon rtsod dang /lugs mi legs pa sogs med pa'i myos byed kyi btung ba'ang lus babs dang bstun pa'i ji ltar mtshams pa dang / kang bro glu gzhas sogs 'khor ba pa rnams kyi spyi srol bsngags 'os legs tshogs su sgrub/ mtha' dag phyogs sming kun nas legs so'i brda 'jal gyi bdogs pa'ang ring du bskyang ba sogs rnam g.yeng zi long gi 'du 'god ci yang shar/ skabs 'dir yang mdo mkhar rang cha/ khongs su gtogs pa'i ser skya mtha' dag dang / gri gu'i mnga' 'bangs kyi gras sgo mtha' sogs kyi khrul mi/ mdor na mi yan sprang 'khyams sogs gang na su yod bsdus te dge 'dun ser mo ba dang /mi ser kang longs/ dud chung / mi 'khyam/ mu to ba sogs la nas 'gyed dang / ja thug spag thud sogs tshim par bstar ba'i dge rtsa grags rjes mi 'brang ba bskrun/ mi ring ba nyid du lha ldan du lhags nas kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma rigs brgya'i khyab bdag thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por dngul dkar gyi ma / la sne 'dogs can dang / sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul dang / rtsi bcud/ sto zog gi bdog pa sogs spyan sngar bstar te mjal phyag re 'dod yongs su rdzogs pa gsung gi gsang ba'i dri rmad dang bcas rna ba bdud rtsi'i bang mdzod bzung / shing pho khyi'i lo/ rdo rje 'chang rgyal dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po hor zla drug pa'i tshes nyer gcig la se 79

ra theg chen gling nas chibs kyi kha lo bskyod de chos 'khor rgyal bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas gzigs la chibs bsgyur ‘kabs bdag cag kyang zhabs phyir bskyo da pa'i skal bzang la longs spyod par gyur te phebs lam du 'khel ba'i gnas gdan sa chen po ri bo dge ldan gyi mtshon grags che byin can gang na ci yod la gnas gzigs gnang ba rnams tshang ma mjal nas smon lam gyi 'brel ba bgyis pa dang / chos 'khor rgyal rang du'ang gnas gzigs/ mtsho mjal/ bdag 'jug bzhes pa dang / bskang ba'i rim pa sogs gsung chog gnang ba tshang ma'i zhabs phyir tshud cing / 'dus tshogs sogs dang / sger zhus gang gi skabs su'ang zab chos gdams pa'i nying khu gang dang ci stsal ba thams cad kyang ma tshang ba med pa thob pas skye ba don lda rte du gyur ba dang / de'i bar phyag glang po'i sna zhags ltar brkyang ba'i phyag 'then kyang zhus chog pa bcas bsam bzhin du bsod nams kyi phung po gzhal bya'i yul las 'das pa nyid do/ shing mo phag gi lo/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig rigs kun khyab bdag chen po cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo chibs bsgyur thog 'di lo dgung keg snga bsur phebs pa'i sku'i rkyen sel la dmigs pa dang / rang nyid kyang na tsho da kyis gtugs pa'i skyabs 'jug zhu ran gyi skabs su bab par mthong nas skyabs mgon srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan lha ldan smon lam chen 80

mo'i tshogs dbur spyan drangs te/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la mang ja bzhes thug gi bsnyen bkur dang / dge 'dun rer sku 'byed dngul skang phyed brgyad re skyabs mgon chen por zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol 'debs dang / rang nyid kyi skyabs 'jug zhu rten chabs cig tu dngul dkar gyi mnal dar tshon sna lngas spras pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i snang brnyan stod hor li ma rmad du byung ba/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi snang brnyan/ lho brag grub chen rin po che las kyi rdo rje'i gsung 'bum cha tshang pod gnyis/ pad spungs mchod rten nyi zla ma/ na bza' skor/sku'i nyer dpyad cha tshang / dbang chas gras/ prog zhu gser 'phul g.yu phras phyug pa/ skra zhwa mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed dang 'dzom rgyan gser gyi dri(sha g.yer sogs kyis mdzes pa/ rtse nor bu 'bar ba'i tog g.yu phra can dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ hor gos kyi stod g.yog mtha' 'jag gan gos las grub pa/ smad g.yogs bzang gos lhan sdebs la gan jus kyis mtha' 'jag dang bcas pa cha tshang / hor sbub dang / rgya sbub rnying cha//sil snyan ya tshe ma rnams shubs mngags bzos dang bcas pa/ gser dngul /ja sig tha mi kha/ rtsi bcud snying po'i ltang / bzang gos yug re gtsos pa'i tshan grangs mang ba/ rang nyid kyi byon pa wa nag gi zhwa mo/gser gos kyi khal kha'i spyon gzugs/ sbu la dang / wa dmar dbyi dkar bcas kyi da go legs pa sogs kyis mtshon bzang bsdus/ dngos 'byor 81

mchod pa'i sprin phung du bstar nas/ maṇḍal 'bul mtshams su khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal ba kun gyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen pos zhing 'dir mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ so thar byang sems/ sngags sdom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cha 'khrul med gang yin pa de nyid nyams pa gsos/ yang dag par bskyangs/ rgyas par spel zhing nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad tshul dang / slad mar yang dus ngan gyi skye bo'i rnam thar ngan zhing tha chad pa rnams la thugs yid mi 'byung bar/ 'di dag gi rnam 'gyur byed spyod gzigs bzhin du thugs stobs kyi go cha ches cher bzhes nas bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan par bzhugs dgos tshul/ 'khor ba pa bdag kyang lang tsho'i nyi ma nub rir yol bar nye ba'i tshe mthar gtug pa la 'di phyi gnas skabs thams cad du gzhan rjes 'dzin gyi dbang bcu dang / ye shes la mnga' brnyes pa'i dbyengs nas 'dor bar med par thugs rje'i gzigs pas skyong dgos pa sogs 'dus pa'i tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su bag tsha ba med pa sgra gsang mthon pos snyan dbang rin po cher gsol te snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba btab pa la 'dod pa ji bzhin 'jo ba'i dbugs dbyung gi bka' stsal bzang po 'ang spyo bo'i cod pan du thob cing /de rjes gzim chung dga' ldan yang rtser dkar spyo'i ston mo rgyas par zhus thog dngul gyi ma / la lha rdzas kyi 'phyang 'phrul can dang / dbyi shod ri bo che 82

ba'i nang rten rje btsun te lo ba chen po'i thugs dam rten du grag pa dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis pa'i spungs sku rgya gar shar phyoṭa li dkar bzo bkod phul du byung ba nged rang gi dad rten du yod pa'ang phul bar skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i ba /'a las/ de ring bka' blon zhabs drung gis zang zing gi skyes dang / legs bshad kyi skyes phun sum tshogs pa byung tshul phebs byung bar/ phran nas dngos 'byor spyan sngar brim 'os dang / legs bshad kyi skyes 'bul rgyus dben kyang / skyabs mgon mchog gi thugs rje dang bka' drin kho nar brten/ rang nyid kyis dang bas kun blangs kyi mchod sprin nyung zad dang / bla ma dang mjal dus gsol ba thob kyi dpe ltar rang gi zhu mi shes bzhin du spyi rtol bskyed pa'i gsol 'debs dgongs 'byor gyi bka' phebs pa thugs rje mchog tu che/da dung yang skye ba nas tshe rabs kyi 'phreng bar rje bla ma mchog gis dgyes bzhin brtse bas 'dzin pa dang / bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byed nus pa byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes zhus/ ston mtshams gong sa lha mi'i gtsug rgyan chen po nor bu gling khar sku'i 'phrod bzhes la chab grang zhag shas bsten pa gnang skabs phran kyi stag lung du dgongs khrol zhus ) sgrub mchod kyi skabs 'grig tu 'byor/ gtsug lag khang du bla bre dang /'phan/ bsngan srung dge bsnyen chen pos gnas yul du na ji sa go ma tshon so gas yo byad cha tshang / rten rnams la mchod spen rgya cher spros nas blo gros 83

kyis ci spyogs pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor yang dag par bgyis/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la mang 'gyed dang / sgrub mchod chen mo'i mthun rkyen du dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ sum 'phreng nas lo nang rer 'bru ru'i khal brgya re'i thebs sbyar ba'i 'dzin tham bcas phul/ stag lung sprul pa'i sku skal bzang ngag dbang rnam rgyal dpal grub rin po cher sku gsung thuṭa rten/ na bza' skor dngos po'i bdog pa'ang ring du bskyang ste zhabs brtan gsol 'debs kyang zhus/ de nas lha ldan du 'byor bas gong sa skyabs mgon chen po chab kyi 'phrod bzhes gnang yul nor bu gling kha nas pho brang chen por chibs kha bsgyur nyer mjal phyug zhus/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i snang brnyan rgya gar shar li rtsod bral byin can dang / dngul/ gos chen/rtsi thog snying po'i ltang sogs kyi mjal rten kyang spyan sngar bstar/ dgyes shing brtse ba'i bka'i bdud rtsi rna ba'i bcud du myong zhing / sku mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i rnam par grol ba'i dga' ston du ma thob/me pho byi ba'i lo tsha chung 'di nyid btsas par btsas ma thag gong sa skyabs mgon chen por skyabs 'jug zhus shing / ming la bsod nams dbang rgyal phun tshogs zhes stsal/ tshogs mchod chen mo tshugs par nye /tshams bdag cag gi thu phrug rnams kyi ma gzhon pa bya ba la rdo phog pa ltar nad drag pos gzir te nyam nga bar mchis pa la sman rim la sogs pa'i bas tshul ji snyed zhig sgrub kyang bzlog tu sked par/ — sman pas bor/ mo bon kyis / 4

bsgus/ gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' skor ste shi dge dur 'debs kyi gshoms ra byed bzhin par/ bdag cag nye du'i gdong mig gi tha ma ni bltas/ tshig gi tha ma ni smras/ mdor na gces par bskyangs pa'i lus kyang dor nas 'jig rten phyi ma'i gnas skabs nyams su myong bar gyur pa de'i tshe yid la bzod par dka' bas gdung bas gces par gyur kyang / 'khor ba spyod pa rnams kyi gshis lugs ni re zhig nyams dga' dga' ltar mchis pa rnams kyang mthar ni mya ngan dang smre sngags dang / sdug bsngal ba kho na'i rgyur gsungs shing / tshe rabs 'khor ba thog sted nas 'di lta bur zo chun gyi 'khyud mo ltar 'khor zhing gnas pa la 'di'i skabs mya ngan dang / gdu nga bas phan pa med cing / rnam dkar dge gtong rgya chen po sprub pa ni don du yod pa'o snyam du 'da' khar sangs rgyas kyi mtshan sngags dang / byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzung sogs rna lam du bsgrags/ mkhan ri na po che dpal 'byor grags pas ngo sprod gsol 'debs nan tan du mdzad/ 'jig rten rnam pa 'dren pa kun gzigs rgyal dbang yab sras kyi mtshon skyes chen dam pa la thugs rje bskul zhing / ljags ba spyo zhu ba rten dang / tshogs mchod chen mo'i 'dus tshogs la mab ja dang / dge 'dun re'i phyag tu dngul skar lnga re sogs 'dus pa'i sde ris su ma chad pa rnams la mang bsngo/gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod sprin/ 'bangs dang ngan slong rnams la sbyin gtong sogs grags pa sgrub ched tsam ma yin par gan du smin pa 85

bsgrubs shing / de yang phyis kyi 'jig rten phal cher ba'i srol lam la pha dus las 'das na de'i spyon pa bca' lag sogs bus longs spyod pa dang /ma dus las 'das na de'i rgyan chas sogs bag ma dang / bu mos longs spyod pa la 'dzems bag med cing / ya mi nga ba de dag gi rjes su ma 'brang bar mdor na rgyan cha byu ru zhar ma tsam dang / gyon pa lham tsam yang lus pa med pa dge sgrub kho na smin pa sogs tshe rabs phyi ma phan pa'i rnam dkar gyi las 'du bgyis/ khyad par khams gsum gyi bla ma/ srid pa gsum kyi 'dren mchog rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen pos rnam rgyal gra tshang ba'i chog rog dang bcas pas byang chog smin rgyas su stsal te re ba'i 'bras bu yongs su gang bar mdzad cing / dge ba sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dang / bsngo rten phul ba'i slog cha yang bzang zhing gya nom pa dpe zla bral bar bka' drin chen pos rjes su bzung / me mo glang gi lo/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gcig pu/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po sku 'khrugs kyi rnam pa'i stem gzhi thog ma chu bya lo nas bzhes kyang / gzhung sger nas zhabs brtan sku rim 'bad 'bung du sgrub pa'i mthu dang rgyal dbang nyid kyi thugs bskyed kyi 'jug pas 'di lo phan star chags byung yang / lo 'dir mi dge ba'i than ltas kyang sna tshogs pa byung zhing / sku'i khams kyang ji lod kyi babs yul blos ma bzod par/86 —

bla ma ser mo ba/ bdag cag bka' blon sogs drung 'kho ra phyi nang drag zhan mtha' dag gdan sa chen po gsum/ rgyud stod smad kyis gtsos 'dus sde chen po rnams/ mdor na lha ldan ru bzhi sogs kyis gtsos grong dang grong khyer dag na gnas pa'i khyim pa pho mo chab 'og tu gtogs pa mtha' dag gis kyang rang rang gi 'byor stobs la dpags pa'i dngos 'bul dang bcas zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs/ sku rim sogs snying thag pa nas sgrub pa sogs rten 'brel gyi bsgrig sgo dang / thabs tshul sna tshogs pa 'bad par byas kyang / bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang bos kung rang gi sku dngos kyi gdul bya'i don mdzad pa'i 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs te mchog gi sprul sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i dgongs pa gtad pa'i tshe/ sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / dgra bcom pa/ lhar bcas 'jig rten tham/sa cad kyi thabs gang gis kyang bzlog tu ma gtub pa dang mchu ngan par/sku khams je zhan du 'gyur ba'i tshul bstan te/ skabs 'dir sku dngos kyi gdul ba'i gdul bya'i tha ma thor rgod nas lha ṭa pa'i mi sna gtos che ba bod gangs can gyi yul du dge rtsa bskrun par ched du yong ba rnams la sku nyams mi bde bzhin du nan tur chen pos mjal phyag stsal zhing / chos dang mthun pa'i bka'i gnang ba stsal ba tsam gyis de dag thams cad dad pa'i gsos su gyur cing re ba 'bras ldan du mdzad/ de nas hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin bdag cag bka' blon rnams kyis zhabs pad brtan par gar la snye7

'dibs kyis sku gsung thuṭa rten dang dngos 'bul bcas rgya cher bteg ste/lhar bcas bstan 'gro yongs kyi dpung gnyen/ bdag cag rnams kyi mgon po thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po nyid gdul bya skal dman rnams kyi ngor bsnyun pa'i tshul bzhes pa la sngon chad gsol sman gyi 'phrod bzhes dang /gzhung sger tshang mas zhabs brtan sku rim/ thabs dang rten 'brel nus stobs gang yod zhus kyang dwangs bskyed ma bzhes pas/ da ni skyabs mgon chen por rang la gsol ba 'debs pa las gzhan gang gis kyang thabs yod du ma gyur pas/ bdag nyid chen po khyod zhabs pad brtan pa zhig ma byung phyin lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad shed ma bye ba'i byis pa chung ngu ma yis bor ba ltar mgon dang bral ba'i sdug brdzal shin tu mi bzod pas mnar zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di'ang rgya mtsho'i glong du gru gzings zhig pa ltar bcos su med par 'gyur na/ rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rabs 'od stong du mas gsal bar mdzad pa'i zhing khams 'di yang blang dor gsal ba'i nyin byed nub gshis mun ming kho na las ma 'das pa tshul 'di brtse bas dgongs te/ da dung bstan pa dang 'gro ba 'di dag thugs nas ma bor ba'i zhabs pad brtan pa zhig skyabs mgon chen po khyed rang nas thugs rje dang /thuṭa bskyed kyi dam bca' kho nar re stos 'cha' ba ma gtoṭa thabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ des na thugs rje'i mthu dpung lhag par ba byed nas bdag cag rnams kyis gsol ba btab re ba'i 'bras bu 'phral du smin pa zhig 88

gzod ma nas thugs bskyed dam bca'i 'jug pa ma bor ba cis kyang mkhyen zhes phran bus mchi mas brnangs bzhin pa smre sngags kyi sgo nas gsol ba de ltar btab par skyabs mgon srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan chen po yang dar cig dgongs pa la bzhugs nas spyan chab cung zad bsil ba dang bcas ji ltar smon pa bzhin 'grub pa'i mdun pa byed ces phebs/ rnam par rgyal ba'i po tshang spyis sngar nas zhabs brtan phul chog pa'i snyan gsan phab par/ glang lo gsar pa'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la mig dmar dbyu gu'i 'grub sbyor dang bcas gza' tshes 'phrod sbyor legs thog phul na yong bka' phebs pa dang / da lam kyang tshes ga sum la gra tshang nas gra pa rags bsdus nyi shu skor gyis zhabs brtan phul chog pa gsol 'debs zhus 'dug par bka' las da lam khong tsho nged rang dang ma 'phrad na yid pham 'gro tshogs yongs thongs shig ces phebs 'dug pa ltar tshogs yongs nas dngos 'bul bcas zhabs pad brtan pa'i —gsol 'debs zhus 'dug pa/ 'di nyin sku khams star chags nas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gzi mdangs mchog tu rgyas shing / sku ngal dub kyi nyams med par bzhugs pa la/ bdag cag rnams kyis sku'i gam du bcar te bsnyun dri gsol bar zhal 'dzum mul bzhin skyon mi 'dug phebs shing / nyin phyed phyi ma tsam nas spyan nam mkha' la yang yang gzigs shing thugs dam gyi rim pa skyong pa las/ bka' phebs cher ma byung bar/de skabs phran rnams nas gong ma'i sku tshab u pa ye dang / pan am ban 89

gnyis kyi sar phyin nas sku'i ltem bab sogs snyan du gsol bar de 'phral gong ma chen por gral tshe zhu yig phul zhing / yang las tshan pa drung 'khor rnams la babs rkyen bsed dkrol btang nas gang 'gab ci legs kyi gros bsdur yang byas rung 'di byed kyi blo gros thon pa ma byung / 'di dag gi skabs sogs la/ la la dag gis sku'i ltem babs 'di bzhin shar ba la sku rim rang nor nyan byung ma song zhes dngos brgyud du ma nas gtam cha bzos 'dug kyang / yod dgu rtsal sprug gi sku rim ji ltar bsgrubs yig tshang khang gi song tho sogs la gsal bar ma zad/ bsdoms tho gang yin sgyung skya rin po ches mdzad pa'i rnam thar rin po cher 'khod pa ltar dang / sngon chad bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'dir chen po grags pa su'ang sku'i rim gro sgrub pa 'di ltar ma byung ngo zhes rnam dpyod yangs pa'i skye bo phal mo che dag gtam du gleng ba ni gcam bu'i ngag tsam ma yin pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa kho na'o/ zhes gsung pa ltar phyogs lhung gi gdon gyis zin pa'i rang 'dod can ma yin pa/ gzu por gnas pa rnams kyis brtag na gsal bar gtan la phebs pa gyur ro/ de nas gzim chung spug tu phebs/ thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i bzhugs stangs ched du mdzad de/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i nye snying yi ge bdun pa sogs gsung ba dang / rlung sngags dbyer med kyi rdo rje'i bzlas pa la sogs pa mdzad bzhin par/ zhing 'dir bstan 'gro'i don 90

rlabs po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa'i dgongs par mthar phyin te/gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i don du/ stong pa gsum rim gyis thim pa'i mthar/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku mngon du mdzad cing / ye shes mngon sbyor gyi thugs dam zab mo la bzhugs so/de'i tshe nged cag rnams la 'phros brda byung phral bcar ba yin kyang /sku dngos kyi zhal mjal ba ni lta ci smos/ thugs dam 'od gsal la bzhugs pa'i stabs gzim chung gi sgo sgrigs 'gram nas phyag phul zhing / sdug bsngal bzod brlag dang bral bas rab tu gdung kyang bsran bskyed de/ zhabs phyi nang ma rnams dang gsung mol thog nas/ dpal ldan rgyud pa gra tshang sag gnyis dang / rnam rgyal gra tshang soṭa kyi zhal 'don bsgyur kha dgos riṭa rna /sa la brda sbyar zhing / sam zan gnyis la gong ma chen por gnas tshul 'phral du zhu rgyu dang / de yang rgya lugs dang bstun pa'i khong rnams sku gdung rin po che'i drung du 'phral du bcar na thugs dam 'grogs rkyen byed pa'i/ thugs dam grol rjes phebs dgos sogs bsed dkrol gtong bar nged cag bka' blon rnams dang / sku mdun mkhan po bcas nas bcar bar mam ban gnyis spyan chab 'byin pa sogs thugs ngal che bar mdzad cing / gang zhus rnams la gsan dgongs kyi gang ci lam du mi 'gro ba'i rigs ma byung / de nas pho brang chen por phyin te mtshan thog thag gong ma ——— 91

bdag po chen po dang / lcang skya mchog sprul rin po cher 'bul rgyur zhu yig bcas kyi zin bris/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por/rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i snang tshul ji ltar gyur pa gsol ba dang skyabs mgon chen po de nyid kyi dgongs bzhed 'grub pa'i thugs smon mtshams sbyor zhu ba'i sngon 'gyoṭa kyi rten dang / mchog gi sprul sku'i 'dzum zhal myur du ston pa'i gsol 'debs zhu rten spam mtho ba/tshogs chen du mang 'gyed zhu rgyu bcas kyang 'phral du phul/ nang par yang las tshan pa sogs drung 'khor che drag tshang ma 'dus nas dgongs rdzogs sgrub lugs kyi skor sogs srol lam ji ltar yod mol bsdur byas kyang snga srol myong grub kyi gnas tshul zhu mi'i rigs ni su yang ma byung / lar babs rgyal mchog lnga ba chen po gzhan don du gshegs skabs ni/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gsang rgya yun ring du mdzad te/ dgongs rdzogs sogs kyang zhabs brtan gyi tshul mdzad pa sogs des 'geb ma thub/ rgyal ba drug pa chen po ni rgya la phebs rtsis thog kun dga' nor du zhi dbyings su gshegs pa dang / de'i skabs rgyal po lha bzang gis bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i stabs bcas dgongs rdzogs kyi re ba dang bral zhing gzhan ma'i dpe srol rgyas 'gebs kyang 'di byed med pa bcas bya thabs dka' bar gyur kyang / sku mdun nang ma rnams dang / sku'i gcung po gung kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ phran bka' blon bzhi bcas mol bsdur thog nas/ 'phral 92

snang gi grags pa sgrub byed tsam ma yin par gnad du gang smin gyi dgongs rdzogs phyi gshol du ma song ba 'phral bsgrubs shing / de ltar chos kyi sku'i thugs dam mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas nyin zhag gcig 'das pa'i/ nub snga ma zhi dbyings su mnal ba'i tshod tsam du/ gzugs sku rags pa'i dkyil 'khor skye 'gro yongs kyi bsod nams kyi mchog tu 'jog pa gnang ste/ ye shes kyi sku mtshan dpes spras pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par bzhengs te gzhan don gyi spros pa rmad du byung ba la rjes su chags pa'i slar yang bsil ldan sman gyi ljongs sogs zhing khams mtha' yas mu med par mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bye ba ther 'bum sogs dus gcig tu 'gyed pa la thugs gzhol bar gyur te/ de'i tshe thugs dam ye shes rdo rje ting nge 'dzinalas bzhengs pa'i rtags shangs bug nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun 'bab pa sogs der 'khod rnams kyi mthun snang du grub par byung ngo/skabal der bdag cag la sogs pas kyang snyan shal sogs mchod sprin spros te sku gdung rin po che'i zhabs la mgo bos gtugs te gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don 'bad med 'grub pa dang / rje bla ma mchog gis skye ba nas tshe rabs kyi phreng bar rjes su 'dzin pa/ mchog gi sprul sku'i 'dzum zhal gsar pa myur du mjal pa sogs kyi smon lam mtshams sbyor gdung shugs chen po'i sgo nas yang dag par bgyis/ gong ma chen po'i bka' mngags pa'i am ban gnyis sogs dpon khag che chung rnams kyang —— — — — — — — — — — —— —ba — mi

'di nyid sku gdung rin po che'i mjal khar bcar zhing / sku'i gzi byin bzhugs stangs sogs kung zhib mor mjal te dad pa'i shugs phyin pa'i mchod 'bul/ phyag 'tshal/ gsol 'debs sogs kyang 'bad par mdzad do/bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen pos skal ngan 'di ltar gyur ba'i gan/ tshul gsan 'phral thugs ngal bzod glag med pa 'khrungs te/ skyabs mgon de nyid kyi thuṭa zag pa med pa'i dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / zhing 'dir mchog sprul myur phebs kyi thugs smon rlabs po che gnang zhing / gsol 'debs smon lam gyi bden tshig kyang 'phral du stsal/ bla brang phyag mdzod nas bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen gyis mtshon gtsang khul dgon khag che rag thams cad la mang 'gyed rgya cher gnang ste/ dgongs zab rdzogs pa dang mchog sprul myur phebs kyi bka' rtsom ched stsal 'jug pa sogs rnam dkar rlabs po che bskrun/ bdag cag bka' blon gyis mtshon zham ring tshang mas yid ngal spangs te dgongs pa rdzogs thabs la 'bad dgos pa'i bka' slob kyang zhib mor stsal pa'i dbu ṭa dbyung / de nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen por thugs dam bsku' 'debs zhu rten rgyas pa'i lugs 'bul bar mgron gnyer sman ram ba ched mngags ba/nang ste ma/la sku'i nyer dpyad na bza' gser dngu' gos dar sogs kyi dngos 'bul dang / tshogs chen du mang 'gyed/ rten rnams mi 4

la snyan shal mchod sprin rgya cher rjos/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang mon khams bcas kyi gnas rnying byin can dang / rten khyad par can gang na ci bzhugs pa rnams kyi gnas khag che kha rnams la stong mchod/ chung gras la brgya mchod kyi bar zla ba gcig ring rgyun chags dang / gzhan yang gser chab/ snyan shal/ na bza'/ bla re/ 'phan/ phye phur/ rgyal mtshan la sogs mchod rdzas kyi rim pa bzang zhing mtha' yas pa 'bul spyor dang / gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dga' gsum dang / bkra shis lhun po gtsos dbus gtsang dwags kong gi char gnas ris med dgon khag mang por mang 'gyed kyi bsnye/na bkur bstabs te/ sngags gra'i rigs grub mtha' ris med la dus 'khor gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ sman bla/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa sogs gtso gyur gyi so so'i chos lugs dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor khag sgrub cing mchod pa/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug dang /sgol ma ma/la bzhi pa'i cho ga ma cha dang yig brgya dung phyur ches mang ba 'gro ba'i bum sgrub khag dang / bshad gra gang yin nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang / bstan 'gyur/ bka' bstan khol bur phyung ba le tshan khag mang gsung sgog mchog gi sprul sku myur phebs kyi gsol 'debs dang yig brgya yig drug smon lam gyi rim pa gang rgyas bcas tshugs shing / tshogs mchod chen mo 'char can la/ ba/dan sa chen po ser 'bras dga' gsum dang / rgyud stod smad/ ra ba stod pa sogs 95

phebs rgyun gang yod thog lha sa tha ta la'i nye skor/ mer rgyud/ dbus stod/ dbus smad/ stag rtse/ 'phan yul khul/ mal gro/ dga' rgyud/ sne'u/ sgrags 'phreng / zur mkhar/ chu shur/ zad/gnam/ ljangs/ snye thang / stod lung tshal bde khul dang bcas pa'i rdzong gzhis khongs su yod pa'i grub mtha' ris med gtsang dgon gang yin gyi dge 'dun rnams ser tshogs chen mor spyan drangs te nyin lnga'i ring / jo bo shākya rin po che'i sku'i mdun du mchod pa stong tshar chag med dang / dge 'dun 'dus tshogs nyi khri chig stong sum brgya skor la gzhung nas mang 'gyed cha gra bcas kyi bsnyen bkur zhing / 'di skabs kho bos kyang se ra tshogs chen mo'i dge 'dun rnams la mang ja dang bzhes thug gi bsnyen bkur thog dge 'dun rer dngul dkar phyed brgyad re thob nges kyi dngos po phul zhing / dgongs rdzogs zhal 'debs su wa nag gi zhwa gor spus legs phod bcas gnyis/ gser gos kyi khal kha gzugs stong skud kyi 'ja' ldan sbul ga'i mtha' 'jag can nang khe ru mas byas pa/ sgu la ga'i rda lab chi dang bcas pa/ yang ther gos gzhi ser gyi khal kha gzugs sram rgyan ma gong mtshungs/ gzhan ma rgyan gzhi sogs kyi tsag pa gsum dang / la ba gsum/ gser skad/ gri chung / phor shubs dang bcas pa/ rgya lu chas kyi pho gos sngon po cha ga ma/ cod ldan dmar po'i stod gos gong ba gser gos sram nag gi rgyan ldan jus bsgrigs kyi gzhi 'jas dang bcas 96

pa/ kong zhed stongs chings dang bcas pa cha tshang / gzan ther ma dang /'bri'u/ mo gos sngo thi cha ga ma/ gos chen gyi stod gos gnyis/ spangs khebs gnyis/ dngul ṭam srang stong phrag gcig mdzod gos yug nyi shu/tha mi kha sngo rtsig ko dra sum cu so drug mar 'degs khal nyis brgya dang brgyad bcas phul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po 'du byas/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bdun la dgung zhag grol ba'i dus mchod/ rten khyad par can rnams la gzhung sa nas stong mchod/ brgya mchod/ gser chab/snyan shal/ bzang gos kyi spyan gzigs sogs dang / bkra shis lhun po paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por/ yang skyar dgongs rdzogs dang mchog sprul myur phebs kyi gsol 'debs zhu ba bcas mgron gnyer chos grags ched du mngags te/ thugs dam rten gras kyi sku gsung thugs rten/na bza'/ sku'i nyer dpyad/ gser dngul gos dar sogs gtos che ba dang / yongs 'dzin rin po che dang / zur bzhi bla khag sogs la sne bzhag bzang nges/ 'dus tshogs su mang 'gyed/ rten rnams la snyan shal mchod sprin sogs rgyas par bstar/ gzhan yang dbus gtsang dwags kong gi grub mtha' ris med kyi dgon khag stong phrag mang por mang 'gyed gya nom pa zhus te sngags gra'i rigs nas dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ de phyin nas bka' bstan gsung sgogs sogs rgya cher sgrubs shing / sems can khri phrag mang po srog bslu/ ngan slong chas mang por zas skom gyi sbyin pa/ dbus mi7

gtsang gi mnga' 'bangs mi ser gang yod la 'bru 'gyed/ dngul gos dar sogs kyi sbyin gto2 rlabs che ba/ rgya gar rtsa mchog grong / bal yul mchod rten rnam gnyis/ 'phags pa mched/ la dwags khul gyi rten tshang mar/ mchod sprin dang / khrigs se/ dpe thub/ ) mi/ che 'dre sogs kyis mtshon dge 'dun gyi sde gang yod dang / mtho sding gis mtshon mnga' ris skor gsum gyi dgon khag sto mon dang / 'bras mo spyongs bcas kyi dgon khag tshang mar mang 'gyed rten rnams la mchod pa/ de bzhin du khams khul gyi chos sde che drag mgar thar sku 'bum byams pa gling so sor mchod 'bul/ mang 'gyed/ rgya nag pi cing du g.yung dgon dang /sha ra su mis mtshon dgon khag gi dge 'dun mang bar mang 'gyed/ tsa/na jo bo/ ri jo rtse lnga/ ri bo po ta lar so sor mchod sprin bcas rgya cher spro ba gnang zhing / skabs 'dir gong ma chen por snga sor gnas tshul phul ba'i lan gser gyi bka' lung bzang po yang yang phebs shing / lhag par am ban gnyis brgyud zhus pa'i bka' lan du/ rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bya ba thams cad khur du blang ba'i skyes bu dam pa mtha' dag gi mchod gnas dang re sa yin cing bod 'bangs thams cad bde skyid la bkod par ma zad/ bstan srid las don thams cad nged kyi sems dang mthun pa'i shin tu bsngags pa'i yul yin pa la/ da cha glo 6ra du zhi bar gshegs pa la nged sems khrul shin tu che bas yid 'phangs 8

shing skyo bar gyur/ dgongs rdzogs sgrub skor zur gsal ltar la/ nged kyi dgongs pa dbus gtsang gi lar rgya'i gal 'gangs che bas/ rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i sprul sku ma gsal gyi bar du hu thog thu che ba zhig nas 'go 'dzin khur len byed bcug na dbus gtsang gi chab 'bangs mtha' dag la shin tu phan pa 'dug snyam pa ltar/ de mo hu thog thu spyo'i mgo 'dren du bskos nas zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin byed dpal ldan no min han gyi cho lo gnang ba yin/ de cho/ hu thog thu khyod kyis tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad sgo thams cad khur du blangs nas byed dgos gshis cis kyang zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bod 'bangs la bde skyid 'byung ba'i byed sgo ma 'phyugs pa dgos shing / nged nas gnam thog sa steng gi skye 'gro thams cad byams brtse'i bskyangs pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par tā la'i bla ma sprul sku ma gsal gyi bar du gus pas bka' bzhin sgrub pa la le shor med pa gyis/ bka' blon sogs nas kyang rang rang la bab pa'i las la 'bad pa dang / tā la'i bla ma'i sku dus bzhin sngar srol bzang po ma nyams par byed dgos sogs bka'i gser yig bzang po phebs don bzhin/ gza' skar 'phrod spyor dge ba la de mo mchog sprul rin po cher/ bdag cag rtse shod kyi drung 'khor ser skya tshang mas legs po'i brda mjal gyi dngos po dang bcas rgyal dbang phyag na padma'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol bar gyur to/ de nas rgyal ba'i sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin byu nor bu zhugs su phul ba mimi

dang / ril por bzhugs pa gang legs rgyal tshab rin po che'i sku drung du bdag cag rnams grol mol zhib tu byas par/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i brtag bsgril gnang ba'i der gang thon byed rgyur thag bcad nas sku gdung rin po che'i drung du thugs dam rten rje'i sku brnyan bkra shis rdo kha ma/ jo bo'i lung bstan sgol ma/ lha mo gsung 'byon ma bcas gdan drangs nas brtag bsgril gnang bar/ sku gdung rin po che ma nyams pa bzhugs pa legs par babs shing / bzhugs gnas kyang thugs brtags la bab pa bzhin/ gzim chung bkra shis 'khyil par gtsug lag khang gsar du bskrun pa bzo bkod kyang shin tu bka' babs shing phun sum tshogs pa 'ul mi sogs ha cang chen po'i brdab bsig kyang ma dgos pa legs pa'i phul du phyin pa byung / de nas sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing mchog dam par bzhugs su gsol ba'i mchod sdong chen po'i sku rgyu'ang gser sbyangs 'ba' zhig las grub pa ci nas kyang babs 'brel che rung / gzhung sa'i phyag mdzod du'ang de lta bu'i dmigs yul du gyur pa med gshis blos shin tu 'khyud dka' yang / tshang ma gsung mol thog nas gser sbyangs rang las bzhengs par thag bcad pa'i tshe/ bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i sku rgyu yongs sgogs thon rtsis kyi gser sil ma srang stong phrag bdun dus gcig tu stsal zhing / ba/zhan yang cha/chog tu dad pa'i nor can rnams kyis dgongs rdzogs zhal 'debs dang / gser 100 pa

gdung rin po chi'i sku rgyu phra rgyan sogs la chid dmigs kyis phul pa/gzhung phyag mdzod nas snga phyir stsal ba bcas khyon gcig tu bsdoms par gser sil ma srang chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya lnga bcu las bsgrubs pa/ rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin po che ma / ra/ i/ / la/ ze bye bye/ margad/pa1 rla ga ke ke ru/ rdo rje pha lam/ me shel/ g.yu/byu ru/ sbur len/ mu len/ mu ka sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phra rgyan gyis mdzes par phyug pa bzo bkod lta bas chog mi shes pa/ dngulasrang brgyad brgya lhag bcas las sgrub pa'i 'dra sku rin po che/ sman 'dam las sgrub pa'i 'dra sku rin po che/ dus 'khor gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi sku brnyan ches mang ba gsar bzhengs rnams kyi gzungs bzhugs la'ang ring bsrel rnam pa gsum dang / sku gsung thugs rten/ dam tshig la sel med pa'i dam rdzas khyad par can/ rgya gar/ rgya nag bal bod sogs gnas rten rnams kyi byin rten rigs dang / sa sna/ rdo sna/ 'bru sna/ rin po che dang / sman rigs sogs kyis phyur bur gang ba gtsug lag khang gi yang thog tu gser sbyangs kyi rgya thag dang bcas pa mtha' dag lha mi'i gtsug rgyan dam pa dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa nas mi ring ba nyid du bzo gra brtsam pa nas glang lo hor zla dgu pa'i nang la legs par grub nas/ sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu bum nang du spyon 'dren skabs gtsug lag khang gsar bsnyun la phebs thog gra 101

tshang gi tshogs dung bus pa/ bum nang du bzhugs su gsol ba dang dus mtshungs nyi ma lhag gis shar ba/ 'chi med kyi lam du kha dog sna snga'i 'ja' tshon gyi rnam pa ngo mtshar ba brjod las 'das pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa byung zhing / de nas zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin byed dpal ldan no mi han dang / rje bla ma ngag dbang byams pa'i zhal snga nas gnyis nas rdo rje slob dpon dang rnam rgyal gra tshang gi sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs kyis dpal 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho sha rgyas par mdzad cing / de dang stabs mthun paṇa chen thams cang mkhyen pa chen pos kyang rgyang nas ye shes kyi byin can dbab pa'i thugs smon spyan dmigs stsal dgos zhu gnang ltar brtse ba'i gzigs yod 'dug pa bzhin/ 'di nyin kyang phyi nang gi rten 'brel sogs gang ci nas phun sum tshogs shing / gnam dpyad 'ja' sprin soṭa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas snang dpag tu med pa thun mong gi spyod yul du gyur pas dad pa'i gsos bla na me da pa thob/ 'di skabs gnam gyi lha gong ma bdag po chen pos rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang gi yang srid 'khrul med myur gsal gyi dgongs pa gtad nas rgyal dbang mchog gi thuṭa sras/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba zung du 'jug pa/ bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po tā kau shri lcang skya mchog sprul rin po che ched gnyer rdzongs brda gnang ba bzhin zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du lha ldan rdo rje gdan gyi gnas su phebs de nas lo dus kyi sku mchod chen mo snga bsnur dang /102

cho 'phrul dus chen dang 'grig khyad bcas sa stag zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum nas smon lam chen mo 'char can gyi dus bzhin/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du jo shākya yid bzhin nor bu'i spyan sngar ser 'bras dga' gsum/rgyud stod smad/ ra ba stod pa/ rmi ru/ bzhi bde ba sogs kyis gtsos dge 'dun zhal grangs nyis khrir nye ba la nyin gsum gyi bar/ mang ja/bzhes thug tsha gra/ 'byed bcas bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos mnyes par mdzad cing / lo dus der ma zad da lta'i bar du'ang nyams chag med par smon lam chen mo 'char can dang zung 'brel du zhu bzhin dang / zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la sku mchod ngo thog la'ang ser 'bras dga' gsum/rgyud stod smad bcas la mang ja dang / sku 'gyed ṭam re chag med du phul ba dang / gzhung zhabs kyi lha sde tshang ma nas dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mor cha bzhag gi rming me spor ba sogs kyi srol lam tshugs pa sogs/ zhib par 'god mi lang zhing rgyal dbang srid zhi'i rnam 'dren dam pa bstan 'gro ma lus pa'i phan bde'i srog shing gcig pu/ kun gzigs ye shes kyi nyi ma chen po chos dbyings su nub pas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun sdug bsngal gyi mun pas khyab cing / bdag cag bzod rlag dang bral ba'i mya ngan smag rum stug pos dgrig pa'i skal ngan nyams su myong ba dang /ci bya gtol bral gyi long ba dmigs bu dang bral bar mya ngam gyi thang la 'khyams pa ltar gyur te/ 'khor ba'i bya ba gang la'ang snying po med par 103

nges pa gting nas rnyed mod/ 'on kyang srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa lag rdo rje slob dpon chen po gus pas bsnyen te/ de'i bka' las mi 'da' bar sgo gsum gyi zhabs 'a nge/gas bsgrub tu yod pa ni bsod nams kyi phul ches che bar gsung ba bzhin/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po sku 'tsho zhing bzhes skabs lta ci skos sku stogs tshul bzhes pa nas kyang zhabs brtan sku rim sgrub pa/ zhing khams gzhan don la gshegs skabs dgongs zab chos dbyings su jogs pa dang mchog sprul rin po che myur phebs kyi rnam dkar gyis mtshon pa'i zhabs 'degs bsam pa thag pa nas sgrub pa'i ska/ra ba rnyed pa ni las byas pa don dang ldan pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde legs thams cad 'bad med du 'grub pa'i gzhi rten/ bsod nams dang ye shes /kyi tshogs rlabs po che bde blag tu rdzogs nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la bsnyegs pa'i snying po lhun gyis grub pa'i snyam nas dga' ba dang / gus pa dang bcas pa bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cing / de ltar sku gdung rin po che snying por bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong 'dzam khya nga rgyan mchog bkra shis 'od 'bar kyi sku rgyu'i zhal 'debs la'ang phran bu dngo 'byor gyi bdog pa cha phra ba zhig gis/ rngo thog pa ma cha/chis kyang / dang ba'i bsam pas kun nas blangs te nang gzhug gzungs 'bul ba/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po'i thugs dam rten dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ra lugs spyo nag tā ping la gsung byon mar 104

grags pa byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba/ sku rgyu dang phra rgyan gyi zhal 'debs gser srang nyi shu/ rang nyid kyi rna rgyan gru dkar dmar gyi pad 'dab che legs/ mchis brang mtsho rgyal gyi kha che spos shel ngang sgong phyed gnyis 'gyur tsam che legs/ spos shel gyi phreng ba/ mchod rdzas sogasakyi thebs/ snyan shal nang mdzod sna lnga/ dngul srang nyi shu las grub pa'i ma/la lha rdzas sna lngas ste 'degs can/ bzang gos kha thi dmar po'i khun ju li che ba/ bcad ldan sngon po gser spyong ma yug chen/ rgyan bzhi 'brug chen sngon po'i khun ju li/ mar 'degs khal brgya dang lnga/ rgyun gyi mchod me'i thebs 'bri gzhon drug cu re lnga bcas kyang phul te zang zing gi sgo nas kyang rgyal ba mchod pa'i bsod nams kyi phul chen po thob pa ni rje mar pas/ tshe phyi mas rgyag phye ga ster du sbas gsung ba ltar che 'dod grags 'dod tsam ma yin pa bsam pa thag pa nas gus pa chen pos nye bar drangs pa'i rnam par dkar ba 'di lta bu ni skye ba kun tu rnyed par dka' ba'o/lo 'dir bdag cag gi bu phrug rnams kyi ma che zhe yang nad drag pos yu na ring du mnar ba sman bcos thabs rim gang gis kyang ma bzlog par tshe srog chu'i lhu ba dang 'dra ba rkyen chung ngus 'jig par sla ba bzhin 'jig rten pha rol du drangs pa'i tshe skyabs mgon dam pa rdo rje 'chang bla ma byams pa rin po che gdan drangs nas ngo sprod gsal 'debs kyi bka' drin phul du byung ba stsal zhing / bdag cag nyer du gyur ba sogs dngos 'dzin 'khrul 105

ba'i a 'thas kyis yid la gdung ba zad mi shes pas mnar yang / ji skad du/ mdza' ba yun ring 'khod 'khod nas/ 'chi bas so sor 'phral 'gyur zhing / mya ngan chen po ldang 'gyur ba/ de bee 'jig rten 'di na nges/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor ba pa rnams kyi myong byar bsam ste yid gdung gi spros pa bcom nas gong du brjod pa ltar gyi rnam dkar dge ba'i rim pa gnad du smin pa rgya cher spel ba tsam las thabs yod du ma gyur )/de nas rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i yang srid mchog gi sprul sku'i sko ra 'di gzod ma nyid nas skye rgu spyi dang / khyad par bsil ldan kha ba ri pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs mgo dpung gnyen khyad du 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug nyid kyis thugs bskyed cing dam bcas pa'i phyir ye shes sgyu ma'i rol rtsed mchog gi sprul sku'i zlos gar zhing 'dir mi ston pa dang / 'khrul pa'i dri bcas su 'gyur ba nam yang mi srid mod kyang / ji mi snyam par 'jog pa ni blos/ mi bzod pa dang / mchog gi sprul sku'i 'dzum zhal gsar pa mig gi bdud rtsir spyod pa la nyi ma re yang stos pa'i tshang ma 'dod gdungs che ba bcas rgyal tshab rin po ches bka' stsal gyi don ltar gsang stabs mngon chung gi sgo nas phyogs mas kun tu stog dpyod byed mi gnang bar pha ma sogs kyi zer tshod dang bstun pa dang / stos ya mtshan pa 'dra byung tshul bcas la brten bar skabs su stod smad bar gsum nas the tshom gyi khreng gzhi che zhing / chos skyong khag nas kyang de dang de'i skabs bstun gyi 106

lung las 'khrul med mdzub btsug kyi yid ston thub pa byung rigs su mi 'dug cing / de nas tā kau sri lcang skya mchog sprul rin po che ched du phebs par brten/ stod smad kyi 1gas pa che sar sku bcar nang ma'i gras kyi stog dpyod pa ched gnyer gtong ba gnang ste yun ring rab tu brtag cing dpyad pa'i gnas tshul dang / gtso bo sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen por thugs dam brtag zhu/ chos skyong khag po tā lar dus gcig tu spyan 'dren gyi lung zhu/ gzhan yang bla ma ser mo ba sogs blo gros kyi phul dang ldan pa mtha' dag la dri rtsad sogs kyi sgo nas kyang gtan la phab par/ ngo mtshar ba'i rtags dpyad rten 'brel bcos min mtshan lam gyi nges pa thugs brtag lung bstan bcas sgo mthun par thob rgyal lha ri sgang du sku bltams pa rgyal ba rin po che 'di nyid kho na nges pa gting phyin par gyur kyang / bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin dpyad pa gsum gyis rnam par dag pa'i slad du slar yang sku mdun nang ma khag nas rtog dpyod gnang rgyu mus skyong dang / gong gi gnas tshul gang dang ci mchis pa rnams 'jam pa'i dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po'i gser gyi snyan du ba/sol te ji ltar bka' dpyad pa'i don la spangs blangs zhu rgyu'i tha tshig kyang bzhes pa ltar slar pi cing du phebs bskyod grub rjes/ 'di ga'i nang ma zung nas kyang / gnas tshul rim par phul don bcas la/ chos skyong byings lung mtha' gcig tu ma mthun yang / gtso bo paṇa chen thams cad 107

mkhyen pa chen po'i thuṭa dam brtag phebs dang / la mo chos skyong chen po'i lung gis gsal bar bstan cing / gong ma chen po'i kyang tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid skor gtsang gi de gsal cha che ba byung 'dug pas pho brang nye 'dabs su gdan 'dren ngos/ slar byings la tsher snang mi gnang ba dang / tshugs thub pa byung bstun gser khri gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i bslab ston zhu dgos phebs pa'i dgongs don gyi rjes su 'brang ste/ gtsang ljongs su rgyal tshab rin po che dang / ji am ban/ no yon gung pa( ta 'khor tshogs dang bcas rgyal ba'i mchog snyul rin po che spyan 'dren la gshegs/ nged cag nas re shig snye thang bde ba can du stan chags rgyu'i gzim khang zhig gsos mtshon/ dgos cha gang ci'i gra sgrig dang / slar pho brang chen por phebs rgyu'i gzim gur sgar bcas dang / chibs dar/ chibs rol/ gzim 'bogs/ 'phan gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ gar pa dang / mchod sprin sna brgyad kyi gyon pas mtshon pa gsar bskrun gas la ston gyi bkod gshams bcas gra bsgrig zhus shing / skabs der lhar bcas 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang bde ldan zhing mgon paṇa chen bstan pa'i bdag po mchog bkra shis lhun por gdan lhan cig tu 'dzom thog gzhung dang / bla brang so sor nas gsol ston dang / 'bul skyes kyi bdog pa mtshar po nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar dbye ba lta bu bcas 108

phyan sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan du ma mngon par 'du mdzad nas/ lcags mo sbrul gyi lo zla tshes dge bar chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun po nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/ phebs lam du 'khod pa'i ser skya dad 'dus bsam gyi mi khyab pa mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel pas skye ba don dang ldan par mdzad de nye ba'i char chibs bskyod pa na gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dga' gsum bla ma las sne/ bdag cag la sogs drung na spyod pa'i rigs can sogs sa gzhi'i khyon dog por 'gengs pa dang / ser sbrings/ bro gzhas la sogs pa'i chibs bsu zhus te sku mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mjal ma thag 'khri shing dud pa lta bu'i phyag phul/ kho bo gcig pu phebs byam gyi drung du bcar nas mjal dar phul zhing / dgyes 'dzum g.yo bzhin par phyag —glang po'i sna zhags ltar brkyangs pa'i byin rlabs stsal ba'i dga' ba dang gus pas mchi mas mgrin pa brnangs par gyur/ rim gyis chos sde chen po mnyes thang bde ba can kyi 'jigs med chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sor bkra shis kyi 'khor lo bkod de phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston gyi cho ga nyams su bstar bar mdzad do/de nas gong ma bdag po chen po'i thog ma nas bka' phebs pa'i dgongs don dang mthun par/ rgyal tshab rin po che/ bdag cag bka' blon rnams gsung mol gyi thog nas bod kyi las don mdzad mi ji a ca/ na can la zhus par gong ma chen po'i gser snyan du phul ba'i phyir phebs la/10

ji hu can gyi sa nas/ de mo hu thog thu/ gung pa/ ta mngags te tā la'i bla ma'i mchog sprul mnyes thang bde ba can gyi dgon par spyan drangs pa nas mchog sprul sku skyed che ba byung gshis po ta la'i gser khrir gdan drangs na/zhwa ser byi bstan pa rgyas shing/ dbus gtsang gi dmangs tshang ma so/ so nas gus sgo 'phel ba yong tshul zhu yig phul byung zhing / pa: ta can nas kyang mchog gi sprul sku 'phral du po ta lar khri 'don gnang na/ nged bod 'bangs —mas bsod nams chen po yin tshul zhus 'dug pa kho pa tsho'i babs rmo bltas na bsam pa rnam dag yin 'dug gshis/ de mo hu thog thus zhus pa ltar gnang na 'os min bka' gsal zhus byung bar/ snga sor nged nas tā la'i bla cha/'i mchog sprul mi mang mjal skabs 'tsher snang med par bzhugs thub dus lha sar bsdad pa'i am ban tsho dang mnyam du bgros thog bslab ston zhus nas khri 'don mdzad 'jug ces bka' phab pa yin/ da cha mchog gi sprul sku sku bskyed che zhing / mi mang mjal skabs 'tsher snang mi 'dug pa babs 'brel byas na bslab ston zhus 'dug pa ltar tā la'i bla ma'i mchog sprul 'phral du po tā la'i khri la bton na 'os pa 'dug mtha' gcig du mchog sprul khri 'don mdzad rgyu'i sba yer dga' ston gyis las don chen po yin/ 'di la sna kya ho thog thu mang ṭa nas phyi lo mi ring nu dzang gi phu ching dang mnyam du lha sar phyin nas tshes grangs bzang ba 'dems sgrub kyis bltas pa'i mchog sprul gser khrir mnga' gsol byed chug nged kyi 710

gsol ras gnang cha'i dngos po rnams kyang kho pa tshor sprad nas khyer du chug ces dang / bka' rjes phebs la tā la'i bla ma'i sprul sku po tā la 'i khri la bzhugs su 'jug rgyu'i slad du nged nas/ khyed tshos zhus pa ltar ched du hal ha'i ching wang gi go sa can tshe brtan skyabs/ mi ring nu dzang gi phu ching /— shā kya ho thog thu/ rim pa dang po'i— shā to to'i e phu hu ling ṭā sogs phyung ste/ tā la'i bla ma'i spru / sku po tā la'i khri la gdan drangs nas bzhugs su chug ces bka' phebs bar cha/ngags pa yin/ zhes pa'i bka'i gnang ba stsal ba ltar/ chu pho rta'i lo hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes bdun gyi nyin/gdan sa khag gi bla ma las sne/ mkhan sprul/ gong ma chen po'i ge nga cha/ mngon par mtho ba'i bla dpon/ drung 'khor ser skya che 'bring chung gsum/hor sog maX' ris pa sogs kyi chibs bsu ba 'chi med kyi la/ du rgyu skar gyi 'phreng ba bkra ba lta bu dang gzhan yang ser spreng / bro gzhas sogs kyi bkod pa dang / mthong bas rnam bar grol ba'i go 'phang ra bsnyeṭa pa gzugs sgu mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor mjal ba la rgyang ring mo nas lhags pa dang bcas pa'i skye rgu nor 'dzin gyi dpal mo skabs dog por byed rte'i tshogs brgyud rgyal ba srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan chen po yab sras lhan gcig par mnyes thang bde ba can nas chibs kyi kha lo bskyod de mtshan nyid gling khar bzhugs zhag bcag mal dang / de nas tshes dgu nyin/ dung chen/mdo rdar gyi rol mo'i brdas baspu la te brgya byin nye dbang gi ka kyis bskor 111

ba'am/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bu'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ 'jig rten rnam par 'dren pa thams cad mkhyen gziṭa chen po nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin 'bar ba'i mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor gsal zhing / spyan ras kyis gzigs pa g.yo ba tsam gyis snang ba ma lus zil gyis gnon pa'i dge mtshan dang bcas bye chibs rag zad mi shes pa'i kha lo bskyod pa na/ dgon gnas dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang /gtsug lag khang dang / pho brang la sogs pa'i rtse nas bsangs kyi dud sprin nam mkha'i khyon kun 'gengs pa dang / sna tshogs pa'i rol mo'i bye brag gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu dang / dar mdung dang / lda sdi dang / ba dan dang / rgyal mtshan la soṭa pa mkha' la bgreng bas bar snang stong pa'i khams kyang lha'i longs spyod lta bu'i reg byas mtshar du dngar ba bres shing / phebs lam gyi gzhi'i g.yas g.yon du dmar ser gos kyis klubs pa'i ser ma ba'i tshogs mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ma tshang ba med par thogs pa'i ser threng dang /rnga shon/ 'bag shon/ rgya 'chams/ bro pa/ gzhas ma sogs gos bzang po'i klubs shing rgyan gyi bye brag phun sum tshogs pas dpa' ba sogs rgyal ba'i 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor blta ba la rings par lhag pa'i skye bo'i ka bgrang gi mi lang pa rnams kyi re ba 'bras bu dang ldan par mdzad de gru 'dzin 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i gzim chung nyi 'od 'khyil par phebar/ ston zhal spro'i rim pa la rten cing 'brel 'byung gi sa rga phyin ci ma log —13

pa legs tshogs su grub/ tshes bcu'i nyin srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad dog med gcig tu spungs pa'i mdun sa/ gru 'dzin pho brang chen po'i tshoms chen rnying pa'i grags snyan khams gsum na mngon par 'bar ba'i 'jiṭa med gdong lngas bteg pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por lha dang bcas pa'i che rgu mtha' dag gi gtsug gi cod pan gyis lan cig ma yin par btud pa la/'phaṭa mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug mi'i srid pa'i gar mkhan rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po dang / mgon po tshe mtha' yas kyi rnam rol paṇa chen thams can mkhyen gzigs chen po zhabs zung bkra shis kyi 'khor lo bkod thog thog ma kho nar 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen pos rgyal dbang srid zhi'i 'dren pa chen po 'jigs med gser gyi khri la mnga' gsol gzengs bstod kyi bka' lung gser yig dpag par dka' ba dril bsgrags/ de nas ched du mngags bzos kyi na bza' skor cha tshang dang /sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul dpyad/ shel dpyad/ dkar spyad/ gi gu shel gyi spyad pa/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ sa brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun soṭa gser dngul 'phul ma las grub pa bzo bkod rmad du byung ba dang / bzang gos dang dar zab yug bam can ches mang ba/ dngul dkar rta rmig ma brgya phrag gnyis sogs lhun po'i spo ltar mdun sa yongs su gang bar bstar zhing / dgyes ston gyi rim pa'ang gna' bo'i srol lam bzang po'i rjes su zhugs pa bkra shis shing byin chags pas mchog dman mtha' 113

dag dgyes pa rab kyi rtse mor son/tsho de'i nyin phyi ma nas paṇa chen bstan pa'i bdab/ po thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po dang / zhwa ser bstan pa'i 'dzin byed dpal ldan no min han/ drung 'khor ser skya spyi tshogs/ bdag cag bka' blon bzhi thun mong nas gsol ston zab rgyas dang 'brel ba rnam rgyal gra tshang gi 'dus pa'i tshogs nas tshe sbyin rnam par rgyal ma'i gsung chog dang bcas rgyal ba yab sras zhabs pad bskal pa ga 'i bye ma snyed kyi bar du brtan pa bzhugs su gsol ba dang / dus mtha'i bstan 'gro rnams la thugs rjes gzigs pa g.yel ba med pa dgos tshul sogs tshig sbyor lung degs dri ma med pa'i lam nas drangs pa rang blos ci spobs su gsol zhing /'bul dngos ma/la sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' skor/ sku'i nyer da6 da sogs ma tshang med pa/ gser dngul/ bzang gos/ ja sig la sogs pa ci 'byor ye shes kyi gzigs pa'i lam du btsa' ba sogs kyi skal bzang —byas pa don ldan la longs spyod/ 'di dag gi tshe nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba dam pa srid pa'i mig tu 'bar ba'ang / 'byung po'i bya 'ug pa rgan po'i mig la mun par snang ba ltar bcos su ma mchis pa la la dag la ni nges mtha' ci yod/ gzhan du na bsam shes dang ldan pa'i skye bo yin phyin chad rgyal dbang mchog gi zhal mjal ba dang / gsung thos pa tsam kyis rang dbang dang bral bar dad pa'i shuṭa phyin pa'i mig bgrad de dga' zhing gus pa'i skal bzang nyams su myong ba las/ deng sang gi bar du dad 'dus kyi lus can 11

dbyar gyi char sprin stug por langs ba lta bu'am/ sa'i rlang rdol ba —lta bu bar mtshams med par lhags nas mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel ba zhus te — rtse gcig pa'i gsol 'debs la 'bad pa ni shin tu don yod pa'i dpal la spyor ba'o/ gong du brjod pa ltar gnam kyi lha gong ma bdag po chen po'i lung — las kyis mngon par mtho ba'i bla dpon rnams ded dpon mkhas pa'i chu gter chen po nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che blangs te phyir ldog pa'i spro ba chen po'i/ dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang / nad pa nad las grol bas dga' bas kyang mtshon du med pa dga' ba 'bum gyis khengs pa rnams la byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi 'byor pa'i dpya las bsdus pa'i gnang skyes kyi bdog par mtshar po bzang zhing gya nom pas kyang tshim par mdzad de gser gyi rgyal khab chen por bskyod par gyur to/'di skabs chab mdo rgyal ba 'phags pa lha/ brag g.yab sprul sku sogs bla sprul khag dang / rnam rgyal gra tshang tshogs yongs bcas nas gsol 'debs zhus don paṇa chen bstan pa'i bdag po mchog gi dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rdul mtshon la brten pa/ byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang / mchog dbang gong ma dang / gong chen/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang chen bcas nyin gnyis kyi bar du kho bos kyang skal bzang gi dga' ston bla na med pa thob bo/ 1 15

di nas mi ring bar pan chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po nas rgyal dbang mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rang rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen por thugs nges rnyed pa'i sgo nas zhabs zung g.yo med rdo rje snying po'i khams su brtan pa dang / rlabs chen 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa rgyal ba gong ma ji lta bar bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag chen por smin pa dgos tshul sogs kyi snyan gsol mtha' klas pa'i ljags bshad dang bcas ma/la/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' skor cha tshang / sku'i nyer dpyad/ gser dngul/gos dar ja sig la sogs pa'i dngos 'bul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /gsol ston gyi rim pa rgyas gshom bcas legs par stsal zhing / gtsang ljongs su chibs kyi kha lo bskyod kha—ra rgyal ba yab sras gdan lhan gcig tu 'dzim zhing gsol ston 'bul skyes kyi bdog pa bstar res su stsal ba dang /rgyal ba yab sras tha dad du gshegs bzhugs la thugs kyis mi bzod pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur la zham ring pa bdag kyang yid blong blong por gyur pa bcas/'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ste chibs kha bsgyur ba la bdag cag gis kyang snye— thang ra ba stod kyi dgon gnas bar zhabs rjes su 'byeng zhing de nub kho bos paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po mtshan gzim khang du sger 'jal zhus/ dngul dkar las grub pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pa dang / rje btsun sgol ma gtso 'khor khri rgyab dang bcas pa rgya gar shar li rtsod bral byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba za ser zangs phul ma'i 116

bzhugs khang g.yu phras mdzes pa dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mdzang pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i chos 'byung pod gnyis/ bka' gdams gdung rten lcags rtse ma/ bzang gos yugs bam can dang bcas phul zhi nga skye zhing skye ba'i 'phreng ba tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i skyabs rol nas 'dor ba me da pa rjes su 'dzin dgos sogs kyi gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab par/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i re ba yid bzhin du 'jo ba'i bka' stsal bzang po'i rdodabugs dbyung kyang legs par thob bo/ de ltar kho bo so skye phal pa 'ching ba kun ldan nyam chung ngu zhig yin mod kyang / tshe rabs snga ma'i bsags rgyab phran bu'i 'bras bus rigs mthon por sgogs pa'i rgyud du skyes/ rigs gnas sogs bslab shes kyi yon tan phran bu dang / sgyu rtsal gyi rim pa la'ang rang mnyam la ngo mi gnong zhing / gzhan dring mi 'jog tsam khong du chud rang lo bco brgyad pa nas gzhung sa rin po che dga' ldan pho brang ba'i drung 'khor lha yi spun zla bgrang ba las 'das pa'i gras su zhugs/ de nas rgyal po lha bzang gi skabs gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse'i yong sdud dang / de'i phyi lo rdzong sdod du bsko bzhag mdzad/ de nas jun gar pa'i dpung shed kyi bod bzung ba'i sde srid stag rtse ba'i dus thog mar gri gu gzhis sdod dang / de rjes sde srid stag rtse'i mgron drung nyis brtsegs lta bu'i las khur re zhig bzung / de nas gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po pho brang po ta lar 117

chibs kha bsgyur rjes/ bka'i gung blon pho lha tha'i ji nags shod sogs kyi don gcod du phebs tshab rtsis dpon gyi las khur blangs/ de nas dbung gtsang gi sde gzar langs rjes bya lo gong ma bdag po chen po'i bka' phab ste rim pa da nga po'i dza sag tha'i ji'i cho lo dang / bka' blo na gyi las khur byed dgos phebs/ bar skabs mi nga bang de nyid nas bsher dpon byi skabs kyang / bka' blon dang nyis spyog byed dgos phebs pa bzhin lo shas de don zhus te gzhung 'bab che tshad las kyang brgal ba'i 'bor che byung ba dang / 'gal zla rnams la'ang mngon shes kyis dpyod ma 'es pa phar zhog gzhan ma mnyam stom phyogs lhung med pa'i drang thig gi bcad mtsham rnams so sor brtag pas gsal ba ltar zhal lce bcad/ yang wang da 'a 'i shā dur gong ma'i bka' khrims kyis tshar bcad rjes bka' blon gyi las khur skor la gung pa/ ta sngon ma nas las don byed bzhin bka' ltar las gsar du bsko rgyu med/ tshe ring dbang rgyal da nga / sri gcod tshe brtan gnyis da dung yang sngar srol ltar bka' blon gyi las don byed nga bos/ bka' blon 'brong rtse ba mig long ba'i tshab tu/ mgron gnyer nyi ma rgyal mtshan bsko bzhag byed zhes don tshan bcu gsum 'khod pa dang / de rjes nged cag rnams phyogs mtshungs la gong ma'i bka' shog gser yig phebs don la/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi khyon la dbang bsgyur ba hong pa'i bka'/ nged nas sa chen po dge bar 118
