khrims kyis skyong ba la phyi nang la nye ring khyad par med nga ra thams cad la sems stoms par byed pa yin/ legs pa la gzengs bstod dang / nyes pa dma' 'bobs rtsad gcod byed pa dang / go sa rim nga bzhag nas tshul mthun ngo so ster ba ni srid chen po'i lugs srol yin/ log sgrub byed mi 'gyur med rnam rgyal nas / nged kyi bslab par khyad du bsad de/ yid gtad kyi bka' drin bskyangs par ras su bor/ tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen rin po cher sri zhu/ zhwa ser gyi bsta pa la bkur sti byed rgyu rnams la cung zad kyang ma brtson pa dang / bod du don da spyod byed par bsdad pa'i am ban rnams kyi tshig la mi nyan par/ sgo sna tshogs nas mi drang zhing gzhung med pa'i las brtsams te nye tshan la 'tshe ba dang / 'bangs rnams sdug la sbyar/ jun gar dang yi bcugs 'brel ba sems la bzhag nas tā la'i bla ma la 'che ba dang 1/ bod 'bangs la sdug ras gtong bas grab yul bshoms par/ bod du bsdad pa'i am ba rnams nas byed lugs kyi stangs ngan pa ma bzod par/ kho pa'i byed ngan la brten log sgrub byed pa de nyid khrims la sbyar te bod kyi spyi'i sdug sri bcad pa yin/ deng phyin chad bod 'bangs rnams nas/ nged kyi bka' drin la brten nas rtag tu bde skyid la gnas pa'i phyir du tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen rin po che la sri zhu dang / am ban mas la blo mthun gyis/ zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyid byu mi

'byung bar 'gyur ba'i thabs/ bka' blon khyod rnams nyid nas soms rtse gcig gi las don drang po byed pa la rag las pa yin/ bka' blon tha'i ji tshe ring dbang rgyal khyod bod kyi rigs bzang zhing / mi gzhung yod kyi brgyud pa yin zhing / chab srid chen po'i bdag rkyen dang du blangs te/srid la phan 'doṭa pa'i dza sag rim pa dang po'i tha'i ji'i gzengs bstod du byas pa yin 'dug da bee am ban rnams dang tā la'i bla ma lhan du bgros nas khyod la bka' blon bsko bzhag dgos tshul zhus 'dug pa stor bka' drin ched du bskyangs nas bka' blon bsko ba'i 'ja' sa gser yig phab pa yin/ khyed kyi 'ja' sa gser yig 'di gus pa blangs nas chab srid chen po'i bka' drin la gus 'dud kyi byas pa bzo ba sems rtse gcig gis gyis/ tā rme'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rin po che la sri zhu legs par gyis/ am ban tsho'i bslab bya la legs par nyan nas gang thub ci spyo ṭa kyi 'bad 'bad dung dung gyis dmag dpung gra bsgrigs 'os bstun dang / dpung rnams no ngar shugs che rtsal bzang par spyong ba dang / yul ljongs rnams bsrung ba dang /so 'on seng bya ra sogs la 'bad par gyis/ 'bangs rnams don med sdug tu ma 'jug don rtsa che chung thams cad tā la'i bla ma dang am ban tsho la dgongs len zhus nas lugs dang mthun par drang pos gzhung bsrang dgos/g.yo sgyu zol zog med pa gyis/ rang blo a 'thas kyir srid kyi bya ba g.yel du ma 'jug mnga' 'og rnams byams brtses skyong zhing / ser skya gcig 12 0

dril gyi blo mthun par gyis/ nged nas tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rin po cher yid gces pa dang zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can gyi bde skyid la phan par bsam pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par gyis/ nged kyi bslab cha 'di rnams la gus pa chen pos dang du blangs te ched gtad kyi go babs leṭa par bsgrubs na khyed kyi pha mes dang bcas pa la ngo so gtam don legs par 'gyur zhing / bu tsha rigs rgyud la bsod nams thob par 'gyu—/gal bye 'di las 'das na chab srid chen po'i bka' khrims btsan po'i nges par mnar bar 'gyur/ nam yang mi 'gyur ba gyis/ khyen lung rgyal po'i gnam lo bcu drug pa'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes drug la/ zhes gong ma bdag po chen po'i bka' lung gser gyi gnya' shing 'dzin ri ltar lci ba dril bsgrags/ khams gsum skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen pos kyang bka'i gung blon gyi go sar gzengs bstod bka' drin che ba bcas bka' blon gyi phyi las khur thog mar bzung ba nas da snya'i bar du'ang lo grangs sum cu rtsa lnga tsam song bar/ gong du brjod pa'i las tshan gyi rim pa mtha' dag mthar skor ri skor gyi rnam bkra dang nor dang g.yo sgyus bsgu thabs kyis zhus gnang sogs ma yin par bkas bcad kho na yin pa rang ngos blo gros dang shes bya dman cing / snying stobs kyi 'jug pa phra bas chos srid lugs gnyis kyi zhabs 'di ṭa la ngo so thon pa 'di zhus kyi byas ma bgrang rgyu med cing / bstan pa rin po che dang / mnga' 'bangs mi ser 121

gyi thad du'ang gong ma mchod yon gyi dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i bde skyid la 'god pa'i rdzu zhugs ci yang ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang rang blo rang la skog tu ma gyur pa'i snang tshul la/ rang nyid gzhung sa'i thugs rjes 'tsho ba'i mnga' 'bangs 'di phyi gtan gyi legs tshogs thams cad gzhung sa rin po che kho na la brten nas byung ba yin gshis gzhung don lar rgya'i skor la blo dang nus pa/ shed shugs gang thon gyi sgo nas zhabs 'debs lhag bsam rnam dag kho na bsgrub pa las rang 'dod phugs su zhen nas gnyen ( khor stos bdus rnams mgo 'don rgyab skyor/ yid la gnag pa gang yin pa shugs kyis rma 'byin pa dang / gnod 'tshe byas pa sogs med par drang tshugs gang zin bgyis shing / khyad par sdod sa dpral ba dang / mig la thal ba'i dpe ltar gzhung sa rin po che'i mnga' thang dpal 'byor la nyams chag tu 'gyur ba la ji yang mi snyam par/ rang rang gi ngo so thon slad gzhung 'bangs sogs gzhan la sbyor ba dang / rang gi zhu ba sogs sna tshogs pa zhig byung song ba yod med kyang / kho pa ni gnyen dang / phyogs gtogs la mgo'adon rgyab skyor gyi gnang gtad zhus rigs ci yang med cing / bka' blon kyi las khur zhus nas da lta bar che btsan byings 'gre zhu sne sbyar na phran bu'i sa rigs mi ser sogs kyi bab thob med par min nam snyam yang / ji skad du/ rgyal po lha yi 'dod pa gang yin dang / mi yi 'dod pa bzang po gang yin pa/ /de dag thams cad mi gcig gis thob kyang / /de yis122

chog med des kyang yang 'tshol lo/ zhes gsung ba ltar 'dod pa la chog shes med pa ni tha chad du gsungs ba ltar mi dbang de nyid nas bzung da lta'i bar du gzhung gi cha bas nas mi ser dud gcig dang / zhing sna mig tsam yang zhus pa med par rang zas sman dang / gzhan zas dug gi dpe ltar pha mes kyi 'dzin dbang gis chog shes par gnas pa 'di bzhin dang / de yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor mchod de gsol ba btab na 'dod dgu thams cad 'bad med du 'byung ba yin mod/ de— dbang shugs btsan pa mang pos dum bur byas te khyer na dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i thabs med par ltar/ gzhung sa rin po che'i thugs rje la brten bye bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba dang / dpon 'bangs kyi go 'babs bsgrubs na re 'bras thams cad lhun gyis 'grub pa gor ma dzwag cing / chab 'bangs rnams nas bzang rgu 'dod dbang gis zhus/ khrul rigs rnams kyang ji bzhin mi sgrub pa 'di 'dra'i rigs ni yid bzhin kyi nor bu dum bur bsil ba dang bye brag med par re 'bras 'byung ba'i yul dang bral ba bzhin no/gzhan yang drag zhan phal cher nas gzhung zhabs la dos sa rims soṭa kyang rang mtshams kyis bskul ba'i brdabs bsigs mnar spyod ji snyed pa dang / 'bam tshong / spus gtad sogs rgya che mu med kyi srol lam dar bar mchis kyang / nged rang gi cha nas tshong zhor bskur ma 'dra phran bu ni med/ gzhan ma ngos rta gtong ba 'bam tshong sogs mi ser la rtser snyad 123

rigs spu tsam med pa ni phyogs kun gyi sne mo rgan dmangs bcas kyi blo la gsal ba ltar dang / de ma tshad gzhung gi khrul rigs skor sgrub 'os spyi dang / lhag du lam thog gi 'khri sgrub drag zhan tshang ma sa sgrub dgos rtsa tshig rin po cher gsal yang / deng sang che btsan phal cher gyis phra bzung kho na dpa' mtshan du bzung nas mi sgrub pa dang de yang khe thob yin snyam snang yang / rang ngos nas rtsa tshig rin po che la ngo mi phog par sgrub blang tshul bzhin zhus shing / khrul rigs gzhan dag sgrub dgos rnams kyang kang 'gro lag 'don gang gi thad nas kyang chad lus rigs phra mo tsam med par sgrub blangs zhus pa bcas 'di dag thams cad dpon 'bangs kyi go bab las 'bras kyi bden pa'i dbang gis rang gi bsod nams bsogs pa'i rgyur 'gro ba ma gtogs/ phra bzung ma thub pa'i spyong sgrub khel ba ni ma yin te/ ngan pa byas rgyal phra bzung 'os min byas pa spyod ngan ngo so 'khyer ba rnams la ni las 'bras kyi rnam par smin pa brnag dka' ba nges par myong dgos pa gdon mi za ba'o/ de ltar gong du brjod pa ltar rang nyid kyis ji ltar spobs pa'i drang tshugs bzung ste rgyal ba yab sras kyi zhabs 'degs dang bo/nga ma'i bka' khrims la bag zon gyi bya ba yin lugs su spyod pa las gzhan dag la 'dir ltar 'doms pa la ni blo gros dang brtul zhugs dam pas/ che drag da nga bcas pa rnams kyis go bas blangs bye la rgya'i stor shing du mi 'gro ba zhib/ 124

blor ma bcag na ral gri la khur tshur brdeg pa dang / ri la spyi bos brdung ba snya bu'i ngang tshul lam yid kyi sog le shing la mi 'gro ba'i dpe ltar btsan po rnams ni/ rang rang so so bag yang ci dgar spyod pa la bya thabs dben pa shes ldan kun gyi gzigs pas gsal ba ltar la/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mang pos ma thul zhing /mthu chen rgyal sras rnams kyis ma thul ba/smad na khong khro bstod na dregs pa skye/mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran sems can/dman la nga rgyal rtsub pa'i sems 'chang ba/chos mthun tshig gis smras kyang chags sdang byed/byis pa'i skye bo 'di dag bdag gis ni/da lta 'dul bar mi nus rang sems thul/zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / de yang rang nyid gyi bya byed spyod gsum gang ci drang pos bsam pas gzhi bzung ba zhig rnam pa kun tu yid la 'gro ṭa pa las bstan lta lar rlabs che'i zhabs 'de ṭa bsgrubs pa sogs byas byung gi ngo so thon pa ci yang ma mchis shing / rang nyid na tshod kyi bgrang bya'ang mthon por son pas phug bsam gyi spros pa cher ma mchis rung bu tsha brgyud 125

dang bcas pa rnams slar yang 'jig rten gyi 'khos ka 'dzin pa la / deb dang gtan ga kyis lung 'dren pa zhig dgos gshis/ me pho byi ba'i lo rgyal dbang rdo rje sna thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por kho bo cag gi 'dzin dbang gang na ci yod la sgrub chag 'jag gsum gyi gtan tshig sher bam chen mo zhig zhus par/ phran tsho'i sa bon du rang 'dod kyi che brjod sogs ci la yang 'god ma nus shing / rang nyid nas 'dod zhus dang gzhan gyis bskul ma zhus pa sogs ci yang med rung / sa bon la/ bka' blon mdo mkhar ba 'di pa'i pha dus nas bzung gzhung sa'i zhabs 'degs sgrub pa'i shing rta sto dmag chen po'i skabs mon shar phyogs la dmag dpon du mngags par mtshan jus 'gro khyab che ba mtshar dga' gzengs bstod mngon par mtho ba byung 'dug pas mtshon bya byed gang ci yin luṭa su spyod pa dang /rgyal mchog sku 'phreng na rim la zol med dad stobs dang ldan pa de nyid kyi rigs kyi myu gur gyur pa 'di pas kyang / gnam bskos dga' ldan pho brang pa'i zham ring drung na spyod pa'i gras su zhugs te rgyal khab chen po'i rtsis dpon dang bka' blon gyi las 'khur bzung ste blo gzu bor gnas shing 'khos dpag lhag bsam mi dman pa'i sgo nas zhabs 'de ṭa bsgrubs dang bsgrub mus bcas bdag rkyen gyi 'os su che bar/ zhes pa'i tshig gzhi bkod nas ka po la 'debs zhus par/ rgyal dbang tham sa cad mkhyen gzigs chen po gdu'/ bya ris su ma chad pa mtha' dag la bsnyen bsring phyogs/ lhu nga dang bral 126

zhing / gzhan ngor gzigs pa'i bsngags brjod sogs ci la gnang rung /'khor ba pa chung ngu bdag rang la tshad med pa'i gzigs pa bla na med pas — bskyangs te/ she bam sa bon gyi zin bris khongs su ljags rmyo sa kho na gnang ste srubs mchan bka' tham 'byar ba phebs par/ —bka' blon mdo mkhar ba zhes pa'i srubs 'jug la/ 'di pa byang stag lung pa zhes gangs ljongs 'dir chos srid gnyis ldan gyi go sa khungs dang ldan cing / bstan 'gror phan bde spel ba'i gdung rabs kyi 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i 0rgyud pa bsngags 'os yin par ma zad/ ces dang / yang bka' blon gyi las khur bzung bar/ zhes pa'i gsham du srubs 'jug bka' mchan la/ ya rabs kyi ngang tshul dang ldan cing / lugs zung gi bya bzhag che phra gang cir shes bya'i blo gros mchog tu yangs pa dang / blo gzu bor gnas shing / lhag pa'i bsam pa rma med pa bcas srid chen po'i gung blon gyi dper 'os pa'i bsam sbyor phun tshogs kyi sgo nas yin lugs su/ spyo da pa'i zhabs 'degs bsgrubs dang / bsgrub bzhin bcas gang ci nas mig bskyangs bdag rkyen chen po'i skyong 'os 'gran zla ma mchis pa yin pa zhes sogs gsar du bsgon 'phri gnang ba de rnams ma gtogs/ bsgrubs chag 'jags gsum gyi skor sa bon du gang phul gyi tshig gzhir bsgyur bkod tshig gcig med pa gtsang rgyag tu phebs shing / bam bri gzhi'i gos chen kyang phyag mdzod nas stsal ba dang / yi ge yang drung yig chen po skal bzang bde chen lags la 'brir 127

'jug pa gnang ba bcas bka' drin gyi phul bsam gyis mi khyab ba thob pa/'di dag la dpag na 'jig rten thams cad kyi skyabs mgon/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus sgrib pa dang bral ba gzigs pa/ skye rgu ma lus pa'i legs nyes kyi spyod tshul phyag mthil skyu ru'i 'bras bu ltar mkhyen pa/ chos kyi gtugs sa 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi dpe lta bu kun mkhyen rgyal dbang mchog las ma 'das gshis/ gang gi bka' stsal dri ma med pas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa drag zhan tshang ma'i spyan lam du bstar chog pa 'di ni/gzhan dag gis ltar snang mdzes mtshon gyis ngo bstod byas pa dang ma 'dra pas rgyal ba'i bka' tshad mar gyur pas gzengs bstod du stsal ba rmongs pa bdag lta bu'i thob par dka' ba/ blos dpag par dka' ba yin mod kyang / rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i byin shu gas dang bsod nams kyi mthu dpal la brten nas rang gi las kyi 'khor lo log par mnga' phyan pa byas kyi lam du song ba rgyal dbang mchog gi dgongs zab ye shes kyi khrong du chub pa'i rdo rje'i gsang tshig 'di ltar stsal ba sna byas pa don dang ldan pa/rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa/ rang gi ngang tshul bsngags brjod dang 'byel bas spobs pa ches cher snyed de dgra la 'phyar rgyu dang / gnyen la ngom rgyu phyi rabs kyi mi rgyud rnams nas kyang thos na snyan pa/ bsam na dga' ba/blo gros kyi rtsal yod pa zhig yin na pha mas kyis byas pa 'di lta bu zhig bgyis 'dug pa dang / bdag cag gis kyang de las mi zhan par chos dang 128 — ——

srid kyi bya ba 'de dang 'di lta bu zhig lhur blangs nas bla dpon gyi zhabs 'degs/ ri rang rang gi 'phral yun gyi bya byed thams cad yin lugs su spyod pa zhig cis kyang bgyid do snyam pa'i sgo ba bskyed par bya rigs shing / lar yang lugs gnyis blang dor gyi bslab bya/ sngon gyi mkhas grub lo paṇa/ chos rgyal sogs dam pa mang pos yang nas yang du legs par bshad pa rgya cher mchis mod/ de dag la spang blang bgyis na de las lhag pa'i gsol 'debs gleng 'os ma mchis kyang / grong tshig go bde'i lam du sbyar na 'phral snang 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag skor la dper mtshon na/ deng sang skye bo drung na spyod pa'i rigs can sogs na tshod ches phra ba nyid nas myos 'gyur gyi btung ba la ni bag med du spyod/ de'i dbang gis spyod pa'ang tho brtsam — spyod la 'byams klas shing / rigs rus da༄ / mtho dman mnyam pa sogs kyi rtogs dpyod med par bzhin stabs mtshar ba zhig byung na mgar shan/ smad tshong ma sogs dang bsdebs nas 'jig rten gyi smod pa la ji mi snyam par byed cing / dngos chas yod rgu bud med kyi gos rgyan du bsgril bar byed pa dang —/mthar yang lus la reg pa'i dug gis 'bags nas 'jig rten phyi mar 'gro ba'i— rkyen du byed pa sogs la bag zon dang bral ba dang / rnam pa kun tu gzhung sa rin po che'i thugs rje'i gzi byin kho na la rten nas lar rgya'i legs tshogs thams cad 'grub pa yin gshis gzhung don gtso bor bzung nas rang don shugs la 'byung ba'i blo rtse gtod rigs kyang / las sne la sogs pa'i 129

go sar 'khod ma thag pa nas gzhung gi phyag rdzas la 'bags god dang / mi ser la thob med kyi za bed rdabs bsigs kho na la nyam mi nga zhing / sne mo der sleb phyin rang gi khyim gyi yo byad gang dang ci 'dod pa bzo bo sna tshogs par sgrub tu 'jug pa dang / khrims don drang por mi srong bar nye dga' phyogs skyor gyi gleng bzhag dang / khrul rigs kyang gzhung nas phran bu tsam brda sbyor byung na de la khag btags kyi zhor drud rgya cher mu med byed pa mi ser khrul dngul bsdus nas gzhung la ma phul bar sne mo bas bod spyad/ der brten gyi 'dod chen thon pa sogs sngar med gsar spros kyi lam ngan 'di phyis su byung ma thag yin pas/ de ltar na 'phral du legs nyes kyi stang 'dzin gsal bar ma byung kyang chos srung mthu bo che rnams kyis tshar gcod pa dang / rang gi byas shing bsags pa'i las rnams ni nges par myong bar gdon mi za ba yin pas na/ de lta bu'i go 'phang mthon por gyur kyang thob par ma gyur cig ces smon lam gyis mtshams spyor zhing / spyir yang 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag thams cad ya rabs dra ma mdzangs pa'i lugs su zhugs te/ yin lugs drang por skyong ba las/ snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus kyi rnam 'gyur gyis skye bo rnams kyi spyod pa'ang tha shal du gyur te 'phral snang du rnam par bkra ba dang / g.yo sgyu mkhas pa/ nor gyis blu bsogs mngon par mtho ba dang / bya ba lam du 'gro ba lta bur snang mod kyang / ji skad du/ dman la spyod pa bzang byung yang / de ni bcos 130

pa'i rnam thar yin/ shel la nor bus kha bsgyur yang / chu dang 'phrad na rang mdog ston/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mtha' mi brtan pa 'gyur ba'i chos can de rigs kyi rjes su mi 'brangs bar rang tshugs thub par bya zhing /bzang po la bzang lan dang / ngan pa la ngan lan 'jal thub pa'ang 'jig rten spyi'i lugs srol dang pho rgod kyi grangs su 'grang bar 'os pa yin kyang /'jig rten phyi ma shul thag ring po'i myong gyur la brtag na de dag kyang rnam smin brnag dka' ba rang nyid kyi thog tu 'bab pa kho na yin/ bya byed dang dgos pa ci 'dra zhig byung yang skyabs mchog rin po che rnam gsum la blo gtad/ las rgyu 'bras la dbang po bcol/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi mi dge ba bcu'i rnam smin rgyu mthun bdag po'i 'bras bu rnams rang thog tu nges par stsong tshul bsam pa'i sgo nas spang zhing / de spang pa'i dge ba bcu'i las lam legs par slob pa las 'bras la nges pa rnyed nas dkar na ga la 'dor len tshul bzhin du byed pa 'di yang ཿ /ga pa'i lta ba zhes dkar chos kun gyi gzhir bsngags pa ltar nyams su blang bar byas na mi dge ba'i las lam gang yin rim gyis 'gags shing / dge ba'i las lam gong 'phel du 'gro ba 'di ni blo gros dang ldan pa mtha/5 dag gi don du gnyer ba na 'jig rten gyi bya ba zhag kyang bag yod dang nges par 'brel ba spyod cing las 'bras la yid ston pa shugs kyi5 'ong ba'i phyir na/ 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi don grub pa'i thar 'do dag bee lta ci smos/ khyim —31

pa gzu bor gnas pa zhig yin kyang lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas dam pa'i lam dang mi 'gal ba'i kun spyod gang legs shig bgyis na/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / lha dang mi yi them skas la/ 'dzeg na thar pa gam na 'dug ces gsungs pa ltar yid la 'doms par byas te/ 'jig rten gyi sgo nas mna' za/ dug spyor/ blo gtad snying rku/ bla dpon dang pha ma la rgyab gtod/ dge 'dun gyi sde dkrug pa/ g.yo thabs phung sbyor gyis sde gzar slong ba sogs rmi lam du'ang mi bya ba yid dam 'cha' ba dang / der ma zad chos phyogs kyi sgo nas gtso bo rdo rje slob dpon dang chos dam tshig gi 'brel ba yul gnyan zhing /rtsa nyung bcu bzhi la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin srung ba zhig ma byung na mnar med dam/ rdo rje dmyal bar lhung ba gdon mi za ba nyid kyi phyir 'di la ni ci nas kyang bag zon gal che ba yin te/rang dbang med kyi 'dam du bying na yang / chos dbang zhus kyi bla ma kha ma gtong / zhes pa ltar rdo rje slob dpon lta ci smos/ rdo rje'i spun grogs sogs la'ang smad par mi rung mod kyang / deng sang rdo rdze slob dpon nas tshe dbang tsam stsal ba'ang dam tshig bsrung dgos gras su mi bgrang zhing /dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdo rje slob dpon la dbang chen zhus pa'i gras su yod na rdo —'i spun —dang / bla ma gcig gis drung du dbang chen snga phyi byas nas zhus na rdo rje spun du 'dren pa'i snang ba ma gtong ba sogs hol spyod du song 13rngo

ba ma gtogs/ cho sa tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa'ang slob dpon du bzung dgos pa dang bla ma gcig gi zhabs la thug phyin chos zhu 1 snga phyi gang 4na kyang rdo rje'i spun phu bo dang / nu bo'i dbye ba las khyad par ma mchis pa'i dam tshig tshul bzhin du bsrung dgos gsungs pa sogs dam pa'i chos kyi gnad 'gag zab cing rgya che ba kho bo lta bus brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir na/ 'dir sne mtshon tsam zhig bskul 'debs kyi ched du smras pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gi drung du dad pa bcos min sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas chos nyan/ bde legs —thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin par nges shes kyis rnyed pa/ bkur bsti/ rim gro bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa bcas kyis mnyes par byas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba sogs thun mong gi lam gyis rgyud spyongs/ de nas rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam la zhugs te mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zab mo'i dbang gis rang rgyud du sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs pa byas/dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung / rgyud sde'i snying po lam rim pa gnyis kyi nyams len la brtson par zhuṭa te sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzoṭa te zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba zhig byung na dgos pa tha/sa cad kyi snying po/ rang gzhan zams cad kyi don gnyis lhun gyi 'grub par gdon mi za ba 'di lta bu'i gnas la blo gros dang / snying 133

stobs kyi mthu bskyed par rigs pa lags so/de ltar )jig rten khyim pa'i bya bzhag ni bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi spyod tshul mtha' yas pa zhig mchis kyang / bzang por rlom pa/ rnam/ ba bde bar shar ba rnams kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i phyir na gang la'ang snying po rdul tsam ma mchis pa 'di go na gzhan ma'i bya byed/ rnam bzhag thams cad a 'thas kyi spros /pa shugs kyis dor bar snang bas 'dir mang du smras nas ci zhig bya snyam du btang stoms su byas pa ste/ gzhan du mi'i dbang po bkra shis rab brtan dbyangs can dbang po'i sde'i gsungs las/ snyigs dus tshe la long dang 'khor ba la/ snying pos dben kyang dam chos ma nus phyin/ 'jig rten dag kyang nus par ma gyur na/ mi las khyir yang mi gtub go bar mdzod/ces dal 'byor mi lus rin po che thob pa 'di don med don log tu ma song ba dam pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs nas/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin pa'i go 'phang bsnyegs pa zhig ci nas kyang zhe dam du bya dgos shing /gal te las dbang btsan po / dam pa'i chos sgrub par ma nus phyin/ 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag gang yin yin lugs su spyod nga bag dang ldan pa zhig ma byung na mi'i gras/ bee ci smos/ khyir yang mi gtub gsung pa'ang dpyad gzhi che bar snang bas blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pas spang blang bya bar rigs so/'dir rang nyid kyi spyod tshul/ gzhan la legs 'doms dang bcas 134

pa 'di lta bu dam pa'i yul du bab col byung rgyal du smra ba ni shin tu nas mi rigs kyang / rang nyid nye du 'khor g.yog sogs stos pa bcas pa mang dag zhig rtse gcig tu re ltos 'cha' bar mchis pa la/ gsong por brjod pa'i snang tshul 'di lta bu la dper byas na bsngags par 'os pa dang / legs pa'i gras su 'dren 'os pa ma mchis kyang / ma rabs tha shal gyi gral du ma tshud pa'i 'bring po tsam zhig yong du re bas/ snga rabs kyi lo rgyus phyin chad kyi blang dor sogs yin lugs su spyod pa la phan pa'ang srid dam snyam nas/ kho bo nad kyis mnar nas yu na ring du dub pa'i skabs/ deng sang snang tshul la brtag na res 'ga' ni spro ba skye/ re 'ga' ni sems khong du chud/ kun rtog gi ri mo ci yang 'char ba gnyis byug pa las grol phyir blos ji ltar nges pa ri mo'i lam du drang ba 'dis kyang skye rgu rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig 'khor ba sbrang rtsis byugs pa ral gri'i so/ /myang na phan bde'i ro 'dzin gcod byed pa/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi tshor ba drag 'bar bas/ /yun ring ngal zhing dub pa'i rgyu la spyad/ /char sprin zab mo'i nang ge glog 'gyu bzhin/ /res 'ga' dal 'byor phun tshogs lus thob kyang / /135

'di snang rnyed grags srid pa'i bde 'byor la/ /dngos zhen a 'thas dbang gis lan mang bslus/ /de slardo dam pa'i bsngags 'os spyod pa'i tshul/ /'ga' yang ma mchis 'jig rten bya ba'i rgyun/ /a ma brla yi khur gyis non pa la/ / — legs byas bzang po lo rgyus rin po che/ /do shal mkhas mgrin bcang 'os ma mchis pa/ /spyi brtol bskyed pa'i bab col ri mo'i lam/ /'god pa 'bras med ngal ba lhur len yin/ /'on kyang g.yo sgyu zol sbyor rdzun tshig gis/ /gzhan dag mgo bo rmongs byed rang bstod dang / /gzhan la sdang zhugs kun rtogs ngan pa yis/ /'brel med sgo btags dbyangs su 'dzer min pa/ /rang gi kun gzhi'i ras dkar gtsang ma'i ngos/ /sna tshogs las kyi tshon ris gsar 'char bas bzang ngan snang brnyan ji snyed bkra ba'i tshul/ /zol med brjod la 'gal ba'i cha shas ci/ /136

khyad par rang gi rigs kyi khyad par las/ /byung ba'i phyi rabs brgyud pa'i phreng ba dag/ pha ma'i rigs rus spyo da tshul yig tshang sogs/ / sngon gyi byung ba yongs su rtogs pa dang / / phyis kyi spyod pa'i tshul yang cha shas tsam/ / 'dom pas blang dor gnas la bde blag du/ /'jug pa'i blo gros mthu dpung cher bskyed de/ /skye ba don ldan bgyid slad 'di smras so/ /gzhan du rang gi grags pa sgrub slad dang / /gzhan dman dbab phyir sgo bas 'di ma byas/ / gzhan la phan par 'dom pa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /gzhan dag blang dor gsal ba'i gsos su smon/ /de skad dus mthar skyes pa'i gyi na pa/ / / tshangs sras dgyes blo tshe ring dbang gi rgyal/ /'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i rnal 'a sbyor la/ /gcig tu brtson par zhugs des 'di bgyis pa'i/ /dge tshogs ku mud zla 'od myungs 'dra bas/ / —137
